The Rite of Anastases can be done by the Queen of the Antinium to reborn the dead; only a Prognugator would be considered worthy, and the Queen labored nearly three weeks.
Ksmvr is no longer the Prognugator when Klbkch returns.
Klbkch tells a gathered crowd that errors were made by the Antinium and the Watch, that the creature is dead and that he has returned to life, and invites everyone to celebrate.
Klbkch refuses Erin's request for Soldiers, explaining the agreement with Liscor on bringing Soldiers aboveground, and orders Ksmvr to go with Erin and protect her.
Klbkch privately tells Ksmvr that Erin's life is more important than his own and that he will see him deconstructed if she is harmed.
Klbkch objects to being killed by Goblins, saying he feels his reputation is at stake.
Klbkch and Relc offer to carry Erin's bag and ask to visit her inn; Klbkch says he has fully recovered from Gazi's wounds.
Klbkch refers to the deadly forest southeast of Liscor as an area patrols avoid.
Klbkch calls thirty Workers with class levels to rebuild Erin's inn and asks that Antinium be allowed to visit to play chess and learn.
Klbkch and Relc help lift heavy things while Pawn and Bird lead the Workers rebuilding the inn, and Erin thinks of a hive mind.
Klbkch says that if the King of Destruction resumed war the Antinium would act, and the Queens would wait until then.
Klbkch tells Relc not to kill Rags because Erin has been deemed important to the Hive.
Klbkch buried the last Flooded Waters Chief, which Rags respects.
Klbkch tells his Queen he will send five Individuals from three Hives to the inn under guard to learn chess.
Klbkch tells his Queen that Erin and Ryoka are pieces connected with other anomalies found by the Hives.
Klbkch tells Erin that asking a Worker its name was dangerous since most become Aberrations, and that she has the quality that the Antinium seek.
Klbkch fights Revi's phantom axe warrior to save Zevara, then holds two sword blades at Revi's throat and ends the battle.
Klbkch tells his Queen that casualties from the latest incursion from the dungeon were quite severe.
Klbkch plants a map of Albez under a broken board in a buried cellar he oversaw the construction of for nearly a week.
Klbkch tells Olesm that he has regained five of his lost levels.
Klbkch promises to patrol south of Liscor to protect Mrsha and the inn, and says that if the Goblin Lord's army passes near a Hive it will be destroyed.
Klbkch fails to return to his Hive overnight for the first time; his Queen recalls the search parties.
Klbkch tells Selys that he is familiar with the country Ryoka and Erin come from.
Klbkch tells Ryoka that he knows she and Erin come from the same other world and offers her his help.
Klbkch tells Ryoka that the Gnolls of Liscor led by Krshia Silverfang arrived nearly a decade ago to acquire information or objects of value.
Klbkch tells Ryoka about the Antinium's past.
Klbkch and Relc visit the inn looking for Erin, and Klbkch tells Relc that the girl at the door is the thief who burned down Krshia's shop.
Klbkch attempts to kill Pawn for knowing of Gods, hesitates, and spares him when Pawn begs.
Klbkch tells Pawn the Queen will not kill him unless his form or actions endanger the Hive.
Klbkch permits Pawn to pray and care for wounded Soldiers, and tests them for Individuality.
Klbkch orders Workers to bring sacs, and green blood pools around the wounded while Workers apply clear gel.
Klbkch requests that forty Soldiers be allowed on the surface; Zevara grants twenty for patrols.
Klbkch buys a jar of bees for the Queen and eats five; Garry says Klbkch wishes him to cook for other members of the Hive, but the Queen wants him to cook for her alone.
Klbkch is nearly drawn into a fight with Zel Shivertail; Pawn, Zevara's guards and Relc stop it.
Klbkch says he regrets only that he was too weak to finish the battle on Rhir.
Klbkch reports that over fourteen villages have been destroyed by the Goblin Lord and a Drake city took heavy casualties.
Pressed by Krshia about a Dragon near Liscor, Klbkch stays silent, then says he will say nothing on the matter, which the room takes as confirmation.
Klbkch tells the room it is not in his Hive's interest to confirm or deny suspicions, and calls them dust.
Klbkch commits to Xrn's plan and tells her about Erin.
Klbkch has a long splintered gash on one arm and says a situation in the Hive needs all Workers and Soldiers.
Klbkch is later found bleeding from his side among twenty injured Soldiers.
Klbkch orders Pawn not to tell anyone of the Hive's weakness, Erin included.
Klbkch investigates Brunkr's death with Relc, questions the party guests with truth gems, and is told by Relc that the Captain ordered the investigation.
Klbkch asks Regrika Blackpaw whether she met Brunkr after the party; she says no and the gem flashes white.
Klbkch and Pawn rush into the barracks after Twin Stripes' attack on Yellow Splatters.
Klbkch inspects Belgrade's kill zone, studies the Workers' archery unit and says he will relay it to the Queen.
Klbkch leads Antinium against the Necromancer Az'kerash's undead during the defense of Liscor, ordering Soldiers not to injure Drakes.
Klbkch walks out of the grieving inn at Zel's death and goes to the Hive to see the black-glass mirror artifact that connects to the Grand Queen.
Klbkch tells Zevara aberrations arise around an Antinium's name and that Pawn is an Individual.
Klbkch orders Bird not to kill the Hobs just yet.
Klbkch inspects tunnels before the rains, sealing faulty ones, and tells Pawn to assist with the tunnels.
Klbkch criticizes the play at Erin's inn, noting the quality of the actor portraying Claudius.
Klbkch speaks to the City Council about the Raskghar, saying the Hive was not attacked.
Klbkch plans an assault on the dungeon with a thousand Soldiers, expects at least 60% casualties, and has Anand and Belgrade stay behind as Tacticians.
Klbkch tells Anand and Belgrade that he lied to Ksmvr and forbids telling Pawn about casualties.
A treasure-room trap kills forty-one Soldiers before yielding a pair of pink crystalline daggers; Klbkch counts 521 Soldiers left.
The Soldiers nearly kill the Hobs at the Hive entrance until Klbkch stops them; he says Bird's only hope is his Queen.
Klbkch says only Prognugators undergo the Rite.
Klbkch studies a map of Liscor with Belgrade and Anand, and tells Garry he let only Pawn out to scout the inn.
Klbkch schedules Belgrade's Workers to rebuild the third floor and Bird's tower and sends Pawn to meet Lyonette.
Klbkch offers Hive funding of twenty percent of construction costs, discounted Workers and two thousand gold annually for the City Watch and Adventurer's Guild.
Klbkch asks Zevara and Selys to let the Hive expand with the city and for fifty visiting Antinium from other Hives with free passage, and asks to raise the 600 Soldiers.
Klbkch tells the crowd that Pallass' army spilled twenty-eight times more blood than Liscor's army and that Goblins saved the city.
Klbkch brings Rufelt Rxlvn, a black alcohol made by Workers with mushrooms, serpent venom and Shield Spider venom.
Klbkch sets up a test with 438 excess Workers and Soldiers because Belgrade's traps cut losses by nearly 56% and Face Stealer killed 211.

Klbkch tells Anand and Yellow Splatters to fight the monsters with the traps disabled and promises each Antinium they save may be inducted into the Painted Antinium; barely fifty of four hundred remain.
Klbkch monitors Bearclaw with Relc; she testified under truth spell that she had committed no crime in Liscor, and Klbkch confirms she committed murders elsewhere.
Klbkch toasts the Centenium of the True Antinium without rebuking Pawn, Bird or Belgrade.
Klbkch is furious that Painted Antinium went above without his permission.
In the inn Klbkch severs Chesacre's arm with his sword; the Garden of Sanctuary barrier stops his blade at Pawn.
Klbkch tells Pawn and the Painted Antinium they are Aberrations and mistakes who may never return to the Hive.
Klbkch says the Individuals are still being tested, then his voice changes to say that they are failing.
Klbkch crushes the scrying orb and walks to the Hive.
Xrn tells Klbkch he is no longer alone; Armored, Flying and Silent Antinium arrive and Klbkch weeps.
Xrn hugs Anand when he asks to call her aunt.
Klbkch leaves the Hive with Anand, Painted Antinium and Workers carrying acid-flies, Garry-bread and cheese to other Hives; Xrn tells him to visit the Armored or Silent Antinium first.
Klbkch returns to the Hivelands southwest of Liscor with Anand and two hundred Antinium.
Klbkch tells Anand the army is all that is left of a far greater past.
Klbkch is honoured by four Hives, with the Flying, Silent and Armored Antinium saluting and the Grand Queen's Antinium kneeling.
Klbkch duels a Worker-type Sword Prognugator who cuts him once with [Extend Blade], and Anand realises it is a copy of Klbkch.
Klbkch defeats the thirty-plus Sword Prognugators with [Recaptured Sublimity], without any deaths.
The Grand Queen tells Klbkch to destroy the Walled Cities and conquer Izril, planning a third war.
Klbkch tells Anand about Galuc, one of the Centenium, who laughed.
Klbkch shares Rxlvn and pepperoni pizza with Wrymvr and the Twisted Queen.
Klbkch, Wrymvr and the Twisted Queen debate how to cross the sea; Wrymvr says by link that he could kill the Illusionist.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch tells Relc and Erin that all races once fought with tooth, claw and magic and then divided, and that those who forsook their natures received [Leveling] while the rest kept their natures' might.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch tells Erin that the strain of madness in the Antinium has not been eliminated from his generation but is falling by 14% per year.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says the Antinium fled Rhir because they were losing, and that the Antinium Wars were setbacks next to the loss of most of their people at sea.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch tells Ryoka that a God is buried in Rhir and trying to wake, and that even speaking of Gods gives them power.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch knows Teriarch is a Dragon who incinerated two armies in the Second Antinium War, and says he advised against attacking him.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch opposes giving the Antinium weapons knowledge from Erin's world because it could start a third war.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says the other Queens do not think as his does and that other Hives are made from different templates and are not Aberrations.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says that the existence of a God is tied to the Antinium's existence on Rhir, and that his original task as a Centenium concerns Gods and supersedes all other orders.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says he knows of Gods but only dead ones, and treats the subject as a secret.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch argues the Christian God belongs to Humans and not the Antinium.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says his original form was lost when he died at sea while Galuc's form was saved and remains in every Antinium; Galuc was a giant, strong and fearless.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch's own thought notes that the Drakes and Gnolls worked out the Antinium's resurrection ability in the First Antinium War, but not the exact nature of it or the levels lost.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch thinks that it has been long since he left Rhir, that the Centenium are dead, and that he and his Queen were allowed to take nothing of value when founding the experimental Hive.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: In the Second Antinium War, Klbkch and Xrn were the two Prognugators close enough to respond, and marched against a Drake army in a kill zone of [Mages], [Archers] and [Spearmen].

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says seven Queens remained out of what had been hundreds, and that he led the desperate army with Xrn.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch grimly raises two silvery swords in two of his four arms, with two daggers held awkwardly in the others, not used to his new body.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch tells Xrn he lost his form and levels and is no longer at Centenium strength.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch personally rescued the youngest Queen from drowning and she later led the Hive in Liscor.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch charges the Drake lines in the Second Antinium War after Xrn objects, calling them oath breakers.

section: Antinium history as Klbkch tells it
text: Klbkch says Gazi of Reim was dangerous but not the most fearsome Named Adventurer he met during the Antinium Wars.
Klbkch believes the Antinium Queens think peace is strange: "We have only known war, never peace."
In Book 16 Klbkch says the Individuals are wrong, copies and not True Antinium, and that Antinium do not break rules.
Klbkch says Soldiers can break, fleeing a battle or losing cohesion due to fear, unlike True Antinium.
Klbkch tells Relc that the Individuals are all defective, supposed to have been restored and reconnected.
Klbkch believes he is ageing and tires more, mentioning Xrn and the Grand Queen.
Klbkch believes Pawn's Painted Antinium are a separate force within the Hive.
Relc says adventurers cause trouble and he hates them; Klbkch adds that their commerce is real but their negative effects cannot be discounted.
Klbkch thinks his Queen is a captive, and he knows he is one.
Grev claims that Klbkch said it was not likely that Dragons are around Liscor but never said there were none.
Rufelt regards Klbkch as a legend and a nightmare for anyone who lived in a Walled City and remembers the Antinium Wars.
Anand thinks that Klbkch was the 4th best guard in the Watch despite his Worker's body.
Xrn says Klbkch is flawed beyond belief because Klbkch the Slayer is incomplete: he is more than a weapon but a poor leader.
Xrn says Klbkch was meant to slaughter foes and pile bodies into walls around Hives, but has learned some leadership and some empathy from Erin.
Klbkch keeps secret from his Queen that Erin is among the best chess players from her world.
Klbkch tells Ryoka his Queen does not know she and Erin come from another world; he will lie to her.
Klbkch tells Olesm he was once stronger and has regained five lost levels, but cannot tell him how.
Klbkch tells Ryoka his levels, his Level 30 and 40 skills and his death by General Sserys.
Klbkch's tertiary classes, including [Diplomat], are unknown to anyone, even his Queen.
Klbkch lets a Dragon's existence near Liscor be confirmed by his silence.
Klbkch tells Pawn the existence of a God relates to his original Centenium task.
Klbkch tells Anand and Belgrade he lied to Ksmvr.
Klbkch tells Zevara a lie that Antinium numbers are slightly below six hundred.
Knight is an Antinium Worker who names himself, and who looks and sounds like Pawn but seems different to Erin.
Knight is one of Erin's chess-club Workers, who all choose names that night and come to protect her inn.
Knight kneels to Erin, declares that he has named himself and chosen to be an individual, and says he is there to protect her.
Knight says Pawn was kept in the Hive by the Prognugator and remains there.
The Workers around the inn name themselves Bishop, Vladimir, Calabrian, Emanuel, Garry, Milner-Barry, Belgrade and Jose, and Erin realizes they are her chess club.
The Worker Magnus bears a name taken from the World Chess Champion Magnus Carlsen, and Garry is named after the Grandmaster Garry Kasparov.

After a deranged Worker who speaks in mixed upper and lower case, claims to be individual yet rejects everything and blames Erin, attacks her with a sword, another Worker throws him off and breaks his neck, and that Worker is Knight.
Knight uses [Defense Formation] and the Worker Magnus uses [Attack Formation], and Erin feels the effects of both Skills, feeling lighter and aware of everything around her.
Knight tells Erin that thirty-four undead have been killed and that the rest have retreated and will return in greater numbers.
Knight tells Erin that a horde of the undead emerged from the Ruins and besieged Liscor about an hour earlier.

Knight tells Erin that several adventurers reached the city alive, that none of them were Minotaurs or elves, and that the only survivors were humans, including a captain who is a woman in silver armor.
The Worker Calabrian reports that over four hundred undead have attacked Liscor and that the Watch is fighting them in the streets.
Knight reflects that the [Tactician] class levels with chess but that chess does not teach fighting or account for unpredictability.
Knight orders the Workers to close ranks into a wall around the inn, tells Erin to stay inside, closes the door and puts his back to it.
Knight dies standing in front of the inn's door, stabbed and bitten by the undead while trying to cover it, after asking Garry if Erin is still safe.
Knight's last wish is to play one more game of chess with Erin, opening with the Danish Opening.
Only Erin notices the moment Knight dies.
Krshia is a female Gnoll [Shopkeeper] who sells goods on Market Street in Liscor and introduces herself to Erin Solstice as a shopkeeper and seller of goods.
Krshia leads the Silverfang Tribe in Liscor and is one of the leaders of the city's Gnolls; Tkrn, a junior [Guardsman], is under her unofficial command.
Krshia becomes a [Royal Shopkeeper], a class she thinks she may be the first Gnoll in history to have, thanks to Lyonette.
Krshia later wins a seat on Liscor's Council, a huge change that she had not imagined a year earlier.

Krshia forgives Erin's apology, notes that Erin stinks of burned ash and trash, and smells blood and oil on her from the fight that Erin won; she then calls Erin the human who slew the Goblin Chieftain.
Krshia says Lism, the shopkeeper across from her, did not tell Erin that the bag of flour was too heavy to carry and gave it to her on purpose rather than arranging delivery.
Krshia is shedding when Erin asks about menstruation, and says Gnolls are forbidden to howl unless there is a full moon.
Krshia says Gnolls do not have periods, but those still able to bear children go into heat, called estrus, only once or twice a year, which is when they mate.
Krshia says Gnolls need no padding, that Drakes and Antinium need none either, and that she would not expect any padding to exist in a store since humans are rare in Liscor.

Krshia does not blame Erin for the death of Klbkch, saying it is a bad sign for the city because he was strong and trouble will follow without him; she says she and other Gnolls think it wrong to blame the human for where he chose to fight.

Krshia is big even for a Gnoll, and she faces down a Drake guardsman who is investigating Erin on Lism's word, calling Lism a talker and liar and demanding the guardsman find Erin and ask her instead.
Krshia invites Erin to her home for food and drink so they can speak privately.
Krshia serves Erin a bowl of raw chopped meat that she calls scurry-food, and Erin finds it good.
Krshia holds the skill [Spot Deception], a [Merchant] and [Shopkeeper] skill, and it tells her that Erin's claims about her home world are true.

Krshia swears by her tribe and the open sky and earth never to betray Erin's secrets, and says her kin must be told and that by the Gnolls' gravest oath Erin's secret will be spoken to none who are not Gnollkind.
Krshia faints dead away when Erin explains what a billion is, after Erin has explained a million as a thousand thousands.

Krshia says she has never heard of anyone crossing from other worlds by a spell, and suggests a truly great [Mage] might have used a teleport spell by accident; she says that only an [Archmage] could cast a spell to send Erin back, if it can be done.

Krshia tells Erin that a journey north in a caravan that hires adventurers, then a ship to Wistram, would be costly, and that for sixty pieces she could perhaps bring Erin to Wistram, with a hundred gold pieces lasting several years there; the real price, she says, is the mage.
Krshia tells Erin that the Gnolls of Liscor have desires she might help with, and that if her tribe disagrees she would help Erin not as one seeking a bargain but as a friend.

Krshia orders Tkrn to have a Runner (Lv or Tshana) send a message to the tribes asking for more Gnolls and wise ones, and to ask whether others like Erin have been found; Tkrn says all such people found so far were long dead, and Krshia says that is why Erin must not die.
Krshia tells Tkrn that the Gnolls need Erin more than she needs them and do not want her speaking with others who would know her value.

Krshia refuses to post guards around Erin's inn because others would notice and ask questions and the Gnolls have few warriors in the city, and says the Gnolls will instead give Erin fangs to protect herself.
Krshia is one of the more influential and vocal shopkeepers in a conclave of angry Gnoll and Drake merchants on Market Street after the Goblin attack, and tells Erin her pillows must wait.
Krshia is the shopkeeper Erin finds easiest to use for all her supplies, since she directs Erin to the right shopkeepers.
Krshia says her Runner is overworked and cannot deliver Erin's order until tomorrow, and says Street Runners use carts for heavy deliveries unlike City Runners.
Krshia leads Gnoll archers, including Tkrn and six others, hidden in the grass in the rain, watching Ksmvr and his Soldiers confront Erin; she tells them it was well that they did not intervene.
Krshia mocks Tkrn, the most junior and inexperienced of the Gnolls, in front of the others for suggesting that Ksmvr meant to kill Erin.
Krshia reasons that Ksmvr would already have stabbed Erin if he wanted her dead, that someone else wants Erin, and that three different sides came for her tonight, excluding the foolish Drake.
Krshia shoots a zombie through the eye with an arrow, then draws a long dagger and grabs a second zombie, when fifteen or so civilian archers freeze during the zombie attack.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia has cast iron frying pans for sale, and during the crisis she offers Erin healing potions to be paid for later.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says several of her tribe are coming down the southern road and will be in Liscor that day, all warriors who will help find Erin's humans.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Ryoka tells Krshia that a group of Gnolls on the south road are dead, found around forty miles from the city and cut apart by something; Krshia goes completely still and her claws seem to lengthen.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia unwraps a bow and huge broadhead arrows, strings the bow in her shop and howls, and other Gnolls around the city answer her howl.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia leads a group of fifteen shopkeepers, artisans and even a tavern owner who run at Gazi with massive bows, and Gazi addresses her as Krshia Silverfang.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia aims an arrow at Gazi's eyes and tells her it is blood for blood because Gazi slaughtered Gnoll kin.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia picks out furs and warm clothing for Erin and sends her off to change.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia still has everything Erin needs in stock but says food now costs half again as much, and she can no longer deliver because her Street Runner is busy with deliveries after the undead attack and cannot reach the inn through the snow without charging more.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says the guardsman Relc came to her quite drunk the previous day talking about Erin's inn exploding and being rebuilt in a day, and that she would have gone to look for Erin if she had not come.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says she remembers her first Drake partner, which was odd but exciting, and that of humans it was disappointing the one time she tried; she has compared Drakes and Gnolls and prefers her own kind.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia accepts a bet of fifteen copper from Selys, who wagers that Erin will take a Drake first, saying she has a good young Gnoll in mind for Erin.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia salvages only a fragment of the twenty three spellbooks, the collection of the Silverfang Tribe over many years, hidden in the back of her stall when a fireball destroys it.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia fears she must face her sister, the Chieftain, because the spellbooks were meant for a gathering that would make her tribe famous and give Gnolls the power to cast spells.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia tells Erin that the child thief is her enemy and has done more harm to her tribe than any other, and that harbouring her will break the bonds between them.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia's formerly large central shop on Market Street has become a small stand with few items, and she is no longer smiling with customers; she snaps at Brunkr and says she is still the leader there and he defies the Chieftain if he goes against her.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says that if Zel Shivertail is leading, the Gnolls in his army will have howled warnings and the tribes will not be caught easily by the Goblin army.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia confirms to Erin's companion that her tribe hoped Erin, being from another world, would give them something useful, and that they offered much in exchange hoping for more.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia answers "Yes" when asked whether Mrsha will be safe, though the narrator notes a flicker of hesitation.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Klbkch tells Erin that the Gnolls in Liscor are led by Krshia Silverfang, who arrived nearly a decade ago ostensibly to facilitate trade but in truth to acquire information or valuables to raise the Silverfang tribe's standing at the decennial gathering of tribes.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia sells small sleds to the citizens, after Mrsha is given a smaller sled than the big sledge.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia explains that each tribe works to bring something of value to the gathering every decade, that her tribe received a Dwarven-made set of arms at the last gathering, and that the tribe that collected arms for every tribe rose in standing.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says the leveling secret Erin and Klbkch found is too cheap for a work of ten years, because they uncovered it in days and her Chieftain could not raise her head high with it.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia worries that if gaining higher levels requires a single class, Gnolls would have to choose classes while barely more than cubs and never change them, which would trouble tribes whose members all contribute in many roles.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia replies by message to Ryoka that the Gnolls will await the delivery and the others will abide until then.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says she thinks the Stone Spears tribe's fate is just superstition, that they were doomed the instant a Goblin Lord led his army upon them, though other, more foolish Gnolls will say differently about Mrsha.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia vows to Klbkch that no Gnoll will slay another Gnoll while she lives, in answer to his question whether Mrsha is safe from attack.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says she awaits Ryoka Griffin, who has promised her something, and that she and the Gnolls who listen to her are antsy until it arrives; she also has a smaller shop to run and a worthless nephew to look after.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia has begun selling directly to Lyonette and visits Mrsha at the inn to talk with her and teach her a little, though she says little to Lyonette and none of the other Gnolls will go near Mrsha.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Among Ryoka's messages at the Mage's Guild, several from Krshia ask when she will return, one saying there is unrest and asking whether she has what is needed; Ryoka thinks of the book of spells in her bag of holding.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia tells Erin that Liscor's Council is made up of important people including the head of the Adventurer's Guild, the foremost [Mage], the Watch Captain Zevara, the head of the Merchant's Guild and Olesm as chief [Tactician], and that Liscor's army is a mercenary one that rarely returns to the city.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says Zel Shivertail allowed Lyonette back into the city and that the Gnolls will do nothing to her while the Council is against them.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia sits down with Octavia to sell her potions, asks her level, and argues that as a high-level [Shopkeeper] with many levels she deserves a better cut than Octavia's opening offer of fifty percent.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Ryoka recalls that Krshia's clan lives in Liscor to earn money and gain something valuable to offer the tribes when they meet, and that its stockpile of spellbooks, worth tens of thousands of gold, was lost when Lyonette used a powerful artifact to destroy Krshia's shop by accident; Ryoka promised something of equal value in return for Lyonette's life.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia receives Ryoka in her apartment with Brunkr and a crowd of Gnolls and asks whether Ryoka has brought what was promised.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia orders that the knowledge of the book never leave the room and that it be guarded this time by [Warriors].

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says shopkeepers learn to tell magical writing, which changes from other angles, from an ordinary written language, to identify fraud; she cannot read the book, believes no one living knows its language, and demands a pair of lenses enchanted with a translation spell.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia shoots a recurve bow herself and takes Erin to a [Bowyer] of her tribe, who sells a yew recurve bow for twenty six gold coins.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia explains that the yew bow is worth hundreds, around four hundred gold coins if shipped far north, and that the bowyer's price is a favor honoring a debt owed to Ryoka, who did Krshia's tribe a favor beyond worth.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia says that Erin Solstice and Ryoka Griffin are of the same tribe.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia hosts Ryoka with Brunkr in her apartment, insists she eat and not leave without hospitality, and proposes celebrating Brunkr's new class with a feast at Erin's inn.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia and her nephew Brunkr celebrate Brunkr's new class with a group of Gnolls at the inn, and Erin serves a cake with the class [Knight] written on it in pink icing.

section: Mrsha, the Council and the Silverfangs (Books 2-5)
text: Krshia tells Erin, in tears, that her nephew Brunkr is dead, found at the bottom of the crevasse in the dungeon with eight others of a Silver-rank Gnoll team, torn apart by some kind of monster.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia forgives Ryoka and calls her a friend to Gnolls, saying that what Ryoka gave is worth more than many Gnoll lives, but asks not to see her for a while because Brunkr was her nephew, whom she helped raise.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia grieves for Brunkr and is absent from her stall; when Olesm calls on her she is barely dressed with disheveled fur, her apartment is a mess, and Brunkr's shield and sword stand propped against a wall.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia is back at a smaller stall at the edge of the market, far smaller than her old one, selling ointments and doing other customers' shopping by talking to the sellers and having it sent on; she tells Erin and Lyonette that six gold covers Erin's long list, the custom pottery being costly.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia says Ishkr, a distant nephew, told her of Erin's understanding with the Goblins, and that many [Guardsmen] on the walls heard the music from the inn.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia tells Erin that the city and the continent still remember the Goblin King, so others will not come to the inn and she will not visit for now, though she says she will trust Erin.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia tells Lyonette that she knows Lyonette is a [Princess] and that she gave her blessing to make Brunkr a [Knight], having learned it because Brunkr was not good at keeping secrets; she thanks Lyonette, says she does not seek to profit from the knowledge, and forgives her.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia says Brunkr's shield and sword remain in her apartment but little else of him, and that she has only memories of him.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia says that Regrika Blackpaw is no true Gnoll and will be hunted, and wonders whether Brunkr would be alive had she questioned instead of being blind to Regrika's nature.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia reads a Drake historian's account of the Antinium Wars and, enraged, says Gnolls did fight, her tribe among them, and that she has seen more accurate histories on shopping lists.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Mrsha has noticed that Krshia's apartment is always watched by Gnoll guards, supposedly housewives and mothers, who are skilled enough to hit a burglar's eye with an arrow at fifty paces; Krshia thinks Mrsha cannot smell them.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Mrsha finds under Krshia's bed, in false floorboards, a large chest that fills the room with poison unless two keys are used in the right order, holding a huge spellbook that the Silverfang Tribe plans to offer at the Meeting of the Tribes.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia has anyone with a bow in the city centre, and Gnolls on the rooftops shoot moths entering the city, though a report says they cannot do more than protect their own area.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia, who has run a street stall instead of a shop, has earned her living in the open street for ten years, and laughs at Pawn's story of how he hurt Lyonette, which makes her remember her tribe and her sister the chieftain, and says she knows Lyonette is a [Princess], explaining that Gnolls hear much.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia is called to a bowyer's shop when Bird arrives asking for a bird-bow; she tells him how much he must save, and after Bird empties out a bag of gold from his Queen, Bird later returns to the inn with a reflexed composite bow, saying Krshia said it was a very good deal.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia asks Klbkch when Gnolls will have a place on the stage at Erin's theatre, saying many are pestering her to introduce them to Erin.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia recalls the old legends that the Raskghar traded their ability to level for strength and savagery and regain their intelligence only when the moon shines.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia tells Olesm during the Raskghar attack that it is not yet the full moon, which is close, and that both moons will wax and wane over the next six days.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: As a [Royal Shopkeeper], Krshia gains the Skill [Imperial Appraiser], which replaces her [Quality Scent] Skill, and soon after the Skill [Silvertouched Wares], which gives every purchase she makes about a silver coin's extra value without activation.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia had not leveled as a [Shopkeeper] for over a year until her shop exploded and left her practically destitute, and the struggle that followed raised her levels again; she says she would rather not have lost her coin and the spellbooks for a few levels.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia eats silkap, a traditional Gnoll dish of pork fat paste with spices, milk and onions, for breakfast, and she keeps Brunkr's bandages in her living room, where she catches a faint scent of her deceased nephew.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia persuades the Gnolls of Liscor gathered in Elirr's shop to stay and fight rather than flee, reciting the history of the Gnolls and the Waning World, the words she once spoke to her sister the chieftain on the day she decided to leave for Liscor.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia tells the Gnolls that the Silverfang tribe came to Liscor ten years ago and has laboured to build a place there, and answers Fashia Splitfur by proposing to hide the spellbook in a bag of holding and tell the other tribes where it can be claimed if Liscor falls.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Mrsha senses that Krshia was not always a [Shopkeeper].

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia says she was apprenticed to be a [Shaman] once and guides the spell [Everdawn's Radiance], a Tier 1 spell of courage and hope that she tells a Drake [Guardswoman] is low enough for even a former apprentice to cast.

section: Moths, Royal Shopkeeper and the Meeting of Tribes (Books 5-10)
text: Krshia says she has a new Skill that allows her to select goods of the highest quality, and expects to win bids for the best meat over Lism.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia tells Erin that the grand Meeting of Tribes is soon, that she must be there, and that she may ask Mrsha to come, saying Mrsha may be important and that the fate of the Stone Spears tribe must be discussed.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia invites Erin to come south across the Gnoll plains with her as guide, saying humans are not barred from Gnoll lands and Erin could be on the outside of the grand meeting.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia tells Selys that she is a highly placed member of the Silverfang Tribe, still a Plains Gnoll at heart, and that she came to Liscor with some of her tribe to build ties and prepare a gift for the Meeting of Tribes, which she says is held every twenty years and sometimes missed.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia proposes to Selys that Liscor be expanded and that a small fee be charged on dungeon entry, a list be made of monster parts adventurers leave behind so a request system can be formed, rents be capped, Antinium be asked to build cheaply in return for concessions for their Hive, and the bounty on Goblins be ended.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia wants to be the first Gnoll on Liscor's Council, which has never included a Gnoll and picks its own replacements every few years; she says Liscor needs a vote and that she would ask to be elected.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia identifies Klbkch as the person with gold to spare whom Zevara has in mind, and Zevara asks for a day or two before approaching him, warning that the army and Council might interfere.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia, Zevara and Selys agree to work together on forcing an election for the Council.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia addresses a crowd, the third that morning, arguing that the Council does nothing, that Zevara did all the work against the Raskghar and the siege, that rent has doubled in some parts of the city, and that the city should elect its Council, with Gnolls among the candidates.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia promises that, if elected, she would tax adventurers entering the dungeon to expand the Adventurer's Guild, fund the City Watch, and ease the rent by expanding Liscor's walls with the help of the Antinium.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia claims from records that Liscor was built up and its walls expanded twice before reaching their present size, that Liscor held many smaller villages before the Second Antinium Wars, and that the enchanted walls are just stone that can be built again.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Lism Swifttail heckles Krshia's speech, saying Gnolls have lived in Liscor only about a decade and accusing her of a power grab; the two are long-standing feuding rivals who are the top salespeople on Market Street.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia notices Mrsha and a human at the back of the crowd and grins at Mrsha.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia, Selys and Zevara propose a Council election with one Council member per district to Klbkch, who asks whether Krshia would win in her area.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Selys says Krshia is very popular among Gnolls and that nearly one Gnoll lives for every three Drakes where she lives, a higher share than in most other districts.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Lism lives in the same district as Krshia, which makes him her opponent, and he tells the crowd not to vote for a tool of the Antinium.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia campaigns with the candidates Raekea, one of the finest smiths and best [Armorer]s in the city, Elirr, a beloved [Beast Trainer], and Senior Guardswoman Beilmark, a veteran trusted by all, and says she has four more candidates, one for each district.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia and Zevara argue over Calruz until Zevara is coughing smoke, and Krshia barely agrees not to call for Calruz's death in her campaign; Erin later says Krshia told her in private she would let Calruz live if elected.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia sells ingredients to Palt at a market stall in Liscor for four silver and three coppers.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia is a [Royal Shopkeeper] and drinks with Elirr in his pet shop at the end of the month of Rerrk, saying the time of the Meeting of Tribes is upon them, which was last held ten years ago.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia tells Elirr that Gnolls must move as one to deliberate over Erin Solstice and Ryoka Griffin, and that Mrsha must come to the Meeting of Tribes, to be looked after by the whole Silverfang tribe, though Elirr fears for her safety.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia points out that it would not do for Liscor to start a conflict with a human city, so Liscor and Pallass do not join Erin's quarrel with Celum, which shows she is taking her new position seriously.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Erin's friends tell her that Krshia told them she does not think Erin has masturbated for months, and refer to dildos that Krshia keeps giving Erin.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia still works her day job as a shopkeeper while attending regular Council meetings.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia tells Lyonette that they are tribe-sisters with no debts between them, citing the debt Ryoka paid, the class Lyonette gave her, Brunkr's wish granted, the [Farmer] Wailant Strongheart, Octavia and the Gnolls learning to be [Actors].

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia undoes the traps and locks on her hidden chest and brings out the spellbook for Lyonette, who learns a spell from it that she says is Tier 3; Krshia calls the book a gift unmatched, Ryoka Griffin's secret, and says the Gnolls will thank the one called Teriarch.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia, a [Councilwoman], is petitioned in the street by people who come to ask her for this or that.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia and Elirr, both of the Silverfang Tribe, plan their trip to the Meeting of Tribes over breakfast; Krshia is more a Plains Gnoll than Elirr, and the door from Pallass has saved them over a month of travel across four hundred miles.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia must reach the Meeting of Tribes by the summer solstice, and Vrrow, a Silverfang [Longstrider Scout], has come to make sure everything is ready.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia and Elirr discuss how the Woven Bladegrass tribe sacked a city for the Meeting of Tribes; Krshia plans for Mrsha to join them for only part of the meeting, since her sister the chieftain knows and Krshia wants Mrsha kept secret from the other tribes, as the Silverfangs bring magic in two forms.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia kisses Lism as the sun sets, after he says he is dreaming of a better Liscor; the two are both Councilmembers.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Lism wakes with Krshia beside him in his apartment when protestors gather outside, and they realize they must not be seen leaving it together.

section: Meeting of Tribes preparations and the Council campaign (Books 10-19)
text: Krshia pours a scent-destroying potion over herself and Lism, tells him to wear unwashed old clothes, and leaves by a pre-programmed teleport scroll, having said she would meet him at City Hall for the Hectval delegation and asks Lism for something of Alonna's or another female Drake's to rub on his clothing.
Krsysl Wordsmith is the [Writer] who authored "The Second Antinium Wars, a History".
Krsysl began writing the book six months after the Second Antinium Wars ended.
Krsysl wrote the book because no other history of the war existed and he wanted a record before living memory faded.
Krsysl openly admits the book may contain inaccuracies and bias, and he wants to be remembered as the first [Writer] to collate the war's accounts.
Krsysl dismisses his critics as lesser writers and claims his account is colored only by love of people and continent.
The book was widely sold across Izril and widely criticized, and later editions added the Introduction and substantive revisions.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl writes that the Walled Cities predate the construction of First Landing by at least six thousand years.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl speculates that the Necromancer's siege of Liscor, which cut the continent in two, may have aided the Goblin King.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl praises Drake courage and claims a single Drake [Spearman] stopped a charging Draugr that Gold-rank adventurers might struggle with.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Tekshia scoffs at the Draugr claim, saying Draugr run down a spear and gut the wielder, and she mocks the claim that Drakes fought off wraiths with swords.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl calls Niers Astoragon a coward for refusing to fight the Goblin King, claiming his spine was weaker than a low-level Drake [Soldier]'s.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl writes that all non-Drake heroes appear to have a fatal flaw, which shapes how he judges Niers.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Niers says he knew any battle with Velan would be disastrous because his army was dispirited and lacked unity.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Niers Astoragon never answered Krsysl's letters, and the book leaves that part of history blank.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Niers Astoragon had told Krsysl not to print the passage and curses him as a clod-footed village-smasher after reading it.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Xrn says Krsysl exaggerates and twists facts to suit his narrative but does not invent false events.

section: Views and style in the book
text: Krsysl credits Elia Arcsinger, a Silver-rank half-Elf adventurer, with killing the Goblin King Velan with a single arrow and thanks her for her steady aim.
Magnolia Reinhart paid Krsysl to write the history of the First Antinium Wars shortly after it ended, and it was widely praised.
Magnolia Reinhart refuses to put her name on the second history and says she did not fund it.
Krsysl invested the money from his first book into the second, which he wrote as a patriot hoping to be beloved.
Magnolia says fame went to Krsysl's head and that the second book earned him criticism from his own people.
Many Drakes still consider Krsysl a good writer, according to Magnolia Reinhart.
Magnolia says she tried to persuade Krsysl to write a more unbiased history, but he detests her.

Ksmvr is an Antinium, named at the end of the Queen's orders in Book 1 as her new Prognugator, who walks to the surface with twin swords at his waist to deal with the Council and investigate the aberration.
Ksmvr looks exactly like Klbkch in every small detail and has Klbkch's voice, but he is slimmer than the Workers, with four arms, large multifaceted eyes and a slightly darker carapace.
Ksmvr introduces himself to Erin as "not Klbkch", of the Antinium of Liscor, and serves his Queen as Prognugator.
Ksmvr carries two swords and two daggers.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr states that Antinium who refer to themselves as individuals or have names are prone to fits of violence, and that his role is to judge such individuals and terminate them.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr takes Pawn into custody, cutting off Pawn's antenna when he speaks, and tells Erin that interfering with his duties is a crime.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: When Erin refuses to stand aside, Ksmvr strikes her hard enough that she sees stars, and decapitates Toren when the skeleton attacks him.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr says the Hive within Liscor has been in disarray and that his appointment was out of necessity.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr waits on a hilltop outside Liscor with four Soldiers, since pacts forbid the Soldiers above ground inside Liscor except in emergency or war.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr privately believes his Queen was wrong to appraise Erin as insignificant, thinking her important and perhaps unique.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr calls himself Prognugator of the Free Antinium of Liscor, and the narration says he became Prognugator before his training was done.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr decides not to capture Erin because Gazi the Omniscient and Relc make the cost too high, and has no idea what to do for the first time in his short life.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: In Liscor's battle against the undead, Ksmvr brings fifteen Soldiers and tells Zevara that the Watch Captain may command at most fifty Soldiers and a hundred Workers in a crisis declared by the Council.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr tells Zevara that his position will cease in a few hours and another will take his place.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr pulls the Soldiers back to guard the Hive, telling Zevara that Liscor may fall but the Hive shall never be taken.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr reasons that the Queen's safety during the Rite of Anastases outranks the Bargain with Liscor.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr is knocked down by a punch, feels his Queen's anger as she completes the Rite, and a figure stands over him.

section: Book 1: Prognugator of the Free Antinium
text: Ksmvr kneels trembling before his wroth Queen.
Ksmvr announces during the fight against Gazi that her armor is impenetrable, and all four of his swords clash harmlessly against it.
Klbkch says the new one, Ksmvr, struggles to take up his mantle, and that he himself has rectified Ksmvr's thinking because a Prognugator is needed in the Hive.
Ksmvr is a new Prognugator, inexperienced, in disgrace with his Queen, and trying to fill a position once held by Klbkch.
Ksmvr arrives at Erin's inn wounded, bleeding green, his lower right arm a jagged stump patched with grey goo.
Ksmvr tells Erin that he is no longer required to fulfil his duties as Prognugator, that Revalantor Klbkch will fill them, and that he failed to hold the line.
Ksmvr's two swords and daggers are missing, leaving him looking naked and smaller.
Ksmvr says his Queen will begin negotiations to excavate the ruins, whose entrance is guarded by many monsters.
Erin suggests that Ksmvr join Ceria's party as a fighter after he was kicked out of his Hive for a while.
Ksmvr says he is considered equal to a Silver-rank adventurer within his Hive, has no Skills, and is competent with every common bow type.
Erin lends Ksmvr a knife, and he fights Goblins with two swords and a shield in his third hand.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Klbkch tells the Queen he will start the next part of the plan regarding Ksmvr, whom she calls young and thinks does not wonder or suspect anything, while Klbkch privately thinks him untested and experimental.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr takes the shortsword and the claw necklace, which resists improperly prepared foodstuffs, hoping it will let him eat dairy products.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr eats cheese sandwiches after getting past his allergy to gluten, and fights with a shortbow, arrows, one of Erin's kitchen knives and the enchanted iron shortsword.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Under a spell that makes him insane, Ksmvr's innate Antinium resistance to mental trickery lets part of him fight back; he later says that true insanity would have made him an Aberration who would have killed them all.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: While mad, Ksmvr ties a strip cut from Ceria's pants around her eyes as a blindfold, then rips chitin from his own side.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr's insecurities under the spell tell him he was not worthy of being a Prognugator, that Klbkch is superior in every way and that his Queen was right to exile him.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr asks to observe an act of chastisement so that he can learn to do it in a command situation, and asks permission to throw things.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Arrows hit Ksmvr from the city wall, and Yvlon throws herself in front of him with the remnant of her plate armor.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: A cheering crowd moves Pisces, Yvlon and Ksmvr, who waves with his three hands at humans seeing a new kind of adventurer.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr tells Ressa that he is fairly confident he can kill or maim her if she insists on taking Ryoka, and asks if they are not intending to kill her.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr is the first to teleport from the door to the stone-holder, appearing with a pop in front of the door.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr tells Pisces he is exiled from his Hive and acknowledges that he was removed from his position due to incompetence, but says his true place and his Queen are in Liscor.

section: Book 2 to 4: the Horns of Hammerad
text: Ksmvr addresses Ceria as "Captain" and asks Erin whether the inn has a stable.
Ksmvr stands in line for the Horns behind Zel and Klbkch, flinching at the Revalantor of the Free Antinium.
Ksmvr gives Yvlon the buckler, insisting it is only logical to concentrate strength in the member who fights sword and shield, and Ceria then gives him the [Barkskin] ring and the Ring of Jumping.
Ksmvr objects to the ban on raising undead, saying animating a fallen teammate's corpse is the only sound tactical decision and that he would be insulted if the [Necromancer] did not use his body.
Ksmvr says he is a Level 16 [Warrior], was Level 12 when they first met, and that Antinium do not level except Individuals; he begs not to be ejected from the group.
In Book 6, Ksmvr stops a fight between Yellow Splatters and another Soldier with his shortsword and shortbow, explaining that as a former Prognugator he has no authority.
Ksmvr spars with Yvlon wearing the Ring of Jumping and leaps into the air, then says "I have died again".

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr states that Antinium policy is to eat their foes or their own dead on the march so that they travel with a reduced burden.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr shakes and whispers about the water at Erin's flooded inn, because Antinium cannot swim.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: After the battle at the inn, Ceria, Yvlon and Ksmvr all raise their hands to show that they leveled.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr is lowered by Yvlon and Pisces into the water to train, saying he disgraced himself by not joining the other adventurers in fighting underwater.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Pawn sees Ksmvr, the once-Prognugator of Liscor's Hive, in the rainy street, and Ksmvr says he will cross the bridge to prove he is unafraid of water.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr runs backwards waving his three hands while an enchanted shrieking ball draws the Shield Spiders.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr has agreed with Ceria, Pisces and Yvlon to the plan of leaking news of the dungeon, assuring Ceria for the eighteenth time that he is not betraying his Hive.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr panics when Ceria removes his blindfold at the water, even wearing a Ring of Waterbreathing.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr goes into the Hive and challenges Revalantor Klbkch for the position of Revalantor, which Klbkch says is not decided by challenge.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Klbkch tells Ksmvr he was expelled from the Hive for incompetence and is not of the Free Antinium, but Ksmvr steadies himself with the thought of being a Horn of Hammerad.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr uses a Skill, [Quick Slash], gained after the Face-Eater Moth attack, against Klbkch.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr writes a resignation letter after failing the team twice, says he was dumped outside the Hive and recovered from blood loss, and rejoins the Horns when Yvlon persuades him.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr holds the Ring of Barkskin and offers to lend it to Ceria.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr uses the Ring of Jumping to catch a fly ball in a game.

section: Books 7 to 10: water, Calruz and Klbkch
text: Ksmvr kept rations from the last expedition, which have rotted over nine days.
Ksmvr says he is the lowest leveled of the team by far and has not hit Level 20.
Ksmvr is a Level 18 [Warrior], having shot up from his initial Level 12 when he first joined the team.
Ksmvr was created in secret by his Queen as a replacement Prognugator in case of Klbkch's injury.
Ksmvr says the two-year average lifespan of Workers is not a biological clock but a byproduct of high mortality, and that his body will not deteriorate with age for at least a decade.
Ksmvr tells a Watch Captain in the guild that he does nothing wrong and so any attempt to arrest him would be met in self-defense.
Ksmvr claims to be a Prognugator of the Free Antinium whose arrest or death would mean war with all five Hives.
Ceria knows Ksmvr is lying: Klbkch had cast him out and taken his spot as Prognugator.
Ksmvr puts on his gear piece by piece, finds that wearing the Ring of Waterbreathing and the food-poisoning necklace together produces vibration, and sets the necklace aside.
Ksmvr tries to rent a horse from a stable whose [Horse Handler] first reaches for his dagger.

Ksmvr recalls that he was created in secret to be a Prognugator should Klbkch fall, at great cost and without the Grand Queen's authority, because she did not want unique Antinium to come from the Free Hive.
Ksmvr tears out the throat of a [Bandit Leader], shoots a plate-armored woman with a [Shatterbolt] ring, and ignites a hide shield with the Flamecoat Dagger's word "Terith".
Ksmvr's Forceshield buckler projects a huge weightless shield, and his Ring of Barkskin stops a magic sword cutting deep into his carapace.
With the Ring of Jumping, Ksmvr leaps ten feet in the air and kills mounted bandits.
At nightfall, Ksmvr uses the dark and the cave against the bandits, and delivers twenty-nine heads from the bag of holding, besides the leader's.
Ksmvr collects the hundred-gold bounty at the guild, lists his team as the Horns of Hammerad, and falls asleep.
Ksmvr reaches Level 20 and obtains the [Skirmisher] class.
Yvlon's team includes Ksmvr, a three-armed Antinium exiled from Liscor's Hive.
Ksmvr is a newly leveled [Skirmisher] at Level 20 with [Quick Movement] and [Quick Slash], and owns a Forceshield and Ring of Jumping.
Ksmvr is almost four years old, and fights using [Quick Movement], a Forceshield Buckler and a Flamecoat Dagger.
Ksmvr is the only one who knows of Yvlon's infection.
Hidden behind the bar with Crossbow Stan's bag of holding, Ksmvr fires crossbow bolts at Ulinde, Isceil and Montressa, whose barriers block some.
The Wistram mages take Ceria, Yvlon and Ksmvr, leaving Alais to wake alone.
Ksmvr knows of the Kilavian mountain goats used for siege riding, from studying Kilavian warfare.
Ksmvr falls from the sky onto an adult Creler's head wound and drives a sword into its brain.
Ksmvr asks to purchase Crossbow Stan's bag of holding and crossbows at market price.
Ksmvr says he has gained only two Skills, one of them the practical [Surefoot].
Ksmvr says that the King of Jecrass will probably die within five minutes of combat with the King of Destruction, and Yvlon agrees.
Ksmvr tells the wagon that Ceria is engaged to Master Hedault because he heard Captain Jelaqua congratulate her; Ceria denies it.
Ksmvr thanks Lord Byres for a tree.
Ksmvr owns a tree, the one Antinium landowner the world has known, and returns two of the eggs from the bird's nest in it, saying he should not eat his tenants.
Lacel the Leaper is a lanky Courier who runs nearly as fast as a horse but has more endurance Skills than mobility.
Lacel carries Lady Hetessana's pendant, which has a ten-thousand-gold bounty set by Lord Bein through unofficial channels.
Lacel is attacked on the trade road by eighteen [Raiders], and escapes by turning into six illusionary figures that race in different directions.
Lacel jumps straight up into the air thirty feet to the top of a hill and leaps again, fleeing the [Raid Leader].
Lacel has two [Thieves] try for his bag of holding the day he reaches an inn where Griffon Hunt and the Players of Celum are celebrating.
A disguised [Assassin] of the Assassin's Guild drugs Lacel and tells him it is a message that Magnolia Reinhart holds no sway over the Guild.
The [Assassin] breaks Lacel's legs with a hammer, and Typhenous says they are well and truly broken, a message with his bag of holding still locked.
The [Assassin] tells Lacel to send Lord Bein the pendant of his own will the next day, and says the injury is not meant to be permanent.
Hawk hears that Lacel was intercepted while running a delivery to Lady Dealia in the Players of Celum's inn.
Lacel leaves the city with broken legs, but the package for Lady Dealia is still there.
The Assassin's Guild is back, now accepting contracts on Runners, as the attack on Lacel was meant to send a message.
Lady Bevia Veniford is the matriarch of the Venifords and the aunt of Rael.
Bevia is an old, high-level [Lady] who has survived two husbands and both Antinium Wars.
Bevia is adept at social graces and brings the Venifords income through trade ties, to Rael's anger at her dealing with [Merchants].
Laken thinks Bevia is much more intelligent than her nephew, and she sounds two decades younger than her age.
Bevia tells Laken that monarchy is alien to Izril because the nobles' ancestors fled Terandria, and that nobles may fear he will annex their lands.
Bevia narrows her eyes as Laken speaks of never having visited Pallass, thinking over what it implies.
Bevia lends Laken her [Mage] who can send and receive [Message] spells for up to two days, in exchange for a token of trust.
Laken feels a push at his mind as Bevia asks for facts about his trebuchets, and resists it because Lady Rie forewarned him.
A noble tells Tyrion that Bevia has written requesting aid because Goblins have surrounded her location.
Bevia shelters in a house at Riverfarm with other nobles and greets Laken charmingly over tea.
Bevia interrupts to support Rags with a charming smile that calms Laken, while her [Mage] whispers urgently beside her.
Rags tells Bevia to stop using her Skill, and Laken tells her to be silent.
Bevia teases Tyrion Veltras for throwing the nobles on Laken's mercy, and says she did not make a mess of the young man's army.
Bevia says half the peers of the realm would try such a trick if they thought they could get away with it.
Bevia stays to convince her peers not to run and asks Tyrion to bring back her [Mage].
Lady Dealia is a [Lady] of the minor house of the Zolde nobility, whose family fled unrest in Chandrar two hundred years earlier.
Lady Dealia is regarded by many nobles as still Chandrarian, and counts among the most beautiful [Ladies] in all of Izril.
Lady Dealia is ranked fourth on the list of the top ten [Ladies] to marry, just below Lady Wuvren.
Lady Dealia has two brothers, the younger of whom is Qiam and might be seventeen.
Lady Dealia is engaged to Lord Bein of the Terland family, one of the Five Families of Izril, in a match thought scandalous.
Lady Dealia's family was delighted by the match, and Lord Bein won over his father, Lord Sheldae Terland, to support it.
Lord Bein was said to have been seeing Lady Hetessana of the Wellfar family for two years before falling for Lady Dealia.
Lady Dealia is troubled by the claims against Lord Bein but stands by him at first.
Rumor says Lady Dealia has promised to call off the engagement if the claim is true, and that her brothers swore to stab Lord Bein.
Lord Bein tries to reassure Lady Dealia that the matter is a misunderstanding before heading south to recover the item.
Couriers Tritel and Hawk race to Lady Dealia's convoy of minor nobles, and her brothers and bodyguards reach for weapons.
Lady Dealia confirms her name to the Couriers and receives the Terland amulet.
Lady Dealia says she knows the amulet is real because it is Bein's, and concludes that Lord Bein was unfaithful.
Lady Dealia is truly heartbroken, and her brother Qiam declares the engagement off before a scrying mirror.
Lady Salkis is a rich young Drake [Lady] of Pallass, with an onyx-scaled hide and a tail that wags when she is excited.
Salkis travels with [Bodyguards] who try to restrain her, and her father is said to be worried by her visits.
Lady Salkis pauses demurely with her bodyguards among the young people watching Kevin, hiding a strange artifact she cannot puzzle out.
Salkis insists on watching Kevin's skateboard ride, saying she would like to see what the Human is doing.
Salkis would have joined the mob around Kevin but for her bodyguards, and orders them to find out what the skateboard is.
Salkis follows Jasi's song to the inn despite a bodyguard warning that it is a hotspot of dangerous activities.
Salkis sees Numbtongue walk out of the Garden of Sanctuary and stares at a Hobgoblin, while her bodyguards reach for weapons until Mrsha kicks them.
Salkis decides she is going to like it at the inn.
Lady Zekyria is a [Lady] of the Blighted King's court and the twin sister of Lady Theras.
A [Chamberlain] says Lady Zekyria and her sister lost their children unexpectedly three months earlier, and both have been in mourning since.
Lady Zekyria wears a pink and red outfit like a riding dress with trousers, and Tom finds her fierce even in mourning.
Lady Zekyria has a husband and had a child.
Lady Zekyria argues that using [Assassins] against the Demon King is a mistake, since Rhir has no Assassin's Guild.
Lady Zekyria dismisses the notion of contracting an Assassin's Guild on another continent.
Lady Zekyria reassures her twin and reminds her that Lady Reinhart is an ally of the kingdom.
Lady Zekyria dismisses the Fool's sufferings, noting he was taken prisoner while Tom fought.
Lady Zekyria would like Lord Nereshal to halt the aging of more individuals in the realm.
Lady Zekyria stands with the other ladies in light red, nearly pink and white, mourning her dead child, after the Fool explains crimson.
The Fool reveals that the miscarriages the ladies mourn were not a curse but the price of the summoning ritual.
Laken Godart is a blind young man from Earth who is transported to the Wandering Inn world holding his bacon quiche and walking stick.
Laken is blind from birth and sees nothing at all, neither blackness nor a difference between light and dark.
Laken becomes an [Emperor] by declaring himself one, and his class lets him sense all the land he claims.
Laken's best friend on Earth is Zoe, and he was with her in San Francisco just before he was transported.
Laken is the son of two fairly affluent parents, one a lawyer and the other a businessman.
Laken says he once wanted to be a professional chef and then a food critic, but gave that up because a blind Masterchef already existed.
Laken says he studied many professions and at one point wanted to be a billiards player.
Laken is about 184 cm (6'1") tall, shorter than Durene by at least a head.
Laken has a fiberglass walking stick that astonishes Durene because the material is unknown in her world.
Laken has an iPhone in his pocket that his best friend Zoe loaded with a flashlight app as a joke.
Laken is twenty-four, not American; his mother is German, she married his father in France, and he grew up all over Europe.
Laken says Ryoka is twenty-one and Erin is twenty, and he asks whether Ryoka is around his age.
Laken speaks German and some French, and answers Ryoka's German in German.
Laken tells the villagers he is a traveler from far off, sidetracked by a spell and relying on Durene for help.
Laken explains that his model is Emperor Norton I, a failed businessman who proclaimed himself Emperor of the United States in San Francisco.
Laken tells Durene that Norton issued his own money, was accepted by the people of the city, and drew a huge crowd to his funeral.
Laken admires Norton as a madman who dared to dream.
Laken declares himself Emperor of the Unseen and Protector of Durene's House, and gains [Emperor Class Obtained!], [Emperor Level 1!] and [Skill - Aura of the Emperor].
Laken finds a sack with one hundred and forty one gold coins and eight gemstones buried in the snow.
Laken believes his [King's Bounty] Skill produced the gold, reasoning that a ruler should never be poor.
Laken accepts Durene's account that Skills only grow powerful above Level 30 and wonders whether his new Skill is a weak one for an [Emperor].
Later, Laken reaches Level 2 as an [Emperor] on Day 19, which he attributes to teaching Durene and tending the cottage he claimed.
Laken enjoys teaching Durene the basics of biology and science, and counts helping her grow as what an [Emperor] would do.
Laken's [Aura of the Emperor] first works when he shouts "Enough" in rage at the children tormenting Durene, and they flee.
Laken learns that Durene is half-Troll when he touches her face and body after her secret is exposed.
Later, Laken gains [Emperor Level 4!] and [Skill - King's Bounty obtained!] straight after learning Durene is half-Troll.
Laken and Durene become lovers during the snowfall that night.
Laken calls Durene his one subject, or perhaps his consort, and calls himself Emperor of the Unseen and Protector of Durene's House.
Laken says Durene was a [Farmer] and is now a [Paladin], and that neither of them knows what that means.
Laken has lived with Durene for about a month, and they sleep slightly apart on the floor of her cottage.
Laken senses the land around Durene's cottage as a circle in which he knows where everything is, even with his cane put aside.
Laken reasons that as an [Emperor] he owns the land, not just the cottage, which is why he can sense it.
Laken can sense Frostwing, and by concentrating he finds squirrel dens within his domain to feed her.
Laken cannot tell what species an odd bird in his domain is, though he can feel it.
Later, Laken gains [Emperor Level 5!], the class [Beast Tamer] at Level 1, and [Skill - Lesser Bond: Frostwing].
Later, Laken's [Beast Tamer] reaches Level 2.
Laken finds a bag of coins by instant sensing; Durene had hidden it behind a sack, and it holds about a hundred times what he just spent.
Later, Laken gains [Emperor Level 6!] and [Skill - Intimidating Glare].
Laken is a Level 4 [Beast Tamer] after training Frostwing not to foul the nest and not to wake him.
Later, Laken reaches [Emperor Level 7!].
Laken dubs the frost faeries into ranks, including a Comtesse of the Soup Spoon, a Reichsgräfin, a Duchess, a Viscount, a Baron and a score of Blumenritter.
Laken promises the Reichsgräfin her position for as long as his empire exists, as an Emperor's word.
The faeries tell Laken they came to see him "before it was too late" but refuse to say what is about to happen.
An avalanche buries a swathe of forest but splits around the cottage, and Laken thinks the faeries' help was a gift and payment in kind.
Laken's sense fails two steps outside the circle of Durene's cottage, which he compares to going deaf or blind.
Durene carries Laken to Riverfarm and covers the ten-minute walk in four minutes.
Laken's first attempt to claim Riverfarm fails when he speaks it, even after he declares it a Protectorate of the Unseen Empire.
Laken realises the claim needs permission, because Durene had given him the authority over her cottage.
Laken succeeds in claiming Riverfarm by shouting his name and that all who live there are part of his empire.
Laken's thunder-like shout silences the fighting villagers, like the shout that once silenced the children tormenting Durene.
Laken senses a child trapped against a wall under the snow and tells the diggers he is fifteen feet down.
Laken revives the buried boy Sic with mouth-to-mouth breaths from his mother and chest compressions, which Gamel witnesses.
Laken senses which buried houses are intact, valuable, or closest to the surface, and organises the digging.
Laken has four big fires lit and has clothing and blankets dug up first for children and the injured.
Laken locates root cellars, potions, a buried sword and broken bows so the villagers can dig for them.
Prost calls Laken "Emperor Laken" while reporting that the barn is unstable.
Laken turns on his iPhone flashlight, then plays L'hymne à l'amour for the villagers.
Laken plays Reinhard Mey's Viertel vor Sieben, a German song of family and home, as his last song on a nearly dead battery.
Later, Laken gains [Emperor Level 9!] and [Skill - Empire: Blessing of the Hearth].
Laken wonders whether this world is meant for him, and whether he could call it home.
Laken tells the villagers they are under his dominion as their ruler, and they take that role seriously.
Laken tells Prost he has hundreds more gold coins like the one he traded.
Laken plans to go to Invrisil with Durene and Frostwing to buy all that Riverfarm needs.
Laken travels by wagon pulled by Durene, with Gamel as helper to Durene and spokesman to guards.
Laken swears to Prost, as an [Emperor], that he will return to Riverfarm, which he calls his home and his empire.
Laken's order "Enough" echoes across an Invrisil square and presses on Ryoka's chest when an adventurer reaches for his sword against him and Durene.
Ryoka sees Laken as a young man with closed eyes beside Durene, a half-Troll over seven feet tall.
Laken curses a lieutenant in German, telling him to go to hell, and Ryoka realises the language is German.
