text: Mrsha goes missing one morning while helping gather plants from beneath the snow, wandering away from the gatherer with her.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: The Gnoll [Hunters] search the forest, river, frozen lake, higher passes and known caves but find no tracks or signs of Mrsha.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Urksh says Mrsha is healthy and her throat undamaged, yet she does not speak.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Mrsha can make only small sounds such as yelps and growls, and Urksh finds it worrying that the tribe has not heard her.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Mrsha has light brown fur at this time.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Mrsha knows the gods are dead and so does not pray, while she sits afraid and cold waiting in the crevasse.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Mrsha strays from the gatherers to chase a snow hare, then something she smelled leaps out at her.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Ryoka infers that a dead armed Goblin in the crevasse had chased Mrsha, and that both fell down there while only Mrsha survived.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Mrsha guides Ryoka by patting her head and growling, then points with her paw, to show the way back to the tribe.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: During Ryoka's long run back to the tribe, Mrsha's brown fur turns pure white, as white as snow.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Ressa reports to Lady Magnolia that a Gnoll child has white fur, and Magnolia calls it no coincidence.

section: Book 2: The Stone Spear tribe and the crevasse
text: Magnolia says a white-furred Gnoll is a portent, though she would need to ask a Gnoll [Shaman] or Teriarch what it means.
Mrsha's fur is the colour of fresh snow, her eyes brown, and Ryoka sees her as silent and ghostlike after losing her tribe.
Ryoka feels that the loss of Mrsha's tribe was the price paid for her own and Mrsha's lives, and blames herself.
Mrsha follows Ryoka at a distance and fears her, and may hate her, after Ryoka's screaming nights and infected hand scared her.
Ryoka notes that Gnolls alternate between two and four legs and that Mrsha still moves on all fours.
Ryoka thinks Erin is probably only the second Human Mrsha has ever met, after Ryoka.
Mrsha has grown thin because she barely ate after her first night with Ryoka.
Mrsha bites Erin's ankle while Erin and Ryoka fight, and Erin flings her into a table.
Mrsha snaps at Erin and claws at her face until Ryoka tells her to stop and she runs to Ryoka.
Erin leaves sausage and scrambled eggs on the floor, and after hesitating Mrsha gobbles them and licks the plate clean.
Erin shows Mrsha how to hold a fork and cut crepes, and Mrsha clumsily spears big bites and dips them in butter and sugar.
In Krshia's kitchen, Mrsha bites Brunkr's hand while he tries to throw her off.
Erin silently punches Brunkr into a wall afterwards, and Krshia nods in approval.
Ryoka tells Krshia that Mrsha will stay with Erin, and Krshia suggests the inn is best for her.
Mrsha wets herself in fear when Toren the skeleton arrives at the inn.
Mrsha is waiting curled round a table leg in the inn when Lyonette returns, and the two eat honey for breakfast together.
Lyonette finds Mrsha thin and sad, and feeds her honey.
Selys has been looking for Mrsha all day after she ran away, which Selys says she has been doing all week.
Selys says Mrsha refuses food, even expensive steak, but Mrsha eats eggs and toast with honey at Lyonette's inn.
Mrsha clings to the tables and yowls when Selys tries to drag her out of the inn.
Mrsha hides behind Lyonette and refuses to leave with Selys, preferring the inn.
Selys leaves, telling Lyonette not to let Mrsha go outside and warning that she will fetch Krshia if she must.
Mrsha plays with paint cans and leaves white pawprints all over Pawn, a Soldier, and the floor.
Mrsha stays the night at the inn and shares Lyonette's bed, after Selys objects at length and then gives up.
Lyonette thinks Mrsha belongs at the inn, and the two eat honey crepes while Mrsha laps milk.
Mrsha sleeps in Lyonette's bed and has been stealing the covers.
Mrsha eats crepes with honey and eats as much as she wants at the inn, unlike in her tribe's camp where food was sometimes short.
Mrsha sees Lyonette as almost as good as a mother, and knows that her mother, father and tribe are dead.
Mrsha left Selys, who made all the rules, nearly a week before this day.
Earlier, when Mrsha ran from Selys and hid in alleyways, the Watch found her.
Mrsha has a class, [Last Survivor], at Level 8, which a voice told her marked her as the last of her tribe.
Mrsha believes her white fur means her tribe is gone and that it was her fault, and she covers her ears to avoid hearing rumours.
Mrsha's tribe was the Stone Spears, and she realises that none of them is left.
Mrsha has the Skill [Natural Concealment], which keeps Drakes in an inn from noticing her as she creeps to a table.
Urksh had been teaching Mrsha in her tribe to walk on two legs, and she copies this to look older and avoid being stopped by a Drake [Guardsman].
A companion of Revi tells Revi that Mrsha is mute when Revi asks the child where she is from.
Mrsha falls into the dark when a skeleton reaches for her too slowly, and she tumbles down into the dungeon.
Mrsha survives the fall with bruises and cracked bones because her Skill [Lesser Toughness] saved her life.
Zel Shivertail catches Mrsha in his arms in the alcove, and she cries wordlessly against his scales.
After Lyonette hugs her, Mrsha feels her fear break like a wall and thinks she is finally home.
At the winter party, Mrsha holds mistletoe and licks Erin's cheek, and Erin kisses her cheek in return.
Mrsha licks Halrac's cheek while Revi holds mistletoe over his head, and he rubs his cheek and grunts.
Halrac, sitting alone, smiles briefly when sure no one is looking.
Mrsha takes a box of matches and learns to strike one on the sandpaper by moving her paw fast, which makes fire for the first time.
Mrsha feels that making fire is instinctive for a Gnoll and that she has done it without flint or tinder.
Hours after her first match, Mrsha lights her one hundred and twenty third while a crowd presses into Octavia's shop to buy matches.
Mrsha sells matches, collects the coins in a pouch and drops them in a pottery jar Lyonette left in the kitchen.
Octavia keeps giving Mrsha more matches to sell, so the coins pile up.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha is a white Gnoll child, unlike most Gnolls who have brown or black fur.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha smells Ryoka coming and tackles her on the hill, hugging her tightly and making small sounds that are not words.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Four Gnolls follow Mrsha to make sure she is safe and say she was having lessons with Krshia when she scented Ryoka.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Ryoka first fears the Gnolls are after Mrsha because of her white fur.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Zel recalls that Mrsha had brown fur before, and Ryoka confirms that it turned white after the battle in which she lost her tribe.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Zel takes this as proof that some of the rumours about white fur among Gnolls are true.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha sleeps on Ryoka's head, goes flying when Ryoka sits up, and then rubs her head against Ryoka's face.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Ryoka does not know Mrsha's real age, since Urksh talked to her like a kid but she could be anywhere from baby to pre-teen.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Ryoka worries what will happen to Mrsha when she grows up, since she would have thrived in her tribe despite being mute.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha is mischievous toward Safry, leaping onto tables just after Safry has cleaned them and getting in her way.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Safry trips four times in a day near the table Mrsha had sat on, with nothing there but an empty chair.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha plays with a chess board in Lyonette's room, whose ghostly pieces fly back into place after she knocks them over.

section: Book 5: Growing up in the inn
text: Mrsha does not know that another player somewhere is resetting the pieces, and probably thinks it is magic.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: After Zel and the others are lost, Mrsha lies listless and silent in a corner, and Apista the bee crawls onto her head.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Lyonette coaxes Mrsha to eat lasagna, pizza, a honeyed egg and hot milk, the last of the milk.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha throws a red potion with an orange centre at the Eater Goats, and her aim is bad.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: A goat bites her potion in mid-air, and it explodes in fire and scatters the other goats.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha flinches at the word Goblin, as she has a past with Goblins, and Erin tries to reassure her.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha is furious with Erin for having let the Goblins into the inn, and her eyes blaze with anger and deep reproach.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha stays angry at Erin and wanders around Pisces, who gives her his wand to distract her.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha chews the tip of Pisces' wand, takes it upstairs and keeps it.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha is mute but not stupid, and she knows what a wand is.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha refuses to eat downstairs, play with Lyonette, give back the wand, or go near the Goblins, and she gets more agitated as days pass.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha refuses to leave the inn to stay with Selys or Krshia.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha remembers the Goblins streaming through the snow and cutting down her friends and family.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha thinks of Urksh and calls herself the [Lone Survivor] in her memories.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Erin steps on porcelain shards from a broken cup left before the basement trapdoor and gets them in her foot.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Lyonette later scolds Mrsha that Erin could have been hurt worse, which suggests Mrsha laid the shards.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha bites Headscratcher's arm and hangs from it until Lyonette tells her to let go, and her mouth is red with blood.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha leaps onto the table and thrusts Pisces' wand, hidden on her body with string, at Badarrow's ear.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Badarrow twists at the last moment, the wand is torn from Mrsha's grip, and blood trickles from his left ear.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha goes downstairs with Erin and sits holding Moore's and Jelaqua's legs for support, flinching from the Goblins.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Jelaqua whispers to Mrsha, and Moore gives her a bud that blooms into a flower in her hands.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha does not forgive the Goblins and hates their species when they laugh, but she finds it harder when they cry.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha stops waiting for the Goblins to attack and falls asleep curled up in a ball.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha agrees to stay with the adventurers rather than go out with Lyonette, who thinks she is more secure around Jelaqua and Moore.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha and Pisces compete over his wand, with Mrsha repeatedly trying to steal it back after Lyonette returns it.

section: Book 6: The Goblins in the inn
text: Mrsha sits with Ilvriss and Erin, lapping honeyed milk and eating soufflé from a fork Ishkr gives her.
Mrsha refuses oatmeal sweetened with honey three days after the battle at Invrisil in which Zel died.
Erin knows that Mrsha loved Zel, and Mrsha lies on a table like a white ball of fluff, twitching but silent.
Mrsha has grown a bit since she first came to the inn.
Mrsha curls up for naps inside Bird's pillow-fort bed, which captivated her.
Mrsha gallops through a puddle of rainwater on the third floor while Apista flies away from the splashes.
Mrsha's first big secret is that she is a Level 8 [Last Survivor] with the Skill [Natural Concealment], which she uses to sneak into the kitchen.
Mrsha waters the Faerie Flowers in the inn's planters each morning before breakfast, a task she has done for two weeks.
Lyonette suggested the flower job and Erin agreed, and Mrsha is paid four copper coins each week for it.
Mrsha is a Level 2 [Gardener] at this time.
Mrsha has the Skill [Wild Affinity], which lets her understand and be understood by Apista in some ways.
Mrsha is a Level 1 [Beast Tamer], like Lyonette, and counts the class as her third secret.
Mrsha hates and fears Goblins because they killed her tribe, but merely dislikes the Redfang Warriors as different Goblins.
Mrsha was born unable to speak, and she makes guttural sounds and can howl but cannot form words.
Mrsha's parents were both [Hunters] of the Stone Spears who feared she was crippled when she was born.
Mrsha's parents tried to abandon her for being mute, and the Chieftain Urksh exiled them for it.
Urksh raised Mrsha like a father until Goblins killed him, and she never knew her parents.
Krshia, Erin and Lyonette all teach Mrsha lessons from reading to math, geography and history.
Mrsha reads better than Erin, who struggles with advanced reading.
Krshia teaches Mrsha Gnoll history and practical math such as making change, and calls her gift for numbers surprising.
Lyonette teaches Mrsha royalty, politics and leveling secrets passed down in her family, while Erin teaches math, science and germs.
Mrsha finds a spellbook in a script that looks like none she knows, and she opens it.
There has been no Gnoll [Mage] in living memory because tribes lack spellbooks, and some say Gnolls cannot learn conventional magic.
Mrsha does not care that people say Gnolls cannot learn magic, and she tries the spellbook.
Mrsha uses Pisces' wand as a catalyst, having sneaked into his room to take it back after it was taken from her.
Mrsha casts [Grow Grass] by reaching for a memory of Ryoka's arms around her on the freezing winter night, and a blade of grass sprouts.
Mrsha considers herself a [Mage] and dreams of being a hero like those in the tales told around the campfires.
Mrsha slips out of the inn with her wand and Apista, against Lyonette's rule that she not go out alone.
Mrsha befriends a healing slime, treats a poisoned Fortress Beaver, and follows it to the Fortress Beavers' cave.
In the cave, Crelers attack the Fortress Beavers, and Mrsha flees into a Shield Spider nest while Apista fights a Creler.
Mrsha returns with Shield Spiders to help the Fortress Beavers against the Crelers, with Apista and the healing slime.
Mrsha casts a spell that makes grass snare a Creler and she collapses, drained, after Apista is savaged.
Mrsha wakes to find the healing slime on her face and Apista alive, and the alliance of spiders and beavers has won.
Mrsha brings home a lone Creler egg, and Jelaqua flips the table with a shout while Seborn stomps on the egg.
Bird shoots a Razorbeak diving at Mrsha as she runs away from the pursuing adults.
Mrsha reaches Level 6 as a [Beast Tamer] and Level 3 as a [Gardener], and becomes a [Mage] at Level 2.
Mrsha's class consolidates into [Druid] when the conditions are met, removing [Gardener] and [Beast Tamer].
Mrsha is a Level 2 [Druid] and gains the Skill [Spell - Wild Growth].
Her Skill [Wild Affinity] changes into [Peace of the Wild], and she obtains it.
Lyonette tells Mrsha she must not leave the inn without telling her or Erin.
Mrsha chases Ksmvr up a hill, spraying him with water from her mouth, while he does water tolerance training.
Lyonette scolds Mrsha for tormenting Ksmvr, and Mrsha reluctantly obeys with her tail and ears lowered.
Erin tells a stranger that Mrsha is a survivor of the Stone Spears tribe, attacked by the Goblin Lord, who lives at the inn.
Mrsha cannot speak.
Erin tries to send Mrsha through the magic door to sleep at Octavia's in Celum, and Mrsha howls, struggles and clings to Erin in fear.
Erin refuses to go through the door herself and stays to protect her inn.
Mrsha vanishes from the inn while Lyonette screams for her, and Erin searches the inn, the basement and the magic door.
The Raskghar take Mrsha to Calruz's lair, where she is held in a small cage apart from the captive Gnolls of Liscor.
Mrsha remembers a Raskghar bursting in, Lyonette screaming at her to run, and the Raskghar grabbing her on the stairs.
Mrsha remembers Lyonette and Apista attacking the Raskghar, and him hitting Apista so hard she hit the far wall.
Mrsha was dragged into the rain and half-drowned, then struck to make her throw up, before reaching the lair.
Mrsha sits shackled in a cage, hurt, thirsty and dizzy, and smells that the Raskghar are very bad.
An old Gnoll from Liscor with dark grey fur streaked reddish-brown stares at her in the neighbouring cage.
The old Gnoll calls Mrsha Doombringer and says the legends of the old days are upon them, blaming her fur.
The old Gnoll says Mrsha cannot help her curse, but she should know she is the doom and death of tribes.
Mrsha wants to protest but can only hide her head in shame, and the old Gnoll turns his back on her.
Mrsha has a very keen nose, honed growing up in her tribe smelling rodents under the earth and rain in the air.
Mrsha alone can smell a faint change in Calruz that comes before his rages, which neither the Gnolls nor Raskghar can detect.
Mrsha is more afraid of the Raskghar than of Calruz, although Calruz scares her as well.
Ceria tells Calruz that Mrsha is mute from birth, that Ryoka befriended her, and that her white fur is probably why the Raskghar think she is special.
A female Raskghar tells Calruz that white fur is special and that they feel it without knowing why.
Elirr tells Calruz, under threat, that in the legends of his tribe those with white fur appear after or before disaster, and they are shunned.
As the camp is attacked, the Raskghar run to the cages, club the Gnolls and lift them, with Mrsha in her cell wide-eyed.
Mrsha throws handfuls of poo at an awakened Raskghar from her cage, and the Gnolls and other Raskghar laugh at him.
The awakened Raskghar unlocks her cage and hurls her to the floor, cracking something and hurting her ribs.
Mrsha finds Ceria's wand, dropped when Calruz threw her, rolled against her cage.
Mrsha thinks of herself as Doombringer of Gnolls, Mrsha of the Stone Spears, and Mrsha the [Druid].
Mrsha knows only two spells, [Grow Grass] and [Wild Growth], neither of which she thinks useful, and she has left Pisces' wand in her room.
Mrsha can make blue grass with [Grow Grass], which puzzled Lyonette, and [Wild Growth] only makes her grass taller.
Mrsha grows grass in the lock of her shackles and with [Wild Growth] cracks the metal, freeing her paws.
Elirr, astonished, says Gnolls cannot cast magic, and the Gnolls plead with Mrsha to free them even though they had blamed her.
Mrsha frees twenty-seven Gnolls' shackles over the day by growing grass in their locks and casting [Wild Growth], then faints with a nosebleed.
Elirr says no Gnoll has cast [Mage] magic in living memory.
Mrsha howls in grief and rage, and Snatcher appears with a bag of heads and paralyses the room.
When Ceria drives Snatcher back with [Ice Spike], Mrsha grabs the wand and Elirr tears her cage open and flees with her.
Elirr smiles and calls her Doombringer again, but it now means something different, and the Gnolls head home howling.
Mrsha leaps from the Gnoll carrying her, howls at the Hobs and Raskghar, and runs past them with the wand in her mouth.
Mrsha's run draws Nokha and eight Raskghar after her, while Headscratcher holds the rest of the Raskghar back.
Earlier, Mrsha waves her wand and grows a grass snare, like those the Stone Spears used, that briefly catches Nokha.
Moore picks Mrsha up and throws Nokha off her, and Lyonette then holds her tightly while the fighting continues around them.
Mrsha is brought back through the door to the inn after Erin throws her frying pan at a Raskghar.
Mrsha has a nightmare of lying on an altar while a living Nokha pulls Vakk's head from her chest and says Mrsha and she are whole.
Mrsha has levelled up and gained a Skill of her own, which she keeps secret, and she sleeps with Pisces' wand under her pillow.
Mrsha smiles at last in a sunlit meadow, realising that she is free.
Lyonette gives Mrsha a tiny bit of Faerie Flower nectar in her before-bed milk, and Erin says she no longer has nightmares every night.
Mrsha throws herself under the table and Dawil roars at her and swats her paw away when she tries to take his pasta.
Krshia and Elirr tell Mrsha they saw her cast magic with her wand, and they are not angry with her.
Mrsha points her wand at Krshia's floorboards, and grass that smells conjured from nowhere bursts up between them.
Elirr is delighted by the magic, and Krshia notes it is not the magic of [Shamans].
Krshia says Mrsha has done what no Gnoll of the tribes has done for sixty years, which is to become a [Mage].
Mrsha reads a spellbook of Krshia's that strains the eyes of Krshia and Elirr, and she can read it as a [Mage] would.
Mrsha traces the symbols with a paw and mimes the first spell with flapping arms, which Krshia and Elirr cannot decode.
Mrsha takes nearly sixteen minutes to choose a spell from the book.
Mrsha later cannot read another spell and goes cross-eyed, so Elirr closes the book, and Krshia concludes the book is genuine.
When Krshia cannot lift the heavy light of the Gnoll ritual, Mrsha takes it and feels it surge through her.
Mrsha finds the light warm, like being amid her tribe, and senses that it is made of the Gnolls' feelings.
Krshia tells Mrsha to throw the light into the sky, and it becomes a star above Liscor.
The star shines for eight minutes while Mrsha sits and smiles up at it.
Mrsha reads Krshia's spellbook until her nose bleeds and Krshia slams it shut, hoping a spell could make her family smile.
Mrsha pulls a concealed wand from her fur and makes grass bloom from the table to comfort Lyonette and Numbtongue.
Mrsha has been mute from birth and was abandoned by her true parents, raised by the Stone Spears as a handicapped child but one of their own.
Mrsha invents her own signs, with encouragement from Erin and Lyonette, once Erin told them of her origins and Earth's sign languages.
Mrsha signs hunger with two pats on the stomach and sadness with two paws clasped then drifting apart.
Lyonette learns a new word Mrsha invented, a tap on the nose and a circle meaning tracking.
Mrsha signs "not good" at Lyonette, who answers with a sign meaning sorry.
Erin lets Mrsha pick fruit from her shoulders, and Mrsha glances down every few seconds for reassurance.
Mrsha has been casting a growth spell that keeps the grass around the inn's hill lush, unlike the muddy floodplains, and has wand and pouch on her side.
Mrsha says by head shake that Moore did not teach her the spell, and Erin jokes about giving her [Gardener] a raise.
Mrsha signs good morning to Numbtongue with paw gestures.
Mrsha carries a plate, cups and silverware on two legs from the kitchen.
Mrsha uses [Natural Concealment] to creep up on the Hobgoblin Pyrite, who spots her at once even though the Skill usually fools Numbtongue until she is close.
Mrsha levels up to Level 4 as a [Druid] and thinks of herself as six years old.
By Plains Gnoll reckoning, which counts years by the winter, Mrsha is already seven, but she decides she is still six because Erin promised her a birthday party with cake.
Mrsha learns [Thorn Paw], Moore's [Thorn Hand] adapted for her, in only two days, finding it easier than learning from Krshia's spellbook.
Mrsha can grow thorns on her paw, one from the palm and one from the back, shaped so they do not cut her.
Mrsha has her own special greeting sign for when she is happy, known to Erin, Lyonette, Numbtongue, Moore and a handful of others.
A Gnoll [Guardswoman] tells Zevara that Mrsha is mute as Mrsha frantically signs to the Watch.
Mrsha makes a sign of paws curved over her ears like horns, and Zevara realises it means Calruz is in danger.
In the prison, Mrsha tackles a Gnoll [Guardsman] about to spear Calruz and stabs his leg with a thorn from her paw.
Rufelt, the bartender, gives Mrsha carrot juice with sugar when she climbs onto a stool the day after those events.
The Council grants Erin's inn de facto citizenship of Liscor and offers to put Erin, Lyonette and Mrsha down for citizenship.
Mrsha, with the [Natural Concealment] Skill, leaps onto Pisces' table to swipe leftover eggs from his plate.
Pisces flicks a finger and the plate soars out of Mrsha's reach, and she misses and lands on the floor.
Mrsha's Skills make her hard to spot, although her white fur is not camouflage.
Mrsha signs to Lyonette, and Lyonette tells the Wistram [Mages] that Mrsha cannot speak but communicates with her paws.
Lyonette relays Mrsha's question about why Ulinde has two wands, and later says Mrsha says the mages smell like the Horns' blood.
Mrsha hides weeping under Pisces' bed with his old wand and a yellow flower tied to it, as a gift.
Pisces shouts at her, then apologises, and Mrsha leaps out and hugs him.
Mrsha has been warned strictly by Lyonette not to climb out on the roof and not to run about, and she sits with Bird in his tower.
Mrsha hides behind Bird as the [Actors] set up in the inn.
Relc trains Mrsha to fight a baby Rock Crab with his knife, and she slashes it but it leaps and pinches her arm.
Relc kicks the crab dead and offers a buckler, and Mrsha refuses a healing potion because the cut is a mark of pride.
Mrsha keeps the polished claw of the Rock Crab as a trophy until Lyonette makes her throw it away, which starts a tantrum.
Mrsha goes for a sword after Relc's remark, and Relc is barred from the inn for six days.
Mrsha leaps at Relc, climbs on his shoulders and beats him with a paw, and Lyonette scolds her.
Mrsha studies a magical tome Ryoka gave the Gnolls in Krshia's apartment, which Krshia insists she learn from.
Mrsha knows six spells, all tied to plants or the earth, and has not learned more after weeks of study.
Mrsha learned a seventh spell once but forgot one of the other six, and she cannot memorise above Tier 2 spells at best.
Mrsha is a [Druid], not a [Mage], having gained the class after the battle with the Defenders of the Cave.
Only Mrsha's family knows she is a [Druid], and Krshia and Elirr do not know it.
Mrsha cannot really cast magic without her little wand.
Elirr, a [Beast Trainer], offers to show Mrsha the baby Wyvern he is raising, and Mrsha shakes his arm in excitement.
Mrsha is Level 5 as a [Druid] and Level 9 as a [Last Survivor], a class that replaced the [Young Hunter] class she had in the Stone Spears tribe.
Mrsha has many Skills for her age, among them [Natural Concealment], which works on everyone except people like Chaldion, Grimalkin and Erin if she concentrates.
Mrsha's friends Ekirra and Visma are a Level 2 [Thrower] and a Level 3 [Shaper] respectively.
Mrsha feels Apista's sadness and gets a flash of darkness, stone, little air, running out of honey, and the need for the sky.
Mrsha knocks Erin's cake off the counter while using [Natural Concealment], and it splats on the kitchen floor.
Mrsha panics, creeps away and hides under her bed when Lyonette summons her, and tries to flee over the roof but a Worker Antinium blocks her.
Mrsha flees into a guest room and flings open a strange faded wood and iron door with a brass handle that does not belong there.
The door vanishes behind her and Mrsha finds herself in shaded grass among tall plants, away from the inn.
Grimalkin's [Scry] on "Mrsha Stone Spears" finds nothing, and Chaldion's scrying works perfectly clearly on Krshia Silverfang.
Krshia and Elirr try to track Mrsha by scent while the Drakes try scrying.
Mrsha explores a domed wooden world of soft grass, mushrooms and a fairy ring, which she finds reassuring and familiar.
Mrsha works out that the place is Erin's [Garden of Sanctuary], and she is the first to find the door in.
Mrsha imagines growing Faerie Flowers, fish ponds and fruit trees in the garden, and grows magic grass there with her wand.
On the hilltop Mrsha sees a stone figure sitting at a table that appeared from nowhere, and she flees crying down to the door.
Mrsha was gone for two hours, and Lyonette tells her that nobody is angry.
Lyonette whispers to Mrsha, who signs her account of where she was, and Chaldion learns that she is mute.
Mrsha touches the stone paw of Brunkr's statue, which sits at the table as if enjoying his first bite of cake, and she remembers that moment.
Mrsha longs to see a picture of Urksh and the Stone Spears' faces and is jealous that the garden is Erin's, and she wants to level up.
Mrsha asks Numbtongue and Bird to play in the garden using her own signing, and Numbtongue signs back how much.
Mrsha has developed her own sign language that anyone who has studied Mrsha-signing can follow.
Mrsha plays catch with Bird in the garden while Numbtongue thwacks his ball across the dome.
Mrsha owns three balls, gifts from Krshia, Elirr and Lyonette, and Selys then gives her a special red ball.
Ekirra and Visma come to Selys' home while Mrsha holds her new ball.
Mrsha realises Selys' wealth can make Ekirra sad and spoil others' gifts, and she hides her ball in a pan in a cupboard.
Mrsha's delight in having rich Auntie Selys falters for the first time, and she keeps the lesson all day.
Ekirra, Mrsha and Visma overhear Erin cursing mildly at the garden door, and Ekirra repeats "Damn!"
Mrsha finds a concealed stone ring in the basement floor and opens a hatch where Bird sits eating a stolen chicken.
Bird tells Mrsha she is not supposed to know of this hiding spot, and she signs victory.
Mrsha uses her [Druid] sense to feel that Apista is unhappy, and she gets an image of a sealed cave with darkness, hunger and "knaves from below".
Mrsha, who cannot speak, understands Apista's thoughts through her class, which feels different from the spellbook she hates.
Mrsha and Numbtongue find the Ashfire Bee cave sealed by a wall of stone, which Moore raised to save his friends, condemning the hive inside.
Mrsha senses the bees as a [Druid] rather than a [Green Mage], and feels the hive queen's fury at the invaders from below.
Mrsha reaches [Druid Level 7!] and obtains the Skill [Ambient Mana Gatherer].
Mrsha, small tray in hand, offers cups of goat's milk to frightened refugees waiting to enter Liscor or Esthelm.
Pawn introduces himself to the refugees and leads them away, while Drassi runs the door between Liscor and Celum.
Mrsha charges and bites at the Earthers Joseph and Rose in anger, but she cannot punish them properly because her blessing is gone.
Lyonette has given Mrsha's blessing to someone else, which is why it is gone.
Mrsha sees Ryoka return to the inn and freezes on the stairs.
Mrsha stopped remembering Ryoka, and cried at night thinking Ryoka had left her because she was a Doombringer.
Overwhelmed, Mrsha crawls out of Moore's hand and runs down the hill, and a wind that Ryoka calls slows her fall and carries her back.
Mrsha sees that Ryoka has tears in her eyes and slap marks from Lyonette on her face, and pinches Ryoka's cheek to be sure she is real.
Mrsha signs that Ryoka is not forgiven for doing a bad thing, then signs that she is happy Ryoka is back, and hugs her crying.
Mrsha thinks of Ryoka as the one who saved her from the Goblin Lord and was with her when her world ended.
Mrsha, angry at Ryoka and Relc for their behaviour, pops her head in Ryoka's window and then opens the magic door on her room as a prank.
The prank exposes a nearly nude Relc to Erin, Lyonette and Embria, and Mrsha sticks out her tongue at Lyonette's side.
Mrsha sneaks away from the inn using her Skills, with her wand, to visit the cave of the Defenders of the Cave.
Mrsha finds the Shield Spiders have tripled in number and overrun the cave, the Healing Slime is gone, and most Fortress Beavers are dead.
Mrsha senses the spiders' hunger with her [Druid] senses and cannot talk to them, as they only have vague images of fire, death and magic.
Mrsha wrathfully casts an arrow of thorns at the Shield Spider King and holds the cave mouth, blowing a horn for help.
Apista dives onto a giant Shield Spider to protect Mrsha, and the Fortress Beavers break out of their dam for a last stand.
Moore, Numbtongue and the Halfseekers arrive and destroy the Shield Spiders, and Mrsha pours healing potion on the surviving beavers.
Mrsha has Erin open the garden door and moves eight Fortress Beavers into the [Garden of Sanctuary], over Lyonette's protests.
Mrsha reaches [Druid Level 8!] and obtains [Natural Allies: Fortress Beavers] and the form [Natural Gift: Fur of the Fortress].
Mrsha has to promise Erin many things, such as keeping the beavers off the chocolate tree and the Blue Fruit sprouts, and they listen to her.
Mrsha feels responsible for the Fortress Beavers, the last remnants of the Defenders of the Cave, who now live in the garden.
Mrsha believes the alliance fell apart because she stopped visiting, and she thinks they would have been fine if she had visited weekly.
Erin introduces paw-painting into Mrsha's lessons, and Mrsha's mural of a happy slime with spiders and beavers hangs by the door.
Ekirra, Visma and Mrsha's paintings are hung around the inn by Erin.
Erin has set a one-hour limit for Mrsha on the electronics that Ryoka brought back.
Mrsha climbs into a drawer of Erin's Skill compartment, ignoring Lyonette's warning about living things, and is crushed back to normal size.
Numbtongue frees her, and a Skill that works like a Bag of Holding does not hold living beings.
Erin makes Mrsha promise never to do it again.
In Invrisil, Mrsha and Shassa Weaverweb recognise Nalthaliarstrelous, keeper of Magnolia's gardens, as a fellow [Druid].
Shassa Weaverweb and Mrsha du Marquin stare together at Nalthaliarstrelous beating a man in the street.
Mrsha puts centipedes in Rose's pillow as vengeance for unwanted petting the day before.
Erin and Lyonette punish Mrsha with an hour of dishwashing and no dessert, and she must apologise to Imani.
Mrsha did not know how to write or read much before the inn, as Urksh had taught her sparingly, and Lyonette and Erin made her a good writer.
Mrsha writes Ryoka a letter in laborious cursive, whose first line reads "hewo", then continues in ornate, posh English with help from Lyonette.
Eldavin shows Mrsha how to use pre-written cards, and she writes insulting notes to Erin, Rose, Olesm, Selys and others.
Mrsha writes a ransom note for cookies as Mrsha the Great and Terrible, Bane of All Things, but Ishkr refuses with a single "Nope".
Mrsha keeps her pre-written notes in a bag of holding she got for her birthday.
Mrsha tells Numbtongue by card that she approves of him, and gives Maviola cards saying she is in her way.
Maviola dunks Mrsha's head in water in the kitchen as a lesson, and Lyonette hands Mrsha a card reading "You could do better."
Mrsha's lineup of cards includes nicer ones after Maviola's lesson.
Mrsha shows her [Druid] ability when she draws her wand and casts [Fur of the Fortress] to tackle Octavia as a huge ball of fur.
Lyonette thinks her [Boon] Skill is not suited to Mrsha, since [Barkfur] and [Lesser Strength] would only let her cause more trouble.
Mrsha, Numbtongue and Bird form the Bee Rescue Team with Apista and go fishing at a pond in the High Passes through the magic door.
Mrsha casts her line from afar, gets the first bite, and helps beat the flatfish to death.
Mrsha wears only a cotton shirt and a kilt, the only outfit she would accept after tossing out the other dresses.
Mrsha prefers signing over writing notes because it is faster, as long as the other person can follow her.
Mrsha designed her sign language herself and has improved it with the help of Earthers who know bits of sign language.
Mrsha feels especially understood by [Druids], Goblins, Antinium, Ekirra and Visma.
Mrsha tears off her shirt and kilt to run around in her fur, and Erin chases her around the inn laughing.
Mrsha pushes Visma over a silver ball she wanted back, Visma and the other children cry, and Mrsha ends up shaking and tear-stained.
Mrsha signs "Raskghar" with a biting claw descending on a heart made of her paws, and Erin holds her.
Erin promises Mrsha that no one will hurt her, which Erin knows is a promise she cannot keep.
Mrsha tries to sign to Ryoka, realises Ryoka cannot read it, and writes a note telling her to stay for a bit.
Mrsha carries a pouch with parchment and a quill that needs no ink.
Mrsha hands Salamani a pre-written card saying she cannot speak but can write and use her paws, and not to pat her head without permission.
Mrsha shakes Salamani's hand and is pleased to be treated like a proper adult.
Mrsha wears a kilt, and she gestures downstairs that she is hungry.
Nailren is a Gnoll of the Fletchsing Tribe and the leader of the Pride of Kelia, a Silver-rank adventuring team from the south.
Nailren's pelt is light grey, and the nine armed Gnolls of his team range in colour from that grey to russet red with black stripes.
Nailren says all-Gnoll adventuring teams are common further south, and that the Pride of Kelia came north to tackle Liscor's dungeon.
Nailren has the Skill [Double Shot], which drops a Raskghar with two arrows in the chest.
The Pride of Kelia includes a Gnoll who wears beads and feathers and may be a [Shaman].
Nailren leads the Gnolls in covering Gemhammer while Earlia's team searches Raskghar corpses in the dungeon.
Nailren spots the Facestealer ahead, aims his bow, and orders both Silver-rank teams to spread out and send emergency [Message] spells.
Nailren was paralyzed by the Facestealer alongside Earlia's team, and the Facestealer bent toward him as he snarled.
Nalthaliarstrelous is a [Druid] with a tangled beard and ragged clothing stained with soil, and he smells earthen rather than filthy.
Nalthaliarstrelous carries a long curved staff that is still growing buds of flowers and leaves, with a bit of blood on the bottom.
Nalthaliarstrelous is introduced as the keeper of Magnolia Reinhart's gardens.
Nalthaliarstrelous can shift into a hulking beast with envenomed claws and layered teeth, and later into a Dire Bear form.
Magnolia asks whether she may call Nalthaliarstrelous Nathal, and he refuses, saying this feels like Liscor.
Magnolia says her affair falls apart without him.
Nalthaliarstrelous walks into Erin's Garden of Sanctuary, and Magnolia orders Ressa to fetch him.
Nalthaliarstrelous reports that he has sensed the dungeon's tunnels, including a big one going south, and all the numbers.
Nalthaliarstrelous says he counted the Antinium too, that some are higher level, and that he will do the map later.
Nalthaliarstrelous grows into his beast form to attack an intruder at Magnolia's mansion, then freezes and turns back into a Human man.
Nalthaliarstrelous bows with his forehead to the ground before the old half-Elven Teriarch, whom the servants recognise.
Magnolia says he never bows like that for her.
Nalthaliarstrelous beats a young man bloody in Invrisil for spurring a horse, and keeps attacking when others try to pull him off.
Nalthaliarstrelous says he writes many warning signs for Invrisil, including one outside the inn about kicking a dog.
Nalthaliarstrelous tells Mrsha there are only two large Circles of [Druids] in Izril, one in the Vale forest under House Veltras and one in Oteslia.
Nalthaliarstrelous uses a Skill to show Mrsha the Floodplains as a lake, then a swamp, then drained plains.
Nalthaliarstrelous holds that Drakes changed the Floodplains by felling the trees, and that Shield Spiders from Baleros multiply until nothing else lives.
Shassa agrees the Shield Spiders should be dealt with, and Mrsha nods her agreement as the deciding vote.
Nalthaliarstrelous begins a [Challenge of the Wilds], drawing the Floodplains' Shield Spiders to attack only him.
Teriarch tells the others to leave Nalthaliarstrelous alone because this is his duty.
Nalthaliarstrelous buries and drowns waves of Shield Spiders with earth, mud, a rift, spires and an avalanche.
Grimalkin calls Nalthaliarstrelous a geomancer, the best of their kind, and says he could still beat him.
Nalthaliarstrelous runs low on borrowed magic from the inn and drops to one knee.
Nalthaliarstrelous fights the rest in Dire Bear form, and the Shield Spiders eventually flee, a fraction of the original army.
Nalthaliarstrelous is found naked and bitten among the destruction, alive, and afterwards only weeps.
Nalthaliarstrelous visits Mrsha to check on the Shield Spiders and says the Floodplains will soon be fit for wildlife again.
Nalthaliarstrelous says he weighs animals and people the same, and higher where people had the power to be good and were mean.
Nalthaliarstrelous reads that Mrsha is worried about the cure, says there are Druids everywhere, and offers to look at nests to see what can be done.
A [Sea Druid] leader says one of their order on land alerted them to Seve's cause, and Nalthaliarstrelous then visits the inn to a hug from Mrsha.
Nanette is a young [Witch], Califor's apprentice, who got her class when she was six.
Nanette says Califor raised her from a baby, and that she loves being a [Witch], which is all she ever wanted.
Nanette is a girl almost as small as a Cave Goblin, with brown hair in braids, who wears a little blue hat.
Nanette needs eight tries to ignite sticks with the basic spell [Hot Hands] while Eloise prepares a second pot of tea.
Nanette says Califor has talked down a rampaging Cyclops, out-stared a Gazer and made peace between Drakes and Gnolls.
Nanette says Califor carries a Cloak of Balshadow, which can turn her as invisible as night, and a staff from one of the Great Forests.
Nanette says Califor had a cottage by the High Passes, kept goats, and raised her there before they travelled.
Nanette says she wandered off as a small child with a goat named Belfaus and Gargoyles took her to a cave, where one ate Belfaus.
Nanette says Califor found her in the cave, brought her back, and then taught her to use magic to defend herself.
Nanette says Califor still has a scar from that day, and that nobody knows how Califor defeated so many Gargoyles.
Nanette gives the burnt Belavierr a half-empty jar of burn cream that Califor made, and tips her hat to her.
Belavierr pats Nanette on the head and weaves a brown ribbon into her cut braids, restoring them.
Nanette cries "Mother" at the burning body of the dead [Witch] and tries to leap onto the pyre until Hedag seizes her.
Nanette loses her mother Califor, who dies stopping the wildfire.
Califor was Nanette's mother by blood as well as by parenthood, and Hedag says Califor pretended otherwise to spare Nanette attention.
Belavierr stole a strand or two of Nanette's hair when they met, and offered Califor her daughter's life or her own.
The brown ribbon at Nanette's throat unravels and slithers back to Belavierr, who rides in wearing Califor's shape.
Nanette sits silent in grief and does not leave the coven's place after learning Califor stopped the fire.
Nanette crawls to the circle, takes Califor's charred hat from the altar and hugs it, saying "Mommy".
Eloise and Hedag say Nanette is alive and needs time, and that [Witches] do not run from their pain.
Nanette sits blank and doll-like in the grass past Riverfarm's unfinished wall, with a basket of herbs and a sickle, while onlookers whisper "Witch".
Eloise scolds Nanette about where to sit and escorts her back.
Children throw stones at Nanette and cut her cheek, and she does not move.
Nanette looks less blank for a moment and tips her hat to the Cave Goblin Pebblesnatch.
Nawalishifra Tannousin, called Nawal, is a [Blacksmith] of Clan Tannousin and wears a veil.
Nawal is the only [Blacksmith] in her clan worthy of the class, in a clan where few women swing a hammer.
Nawal is the only one of her father's students who learned enough to shape Naq-Alrama steel.
Nawal's people hold that women are impure and that metal develops defects if a woman shapes it.
Nawal's father forbade her from shaping blades and claimed to have made each blade himself with her help.
Nawal's father died the year before from a failing heart, after forging fewer than ten blades a year for the clan.
Nawal's brother Allaif makes extravagant promises and flatters buyers, and he lands the clan in trouble.
Nawal is prickly, and her sharp tongue irritates Teres Atwood.
Nawal sells Naq-Alrama ingots at the bazaar and snaps at a buyer for not understanding that the steel is magical and enchantable.
Nawal swears to forge Flos's master a blade sharper than any he has seen, with her brother Allaif's body at her feet.
Nawal swore the oath about three weeks before her arrival, and Flos sent a bag of holding full of gold by Courier to her clan.
Nawal's clan debated the offer for three days before deciding she must go to Reim, woman or not.
Nawal arrives at Reim's palace with a caravan of Tannousin warriors and clanswomen and clansmen after weeks of travel.
Nawal is the only clan member skilled enough to work Naq-Alrama metal flawlessly, and her tribe would suffer Flos's wrath if she fails.
Nawal tells Trey Atwood that the clan has come to forge the King of Destruction a blade unlike any he has seen.
Nawal expected Flos's palace to be vast, with silk beds and long carpets, and is disappointed by its plainness.
Gazi tells Nawal that she sees ruin after two decades of despair and asks her to hold her judgment until she has seen Flos.
Nawal says she will forge Flos blades of Tannousin steel that can cut through any spell, and vows not to disgrace her tribe.
This is the first blade of Naq-Alrama steel Nawal forges unaided, and she is young and low-level for the work.
Nawal insults Master Daiton's work and spits on the idea that he is a master smith worthy of Flos's forges.
Nawal says she can forge a better blade than Daiton within a day, and that Daiton challenged her to prove it.
Silmak draws a circle around the anvil, and inside it there is no air, as Daiton and Trey discover.
Nawal hammers the metal inside the circle for exactly forty-four seconds, then steps out to breathe before returning.
Nawal quenches the sword once in oil and says it is done.
Ulyse's four [Mages] enchant Nawal's sword with Strength, and Ulyse judges the blade pure enough to hold an enchantment.
Orthenon says Flos has heard of the bet and wants to see both swords.
Silmak tells Flos the Tannousin could never supply an army, since they forge a single masterpiece blade slowly.
Nawal travels with Flos's march north and sketches a weapon for him, complaining of the light.
Nawal warns that Naq-Alrama steel shatters when it breaks, so an ill-designed blade could shatter under Flos's strength.
Nawal is Clan Tannousin's best [Smith] yet is younger than her elders, who often ignore her or give orders as advice.
Nawal tells Lord Venith and Lady Maresar that Naq-Alrama steel is worked only by blue moon and noon sun, and that work proceeds slowly.
Her aunt Bezhavil, Silmak and Hesseif stand behind Nawal and let her lie.
Bezhavil proposes blaming Nawal's youth and inexperience as a female smith for the delay.
The first hammer blow shatters an ingot like glass because a seam of air runs through the metal.
Nawal smashes the other flawed ingots in despair and says her father's pride has killed them.
Nawal suspects her late father forged the flawed ingots and left them to be sold as metal, not a finished blade.
Nemor is a Great Mage who once cast ward spells for Magnolia Reinhart.
Nemor wears yellow robes with green slashes and has a groomed goatee.
Nemor blasted the wall of Magnolia's sitting room and announced that the Circle of Thorns seeks her life.
Magnolia and Ressa stood untouched inside a glowing shield while assassins emerged from the dark.
Nemor walked across the courtyard wreathed in a gold and sapphire shield.
Nemor cast a blue fireball with a white-hot center.
Nemor claims the Circle of Thorns has roots everywhere, even in Magnolia's own home.
Magnolia says Nemor bypassed her wards, with assassins, and subverted control spells for her Golems.
Nemor dies when Magnolia fires a thin line of light from her ring that expands into a pillar of fire.
Nereshal is a [Chronomancer], a time mage, who serves the Blighted King as palace steward and confidant.
Nereshal wears dark grey robes lined with silver, which do not quite hide the scars on his arms and left hand.
Nereshal has the cold, detached eyes of someone who has seen war.
Nereshal is short and slightly pudgy, like a man who casts spells all day and manages the castle, but with a [Soldier]'s eyes.
Nereshal acts as steward of the palace until he is released from his duties, and warns the newcomers that guards may not wait for explanations.
Nereshal says he can speed up a flight of arrows, slow an enemy's charge, hasten a weather front or slow the collapse of a wall.
Nereshal says his most important duty is preventing the aging of the Blighted King, so the king may rule longer.
Zekyria says Nereshal halts the aging of the Blighted King, perhaps the Queen, and that he may use the spell on himself.
Nereshal is the Blighted King's most trusted confidant, an exceedingly powerful [Mage] who owes nothing to Wistram.
Some wonder whether Nereshal is a match for Wistram's Archmages, or beyond one, but he cares nothing for Wistram.
Nereshal is bound to Rhir and its eternal war, like Othius.
Nereshal lifts his staff, freezes time, and bursts a bubble of time that makes the exhausted Blighted King look younger.
Nereshal slows the passage of time around Eddy's mouth, so Eddy cannot speak until it wears off, to teach him manners.
Vincent and Emily are astonished that Nereshal is a time mage, since they thought time magic was impossible.
Nereshal answers that lesser [Mages] may think so, but the Blighted Kingdom demands every form of magic in its defense.
Nereshal says the Blighted King wants to appraise the group's worth, and notes that two of them reached Level 30.
Nereshal says the king also wants to confirm the rumors of Tom's success with his own eyes.
Nereshal raises his hand and shows the invasion of the courtyard as a floating image above the banquet hall.
Nereshal explains the Demons arrived by teleportation, likely with a scroll or artifacts, despite the anti-teleportation ward.
Nereshal estimates the Demon mage needs between forty minutes and two hours to open a teleport portal.
Nereshal says no [Mage], not even an Archmage, could do the calculations for a distant portal in ten minutes or less.
Nereshal commands the castle's magic while Tom eats at the banquet table, and the mage lights are put out.
Nereshal and the other mages cast [Heart of Darkness], which floods the corridors with pitch-black magical darkness.
Nereshal freezes a corridor full of Demons, leaving Tom only to stab them.
Nereshal has a gash on his cheek after the fighting in the corridors.
Nereshal and Tom fall from the same tower, and Nereshal survives.
Nereshal kills a few hundred Demons yet is almost undamaged, and he asks Tom whether his madness is an act.
Nereshal snaps that hundreds lie dead in the castle and thousands in the city.
Nereshal's nose is broken by a juggling ball thrown by the Fool.
Nereshal casts [Lightning Storm] at the Fool, who juggles the lightning back and knocks Nereshal unconscious.
Nereshal watches Erin Solstice's image beside the Blighted King and grows pale at a word she used, wondering if it relates to the summoning spell.
Nereshal tells the Blighted King he is not sure, but would bet that exactly a thousand came from Earth.
Nereshal reasons the others would have met hostile monsters, or been teleported into the sea or sky, and ten times that number would have been noticed.
Nereshal believes the summoning ritual of ten thousand lives produced a thousand children from Earth who were thrown across the world, not to their destination.
Nereshal tells the king that the Fool had little knowledge of the ritual because he was not there.
Nesor is a young [Mage] who attended Wistram but failed to receive his mage certification.
Nesor serves in Lady Rie's company and kneels beside her and Geram when she kneels to Laken.
Nesor is a poor caster, so it takes him laborious minutes to send Laken's words by [Message] to Wiskeria's [Mage].
Nesor is pale-faced and sweaty with nerves, and Laken makes him sit so he cannot faint.
Nesor says he can send further [Message] spells if he has a mana potion.
Rie says she will send [Message] spells to Invrisil with Nesor's help.
Nesor attends Rie's meeting with Geram and is silent, since the magic discussed is beyond him.
Nesor copies the [Message] Ryoka receives.
Nesor is found among the older [Ladies] at Lady Bevia's house, who have stolen him away with their company, and Laken calls him back.
Rie is mortified at how Nesor was sought out and promises to keep an eye on him.
A [Message] ordering the army to attack is sent in Laken's name, and Laken says he sent no [Message].
Nesor is gone from Rie's cottage, which shows signs of a scuffle.
Laken finds Nesor unconscious with a lump on his head, dumped behind trees far outside the village, too late to stop the attack.
Nicoletta is an Italian Earthworlder around nineteen years old, introduced alongside Lorenzo and Diana.
Nicoletta, Lorenzo and Diana were riding a crowded bus when it passed through a tunnel and they found themselves in a forest.
Nicoletta is one of eight people who appeared there, plus a pair of two other confused people.
Nicoletta greets Siri with Salve and asks whether she is from Earth.
Nicoletta whispers to the other Italians and translates for them.
Nicoletta takes Daly's hand when he reaches out to reassure her.
Kirana hugs Nicoletta as the Earthworlders of the United Nations company surround the overwhelmed newcomers.
Daly says people from countries like Nicoletta's are not used to war.
Nicoletta and Lorenzo brighten at something Daly points out, but Kirana fends them off.
Niers Astoragon is second in command of one of the Four Great Companies of Baleros.
Niers is a Fraerling, one of the Small Folk, and is only six inches tall.
Niers is called the Titan, an ironic nickname that only some people understand.
Narration calls Niers the highest-level [Strategist] on the continent, perhaps in the world, and says he keeps his exact level hidden.
Niers led his army as a [Strategist] without a single level in [General] or any other class, and is infamous for it.
Niers is the most famous Fraerling in the world and a hero to the children of his kind.
Niers led armies to victory using his mind rather than a sword, outmaneuvering foes up to three times his army's size.
Niers has fought as a mercenary in Baleros for over fifty years.
Niers is loyal to his company and to his commander, whom he calls a long-time friend, almost to a fault.
Niers looks like a middle-aged Human apart from his height, with dark black, slightly grey hair and a powerful build.
Niers wears armor as expensive as any [Lord]'s, since [Blacksmiths] find forging anything so small difficult.
Niers sleeps in his command tent on a small cot set on top of a table, to avoid being stepped on or attacked by wildlife or bugs.
Niers considers a dagger as large as he is still a dagger and is strong enough to lift it, though it is awkward.
Niers does not interfere in battles his lieutenants are winning, because interfering would impede their growth.
At the time of the first chess games, Niers is a Level 63 [Tactician], and his company's fate rests on his shoulders.
Niers is a Level 64 [Strategist], and in truth a [Grandmaster Strategist], an odd subclass he obtained shortly after learning to play chess.
Niers keeps his exact level and his class change secret.
Niers cast [Assault Formation] mid-battle, changing the air on the battlefield and drawing a roar from his soldiers.
Niers has a class sense of coming battle, a premonition larger than anything he has felt before, which he reads as larger battles awaiting him.
Niers had barely levelled in the past decade, gaining a single level.
Niers levelled again after only eight games against his unknown chess opponent, and suspects he will keep levelling while pushed to his limits.
Niers wonders what miracles might occur if he could reach Level 70.
The game of chess is credited to Niers, and his students and much of Baleros play it almost religiously.
Niers says he did not invent chess; he calls the claim a grand lie, a trap set to catch a far larger truth.
Niers seeks the truth of the past that he discovered along with the game long ago.
Niers keeps a magical chessboard beside his bed whose ghostly pieces mirror every move of a board elsewhere in the world.
The magical board lets Niers play only one person, an opponent he considers worthy of the Titan himself.
Niers tells a student that in the current game he has won two games and lost four.
Niers lost his fourth game to his opponent, was close to winning, and smiled rather than raged.
When chess spread, Niers travelled and played people, losing only twice, and afterwards only a handful of times among thousands of challengers.
Until a few weeks before, Niers had no consistent rival on the continent; his best students could win one game in ten.
Niers was lonely as a king alone above the world until this opponent arrived.
On a whim, Niers spent a few hundred gold pieces sending a challenge across the world to separate good chess players from mediocre ones.
One answer came back almost instantly: a clumsy drawing of a board with a notation system better than the one Niers devised.
Niers spent days on the puzzle, then paid almost triple for a fast-built magical chessboard.
Niers backtracked the letter, at great cost, to Izril, and learned it went on to Liscor after leaving the boat.
Niers says he prefers to savor the mystery and has not looked into the matter further.
Niers could reach Liscor within days with [Teleportation] spells, but chooses not to spoil the surprise.
Niers once played Flos Reimarch a single game, while Flos was slumbering, before the game of chess was revealed in full, and won.
Niers says Flos's spirit was not in that game, and that Orthenon, Flos's steward, was a far more difficult opponent.
Niers considers quitting his company, bored by recent wars and driven by a wish to find the truth, though he would abandon his commander.
Niers reads [Dangersense] reports from cities across the continent, which he requested, and marks them on a map of Izril with a compass circle.
Niers notes the circle is about the same diameter as before but slightly bigger, and concludes another dungeon has been found.
Niers' chess pieces had not moved for over two days, and he worries his opponent is injured or bored.
Niers has been in a bad mood for over a week, so students tiptoe around him and soldiers obey quickly.
Niers takes the smallest room in an inn, staring at the chessboard he sent across the world and at a lavender, gold-edged letter.
Niers is tempted by both the chessboard and Magnolia's letter, since Magnolia is on the same continent as his missing opponent.
A man tells Geneva Scala that the Titan, second-in-command of a company that rose to prominence two decades earlier, is the greatest [Strategist] in the world.
The same man says the company's Commander, the Three-Color Stalker, takes down enemy officers while the Titan leads their armies.
Niers' student group includes Umina, a Lizardfolk girl who is new and careful around him, afraid of crushing him.
Cameral, a Dullahan, is Niers' student; Niers tells him to take his head off if loose rather than squash him.
Marian, a Centaur and the largest of his students, coordinates a stationary mage unit in the Grimvol battle.
Venaz is a Minotaur sent from the Isles of Minos after much competition to become Niers' student, described in the text as female and always trying to outshine the others.
Niers has senior students Wil and Yerranola take command of his second force.
Niers puts students in roles away from their strengths, such as a Lizardfolk leading cavalry, to avoid overspecialization.
Niers asks for fewer than forty casualties in the next day's battle, ruling out heroic charges.
Niers wonders when he stopped being a leader of soldiers and became a teacher, and thinks the world needs more [Strategists].
Niers faced fifteen of his own [Strategists] and [Tacticians] in the Grimvol battle, which was overkill but useful practice.
Niers' opponent in the Grimvol battle was a [General] with defensive skills named Grimvol.
Grimvol set a trap meant to kill Niers, relying on reinforcements from a larger army hidden in the eastern jungle.
Niers found the trap easily, destroyed the hidden army the day before and replaced it with his own force.
Niers has Cameral spearhead the assault slowly, making it look like a pitched battle to give Grimvol time to launch his surprise attack.
Niers orders Umina to discard Magnolia Reinhart's letters scented with lavender, rosemary, raspberries or other flowers, and tosses one aside after a cursory study.
Magnolia's letters are always an invitation to speak by mage spell or in person, and Niers has never replied.
Niers has met Magnolia only twice and is exceptionally wary of her.
Niers fears that if he talked to Magnolia she would offer a prize he could not refuse, and he wants to avoid the temptation.
Niers says Magnolia's mind would put most [Strategists] and [Generals] to shame.
Niers paces on his desk reading reports written on pages as tall as he is, in a bad mood because of the unmoved chessboard behind him.
Niers reads that the Razorshard Armor and Roving Arrow companies destroyed their reputations fighting over a valley now practically unusable.
Niers' [Spies] and [Informants] sift reports of new companies, and he reads of a new company calling itself The United Nations.

The report on The United Nations lists a few sub-companies of under a hundred members each, a connection to a local Naga war vendor and former undead suppression company members including Quallet Marshhand.
Niers once dreamed of uniting the Great Companies of Baleros, a hope Magnolia had tempted him with, and thinks the name is an empty dream.
Niers feels the world beginning to move again as a piece on the chessboard behind him slides forward.
Niers lives in an academy converted from a palace in Elvallian, and moves through enclosed Fraer-ways lit by mage lights.
The Forgotten Wing Company's wealth let its [Architects] install glass windows in the Fraer-ways so Fraerlings can view the city.
Elvallian is a trading hub in Baleros and headquarters of the Forgotten Wing Company, and aspiring [Strategists] can learn there from the Titan.
Niers is a [Grandmaster Strategist], and many claim he is the highest-level [Strategist] in the world.
Students call him the Professor, and he is always angry of late, feeling cooped up and made to show visitors how important his classes are.
Niers resents Terandrian lace fashions, wearing a lace-trimmed black-and-silver doublet to a fundraising event and declaring he will quit.
Niers tells Foliana over breakfast that he is thinking about quitting.
Foliana answers that if Niers leaves the company will probably be attacked, so he should rethink.
Foliana asks if he is going to find his mystery chess partner, and Niers says he is done with pomp and teaching.
Half of Baleros knows Niers is playing an opponent, and most know his record; this week it was two wins, three losses and four draws.
Niers teaches that static pike-and-archer lines would lose to the Antinium, who overrun pikes and tunnel under archers.
Niers cites Generals Sserys and Shivertail from the first two Antinium Wars as showing the best answer is elite shock units and mage bombardment.
Niers has a magic quill sketch battle plans on a board during lectures, with the parchment later available for study.
Niers' advanced students, about eight, are those he considers able to lead soldiers in an actual battle.
Niers rates Umina as talented but hesitant, Cameral as gifted but lacking creativity, and Marian and Venaz as supremely confident.
Niers passes over Wil, a Human, and Yerranola, a Selphid, in class because they would answer any question.
Niers orders Marian to shoot a Sparklewing Bird at the window, calling it a hazard if any Fraerlings are about.
Niers is addressed as Lord Astoragon when greeting visiting guests, including Lady Messimar, a Lizardwoman noble.
Niers and Foliana raise funding at yearly fundraisers, receiving thousands or tens of thousands of gold pieces in donations from a single guest.
Niers tells his students the King of Destruction's steward Orthenon allegedly targeted enemy [Strategists] in a recent battle to bait them into a trap.
Only Niers and Foliana know that his invention of chess is a lie, and chess is part of his classes.
Niers kicks over a cup of eight dice that all come up ones, then loses, saying he simply does not like to gamble.
In a coin toss with Wil, Niers calls heads and Wil's coin lands heads repeatedly, and students whisper of a curse.
Niers tells his students there is no curse and that their eyes and ears are mistaken.
Niers drinks Firebreath Whiskey from Izril against Venaz, matching cup for cup, and the students are all unconscious by midnight.
Niers secretly emptied a hidden bag of holding of the whiskey, kept behind a molar, and feels old.
Fraerlings can hold more than their body weight in drink and food, growing taller to support the mass, but alcohol can still kill them.
A student shows Niers a chess newsletter from Liscor addressed to the [Strategists] of Zeres, sent by an Izril [Strategist] in a Walled City.
Niers recognizes one game in the newsletter as his own game with his opponent, written down for all to see.
The newsletter's author, Olesm Swifttail of Liscor, says he witnessed the game rather than played it.
The newsletter includes instructions for a game called Go, and Niers demands a quill, parchment and black and white stones.
Niers plays a game of Go against Umina and wins crudely, with his hands shaking.
Niers finds Go fresh and impossible to see through, and says he will send Olesm gold and an enchanted ring.
Niers concludes his opponent showed Olesm the game of Go and is in Liscor.
Niers orders his [Chamberlain] Peclir to bring a [Diviner] to locate the board linked to his own.
The [Diviner] shows an inn with the other chessboard, and Niers hears footsteps before ordering the spell cancelled as someone steps into view.
Niers realizes afterwards that he is afraid to learn his opponent's identity.
Niers laughs at his fear, burns his lace doublet and hunts the intelligent rats living in the academy's woodwork.
Niers enters his lecture hall late, bloody, with a severed rat's head, and has Marian clean it so he can make a drinking cup.
Niers tells the class that a [Strategist] must sometimes throw caution to the winds, but that caution is not cowardice.
Niers orders a flashy red coat, a pirate-style hat and a full Sparklewing feather from the company's String Person [Stitchmistress].
Niers accepts Marian's invitation to a mock battle against any students who wish to take part.
Foliana remarks that the old Niers would have said no to the mock battle, and he answers it is good he does not feel old.
Niers leads his army into the mock battle with [Vanguard of Terror], [Covering Fire], [Rapid Advance] and [Formation: Dodge].
Niers then uses [Charge of the Strategist] and his army routs the student army, which uses padded weapons.
Niers gives Foliana the feather from his hat after the battle.
Niers writes to Olesm Swifttail on paper bearing the three-colored wing insignia of the Forgotten Wing Company, one of the Four Great Companies.
The Four Great Companies of Baleros are the Forgotten Wing, the Iron Vanguard, Maelstrom's Howling and the Eyes of Baleros.
Niers' letter praises Olesm's analysis of the games, attaches a puzzle he compiled, and looks forward to future publications.
Niers sends Olesm a brass ring with an eye insignia set with a tiny diamond as a small token of appreciation.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Olesm Swifttail regards Niers as a hero among [Strategists], famed for beating [Mages] and enemy [Generals] with mind games and clever insight rather than brute force.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers' letter says he would love to know more about the game of Go that Olesm mentioned in his newsletter.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers and Foliana are dragged out of bed to hear a recording of Zel Shivertail's speech, and Niers fears the Reinhart plan will upset Izril's balance.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers calls the Tidebreaker allied with the Reinhart fortune a dangerous combination, and notes Magnolia Reinhart is not known for mercy.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Foliana tells Niers that Magnolia sends her a letter every month, and the day before sent a letter with a blueberry muffin, which Foliana ate.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers is horrified at the muffin, saying there are more spells and poisons than they can test for, and Foliana points out that he reads Magnolia's letters.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: A Drake author's book says the Titan appeared on the Plains of Saltes the day after being seen in Baleros, took command of a Human army and pushed back Greydath of Blades.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: The same book says Niers assumed control of Human armies in the area and won or stalemated several Goblin Lords.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: The book says Niers is famed for defeating Queravia, the Gambler of Fates, one of the King of Destruction's Seven.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: The book credits Niers with pushing back the armies of two Goblin Lords at once during the Second Antinium War.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: The book notes that Niers' company was the first to agree to peace with Velan the Kind when he was a Goblin Lord.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: The author accuses Niers of cowardice for retreating whenever the Goblin King appeared on the eastern fronts, ending the war without a battle where the Goblin King was present.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Asked about his retreats, Niers answered only "I'm not an idiot", then ignored the author's letters.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers tosses the book aside in irritation, saying the Drake author is petty because Niers refused to let him interview him.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers is uneasy about the Goblin Lord business, seeing too many parallels to the past, including Zel Shivertail and Magnolia Reinhart.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers admits that had he known what Velan would become, he would have destroyed Velan's tribe when they first met him.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Foliana says Velan was sane, smart, kind, caring and strong, and that he went crazy on becoming Goblin King.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers agrees with Foliana's impression of Velan, calling him calm and intelligent for a Goblin, and intends to unravel the mystery of his sudden change.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers believes chess, the dungeon and the change in Velan fit together, and wishes he had time to visit the new Liscor dungeon and an old one in Terandria.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers spends an outrageous sum commissioning an enchanted Go board and plays his 37th game of Go in preparation for sending one to his unknown adversary in Liscor.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers orders reports on the four adventuring teams at Liscor, especially the [Mage] who cast the weather spell.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers watches the Liscor battle with Foliana, wants to go adventuring again at the thought of the dungeon, and hopes his chess friend is safe.

section: Fan of Olesm; the Goblin King (Book 6-7)
text: Niers thinks Olesm Swifttail, who commanded Liscor's defenses, may gain two or three levels.
Niers and Foliana bathe in a hot tub after campaigns, naked, as is Balerosian custom, since scalding water kills leeches and parasites.
Foliana is a Squirrel-tribe Beastkin whose pupils are red-pink, yellow and green, and who can turn invisible if she chooses.
Niers' students refuse to bathe with him and Foliana; Venaz, a male Minotaur, refuses to share a tub with anyone of the opposite sex.
Niers' magical chessboard floats, as do his map case, bag of holding and the handle of his sword, because Fraerlings make valuables buoyant.
Niers says he is six inches tall and dislikes ponds, and pictures fish and frogs swallowing him.
Niers has grey and black hair and a sharp beard.
Niers' opponent's chess pieces played dozens of games against themselves for over half a day and then stopped, with phenomenal play.
Niers had a duplicate of his magical chessboard made and sent across the world to his unknown opponent, and paces around his own.
Foliana says Niers used to play chess with a mage from Wistram, but stopped when he learned half the mages in Wistram were playing him together.
Niers says he thought his Wistram opponent was Archmage Feor, who played the first few games but is not at his level without predictive magic.
Foliana says Niers was once smitten with a [Lady] he thought a strategic genius, who turned out to be the Lord of the Dance.
Niers says the Lord of the Dance never gave his name and his stationery was perfumed.
Niers has a new Go board and pieces commissioned and sent to his opponent by Courier, certain they taught Go to Olesm Swifttail.
Go is sweeping across Baleros, and Niers is inaccurately credited with creating it, while Olesm's name is not connected to it.
Niers believes his opponent is in or near Liscor.
Niers prepares several fake boards and duplicate messages to confuse [Spies] and [Informants] who watch him, and enjoys seeing them reveal themselves.
Niers considers sending a Go board to the King of Destruction, but thinks it politically dangerous.
Niers rejects Foliana's suggestion to send a Go board to Reinhart, saying she would make it a talking point or use it against him.
Niers jokes about sending the Wistram mages a Go board with itching powder.
Niers has Liscor on his watch list and has received no letter from Olesm Swifttail, nor have his students.
Niers says reports are spotty, but a Gold-rank dungeon next to a city is a recipe for disaster, and this one is a vengeance dungeon by all accounts.
Niers says he heard Gold-rank adventurers travelled from Pallass to Liscor through the inn's door, and thinks it a powerful artifact the [Innkeeper] will soon lose.
Niers has a network of information spanning the world, and Foliana relies on him to tell her the news.
Niers reports that Lord Tyrion Veltras, one of the Five Families, assembled a large Human army and, with the Kingslayer's team, chased the Great Chieftain and Goblin Lord out of their mountain.
Niers notes Elia Arcsinger is demoralizing the Goblins and that Veltras has not yet engaged them, instead running them away from their fortress.
Niers met Veltras briefly when Veltras was younger and has attended gatherings on Izril where he knows reports of the man.
Niers disliked Veltras, saying he is everything Niers dislikes about Humans, but calls him a good leader who chooses when to fight.
Niers has planted a large flag by Invrisil on his map of Izril, labeled "Emperor?".
Niers writes his theory of Veltras's plan on a folded paper to be opened in about ten days, but Foliana opens it at once and finds it makes sense.
Niers says Veltras's plan is clever and may work, and that his enemies will not notice before it is too late.
Foliana remarks that Niers identified Veltras's plan in seventeen seconds.
Niers uses [Rapid Advance] to chase Foliana through the citadel when she runs off with his prediction, shouting that his reputation is at stake.
Niers puzzles over his opponent's twenty six master-class games played at speed against themselves, wondering whether they were a message, a code or a demonstration.
Niers' base is a citadel that is also the Forgotten Wing Company's base, where he keeps a war room with a magical map.
Niers is growing a beard after months clean-shaven, which irritates him.
Niers dislikes magical maps because he is too small to see over features like the High Passes, and prefers paper ones.
Magical maps cost a hundred times an enchanted sword to make and depict only what their creating [Mage] knows.
Niers' students in the war room include Marian, a Centaur, Venaz, a Minotaur, Yerranola, a Selphid in a Dullahan's body, Umina, a Lizardfolk, and Wil, a Human.
Umina lets Niers perch on her claw so he can see the map.
Niers tells his students the Humans are marching on Liscor, driving Goblins ahead of them as a pretext, with Tyrion Veltras holding trebuchets.
Niers has marked a small dot east of Liscor on his paper map of Izril, so small that only a Fraerling or keen-eyed student would notice.
Niers once scryed his opponent's room without seeing the opponent, and on the day of the Face-Eater Moth attack recognized the same inn interior.
Niers learned the inn's name through quiet information gathering and wonders whether his opponent is staying there.
Niers watches the Liscor battle in the war room through a scrying orb, with students ready to recreate it on the map with pieces.
Niers estimates the Goblin Lord's army at closer to a hundred and sixty thousand, and Venaz doubts Human [Engineers] can bring down Liscor's walls within a day.
Niers is tallying the Forgotten Wing's forces and reserves, preparing a short trip to Izril that Foliana guesses is to Liscor.
Niers plans to accelerate some students' training and contact old graduates and other companies so the company can run in his absence.
Niers keeps a blurred image on his desk of the young woman waving the flag, taken from a scrying orb, and wonders if she was his opponent.
A Courier named Ken tells Daly the Forgotten Wing Company, based in the south, recently seized land from other companies and is led by the Titan.
Ken says the company is considered powerful but fragile, since the Titan and a second leader called Three-Color Stalker, a powerful [Assassin], may be all that hold it together.
Niers hunts rats at night after the encounter with the academy's rats, and thinks of himself as about the size of a mouse.
Niers reads and seals reports at his desk while his [Chamberlain] Peclir Im collects them and helps run the citadel.
