text: Rags's tribe forms a tentative bond with Reiss's forces during a day of marching together.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags wakes with a cry of pain, feeling something snap and an emptiness in her chest, unaware of its cause.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Before sunrise Rags knows Quietstab is dead and weeps, and she finds his body twisted in the latrine ditch with his head snapped around.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags's rear guard turns on Tremborag's pursuing tribe with a pike wall and crossbow volleys while Human spells hit Tremborag's rear, then retreats, shooting as it goes, and outpaces him by [Fleet Foot].

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags realises the killing is a circle and tells Tremborag she will let the Humans kill him, calls him big, fat, stupid and ugly, and rides away.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: After Tremborag's death Rags tells the Goblins from the back of her Carn Wolf that Goblin deaths run in a circle and must stop, and maybe just over half the Mountain City tribe go to her.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags has Redscar and the Redfangs drill the Mountain City tribe and plans to set Tremborag's old lieutenants to compete over leading new factions.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags refuses to attack Liscor with the Goblin Lord's army, saying the Goblin cycle must stop and she will run or hide but not fight, because a Human named Erin Solstice is her friend.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags says Erin kills only to defend and has a sign at her inn saying "No Killing Goblins", and that she is good.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Reiss hits Rags with [Deathbolt]; she sways, alive but too weak to turn her Carn Wolf.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: A later [Deathbolt] aimed at Rags strikes her unnamed Carn Wolf, which dies, and when she vanishes in the melee her tribe breaks and runs.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags had refused to name the wolf Garen gave her.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags survives beneath the wolf's corpse among the dead, and finds her crossbow, sword, shield and wolf lost.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags loses her tribe, her wolf and her crossbow for a time.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags leads several hundred Goblins including Pyrite and Ulvama toward Liscor, behind a Human army, apart from her tribe.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags tells Garen "When you betray, you should stay", and he rides north and west towards the High Passes.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Shield Spiders, released from the dungeon after a Chieftain who knew rocks broke the walls, pour out onto the Floodplains as Rags, Garen and the Redfangs ride ahead of them and Pyrite and Tremborag's Goblins run behind.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Ulvama makes the Shield Spiders grow and become angrier as they race into the Human army.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Five Goblin leaders remain with Rags: Poisonbite, Snapjaw, Rabbiteater, Badarrow and Redscar, and she had hoped Pyrite and Ulvama would be there too, but Pyrite was gone.

section: Flight and the Goblin Lord's army (Book 9)
text: Rags names herself Chieftain of the Flooded Waters tribe, the Redfangs, Reiss's Goblins and the Cave Goblins, and Great Chieftain of the Mountain, and leads the survivors with burning weapons.
Rags is Chieftain of Goblinhome, a few inches taller, and wears Garen's key.
Rags has begun bleeding, which she takes as being closer to an adult.
Rags has visions of Velan as the Goblin King, filled with rage.
Rags is called Level 32 [Great Chieftain] of the Flooded Waters Tribe.
Rags designs a Roarwing crossbow built from Wyvern parts, a third of the ballista's size and moveable, of which she has made one prototype.
Rags and Redscar plan to send Badarrow and Snapjaw with Carn Wolves to Erin's inn, as Rags promised, but Rags will not go herself.
Rags fears bringing about a second slaughter by revealing that Goblins live to Erin, or that something will happen to her.
Rags believes the cycle can only be broken by Goblins being strong, as Velan was before he became the Goblin King and went mad.
Teriarch teleports Rags out of his presence, and she lands in Goblinhome's lake.
Rags decides to seek the two northern Chieftains, the [Fighter] and the [Witch], as allies for climbing the High Passes and finding the key.
Rags reaches Level 27 [Steelflame Tactician] and obtains [Spell - Fast Fireball] and [Skill - Dual Shot].
Redscar defeats the Ogre clan's champion without Skills, and Invek of Tormek Al makes peace with the Flood Water Tribe.
Rags trades Goblinhome's large nuggets of gold and cut gems to Invek for Goblin-sized steel daggers, small armor and three full sets of plate armor.
Rags reaches into Kerra's memory of the Valley Pact Tribe, living through the peace between Goblins and Ogres and the Keeper of the Valley's death to Terandrian armies.
Rags sips an Ogre mana potion, exhales a small gout of flame, and learns the Ogres fight Humans for mana potions.
Rags becomes Level 34 [Great Chieftain] and learns [Skill - Natural Allies: Ogres] and [Spell - Ogre's Strength].
Ram Shackl introduces himself to Ryoka at Riverfarm as a [Rancher] by class who is working as a [Farmer] for now.
Ram Shackl says he heard from Prost and other Riverfarm folk that Ryoka delivered food to them as a City Runner during the winter.
Ram Shackl says delivering letters to his farm used to be hellish because he cannot pay silver or gold for a delivery.
Ram Shackl says there are no Runners about Riverfarm, only former Street Runners such as Beycalt from years ago.
Ram Shackl says all of Lancrel's Runners just found work elsewhere because Runners are in demand.
Ram Shackl tells King Laken that he and the [Farmers] will soon have the storehouses bursting.
Ram Shackl assumes Laken will use the Goblins as monster bait or as workers, and he fears they will slit the farmers' throats.
Laken answers that his plan is nothing like Ram's guess and tells him not to worry about the Goblins.
Rasea Zecrew is a half-Drowned [Pirate Captain] of the Illuminary, glowing yellow in her right eye and shoulder like her ship.
Rasea is half-Anglerfish, grins with sharp teeth on one side of her face, and keeps the other half of her face Human.
Venaz names Rasea as Captain Rasea Zecrew of the Illuminary, called Rasea the Shining, one of the most feared [Pirates] on the seas.
Rasea is the younger sister of Revine Zecrew, the Siren of Savere, and calls Revine her big sister.
Captain Lasc says Rasea joined the Undersea Crews, the drowned Folk's brand of piracy, and took the Sea's Bargain.
Lasc says Rasea later left the Undersea Crews and is a [Pirate] who preys on everyone, including Drowned vessels.
Rasea's glowing Illuminary rams a [Necromancer]'s ship, and she is pulled back aboard her own ship from the burning wreck.
Rasea introduces herself to Wil with a bow, sweeping off her hat, as Captain Rasea Zecrew.
Rasea claims to be just a passing [Captain] who saw the fog and thought Wil's group might be in trouble.
Rasea slips and says she could not recruit, then corrects herself to say negotiate, while speaking of the [Necromancers].
Rasea's crew lie as badly as she does and say they did not hear a Minotaur and a Selphid bragging.
Wil realises Rasea has heard Venaz and Yerranola bragging, and sees that she thinks he has not caught on.
Rasea says she does not want to die safe like her sister and wants to see the world's greatest terrors and glories.
Rasea dreams of sailing over the edge of the world at the Last Tide, which she says swallows all ships.
Rasea swears by the flag of Savere that her crew will not trouble Wil's journey, but says they will come calling for a share of the loot.
Rasea admits she lied, saying she expected Wil would not give up the treasure beforehand, but claims she did not lie because she gave her oath.
Rasea tells Wil that a [Pirate] can be trusted only in her words, since she swore by the flag of Savere and then has her crew burn it.
Rasea says she only flew Savere's flag because her sister gets prickly if she does not, and that she cares nothing for nations, rules, laws or armies.
Rasea swings across to The Emerald Signet and fights Captain Lasc blade to blade.
Rasea persuades the Bloodtear Captain that Merchant Seagrass himself is a bigger treasure than the Swords of Serept.
Thirty [Pirate] and Drowned ships break from The Emerald Signet and follow the Illuminary against Lord Seagrass' command ship.
Rasea hails a Goblin ship from the Isle of Goblins under a white flag, asking for crew to join the Illuminary.
A Goblin [Shaman] calls her Hero-death and orders the Goblin ship stopped, knowing the glowing Illuminary cannot be outrun.
Rasea says her crew has been dancing with Admiral Seagrass, who holds a grudge, and that she is looking for a larger battle.
Rasea draws her sword when Greydath claims to have killed a thousand Humans, and her crew hold her back.
Rasea tells the Goblins she will land on their island someday, then orders the Illuminary on to Savere.
Rasea cries over seeing the King of Destruction, wishes she had been born when he was strongest, then orders full speed ahead at the beach.
The Illuminary rides the wave of [The Eternal Wave] over the beach and splits the cavalry.
The Illuminary runs over Flos Reimarch and his horse, and both vanish beneath the wave and prow.
Rasea tells an onlooker she hopes the King of Destruction will hunt her down, since life needs a challenge.
Rasea stabs the [Mage] Ulyse through the throat as he raises his staff, then cuts down another [Mage].
Rasea uses [Flash Cut] and cuts off Orthenon's forefinger and middle finger.
Orthenon's blade opens Rasea's stomach, and she steps back clutching her guts.
Rasea is laughing afterwards, having stolen armaments from a House of Minos warship and made an enemy of the King of Destruction.
Rasea is screamed at by her sister Revine, the Siren of Savere, and has someone mute the ravings.
Rasea did not order the Illuminary to war on her own account, because someone hired her and she would have done it for joy.
Rasea is fairly sure she knows who hired her through a distorted voice, and calls the hirer one mean Lamia.
Rasea threatens to burn Wistram's isle if her full pay is not delivered.
The narration says the House of Minos has done its duty and the King of Destruction has suffered his first real defeat.
Rasea tells a Wistram [Mage] on camera that the attack on the King of Destruction was all her idea.
Rasea says her sister can look after herself, and that as a [Pirate] her business is loot and glory.
Rasea's crew thrust a recruiting flier at the viewers, requiring applicants to be at least Level 30 and warning survival is not guaranteed.
Rasea's crew call the Illuminary better than the Bloodtear Pirates or the Undersea Crews.
Ratici is a short, slender Drake in a cap who works with Wilovan as one of the Gentlemen Callers.
Ratici is a master-class [Gentleman Thief] who notices hidden objects and stashes almost everywhere he walks.
Ratici tells Erin he is the finest [Thief] she will ever see, and Wilovan agrees.
Ratici belongs to the Brothers of Serendipitous Meetings, which Palt calls a smaller but elite gang with big players in northern Izril.
Ratici cannot see through the door to the Garden of Sanctuary, which drives him crazy.
Ratici can produce items such as a cup of ketchup with a flick of his hands.
Ratici tells Wilovan that he and Wilovan are late on a contract, and that the Brothers did not tell the Tall Man they were in the south.
Ratici says the Tall Man pays well and that after the Lady Reinhart business the inn seems the place to be.
Ratici rearranges the pieces of a magical chess puzzle board in Erin's room as instructed by the Tallman on the other end of a communication spell.
Ratici confirms to the Tallman that the room belongs to Erin Solstice, and the Tallman is Niers Astoragon, the Titan of Baleros.
Niers hires Ratici and his companion for escort duty, and Ratici agrees to keep an eye out after Niers offers to double the fee.
Ratici opens the inn's door for Erin and tells another gang he trusts they have an understanding, disarming them unnoticed.
Ratici notices that the inn has multiple holding areas and stashes, including a hand crossbow, knife and jars.
Ratici and Wilovan agree the Tall Man pays too well for them to pursue their other activities.
Ratici and Wilovan stay as Gentlemen Callers paid by the Tallman, though they worry about getting fat and rusty from sitting.
Ratici and Wilovan become champion dart-board players and enjoy the new games Erin introduces.
Ratici introduces himself to Erin as Ratici and Wilovan as his companion.
Ratici and Wilovan accepted the Tallman of Baleros' invitation to guard the inn, expecting a particular threat.
Ratici says the inn is a fine place but grates on the nerves when they have nothing to do but sit and eat.
Ratici suggests telling the Tallman they are cancelling the contract and returning the rest of his fee.
Ratici steals a card in Seaman's Vault by switching a card in his hand for the glowing one he wants, moving too fast for anyone but Wilovan.
Ratici and Wilovan hint to Numbtongue that all sorts, even types called monsters, can find work where they work.
Ratici and Wilovan say that they did not hold a fellow who ran afoul of their group accountable, and that their issue is with whoever led the group into it.
Ratici notices that a door which was in the hallway two days ago is gone and says Skills suggest a space behind it with no entrances.
Erin learns that Ratici and Wilovan are Gentlemen Callers of the Brothers of Serendipitous Meetings, who say they are criminals hired to look out for her.
Ratici and Wilovan refuse to say who hired them, and Erin guesses Ilvriss, perhaps Magnolia, or others.
Ratici says they chase off rough fellows who came calling and that they would let the Antinium take the first swings.
Erin realises Ratici and Wilovan were in Invrisil and protected her during the mob.
Fierre says the Gentlemen Callers are two of the Brothers' best and will kill an enemy of the Brothers.
Erin tells Ryoka she already knows Wilovan and Ratici are criminals.
Redit is a [Bouncer] who guards the door of the Players' inn in Invrisil.
Redit carries a club, and keeps his hand on it when trying to be unobtrusive.
Redit is a man strong enough to hold a boy in one arm.
Redit asks Grev whether he knows the Griffon Hunt, and Grev confirms they are the original Griffon Hunt.
Grev tells Redit that a boy trying to kick past him is a pal, so Redit lets him in.
Redit stumbles back and flinches when Maviola El enters with fire racing up her arm.
Redit closes the door after the [Lady] walks in with the Earthers.
Redit recognizes Maviola, lets her in, and blocks the mundane patrons.
Redit is kicked in the rear by Maviola after he looks abashed at being passed.
Redit has the door while the other [Bouncers] lock down the fancy inn.
Redscar is a scarred Goblin who leads the Redfang warriors, Garen Redfang's former second-in-command, and obeys Rags instantly.
Redscar leads the Redfangs as Rags's mobile attack force and vanguard.
Redscar rides a Carn Wolf larger than all but Garen's, which he raised from a cub.
Redscar's Carn Wolf is named Thunderfur, and he cares more for it than for himself.
Redscar carries an enchanted frost sword, which casts a frost spell.
Redscar has two classes, [Beast Tamer] and [Raid Leader], both useful to what he wants to do.
Pyrite thinks Redscar is the best fighter among the marching Goblins except Garen, Reiss and Eater of Spears.
Pyrite believes Redscar's two classes will merge in time if he lives long enough.
Redscar is a poor reader, taking a while to make out the sign on the inn's door.
Later, Redscar has become a full Hob, a little taller than Rags but the shortest Hob of all, with strength that shot up.
Redscar likes male Goblins, and is the leader of the remaining Redfangs.
Later, Redscar is called a [War Leader] and [Beast Master], Rags's second and the strongest Goblin beside her.
Redscar trains Rags in push-ups, stretches and sparring, noting that training means winning too.
Redscar wants to go home to the High Passes and fight a big herd of Eater Goats, which eat Carn Wolves, to make the tribe strong.
Redscar rides out of the darkness with his frost blade covered in blood, unharmed and furious, wanting to hunt the Humans.
Redscar stabs Pyrite in the arm with his frost sword when Pyrite stops him from riding after the Humans, then obeys and sends sixty riders.
Redscar leads Redfang Warriors out of the darkness with a glowing longsword and cuts down two Humans.
Redscar charges the Humans at the village, and Tyrion Veltras's lance pierces his right shoulder.
Redscar scouts ahead on Thunderfur despite his shoulder wound from Tyrion's lance three days earlier.
Redscar tells Rags "We chose you" when the Redfang Warriors confront her.
Redscar angrily asks what the former Chieftain did, hiding in a mountain, and says Rags was a better Chieftain than Garen could be.
Redscar half-rises with flashing eyes when Tremborag calls Rags a nameless child, and Noears and Quietstab hold him down.
Redscar tries to hold Reiss's army off from the flanks and shouts "Betrayer! Cowards!" while rallying the tribe.
Garen calls the Redfangs to follow him, but the ones around Redscar do not, and Redscar shouts "Run!" and flees.
Redscar arrives at Liscor with the Flooded Waters remnant on the eleventh day.
Redscar leads the Flooded Waters tribe toward the inn, sensing a friend ahead, and leaves Poisonbite and Noears behind to climb the hill.
Redscar reads the sign on the inn's door and laughs when he understands it, "No killing Goblins".
Redscar speaks English with Erin and introduces himself, holding her hand gingerly.
Redscar reunites with the five Hobs, hearing Headscratcher say his name.
Redscar duels Spiderslicer with identical unenchanted steel shortswords, and both heal their wounds afterward.
Halrac bets two hundred gold on the one with the scar, Redscar, and Pisces adjusts the odds.
Redscar asks the Halfseekers whether Garen was a good teammate, and Seborn and Jelaqua tell him Garen was terrible but strong and trouble-prone.
Redscar concludes that Garen was a bad friend, teammate and Chieftain, but good one sometimes.
Redscar directs the Flooded Waters tribe to spread out and leads them forward in formation.
Redscar points out undead to Poisonbite's female warriors in the battle.
Redscar fights on with the last Redfangs against encircling Humans, holding a frost-enchanted sword and the rust-red Redfang.
Redscar kills Sir Vumat in single combat after Vumat judges he would become as great a threat as Garen Redfang.
Redscar senses Rags running, sees shapes fleeing toward the mountain, whispers "Chieftain", and rides away with the last Redfangs.
Redscar finds Badarrow fighting with a dagger and drags him away.
Redscar brings Garen's rust-red sword Redfang to Rags on the back of the badly injured Thunderfur.
Redscar is one of five survivors who reach Rags with Poisonbite, Snapjaw, Rabbiteater and Badarrow.
Redscar rides one of the largest Carn Wolves and slashes Wyverns with his frost sword and Redfang.
Redscar's [Flurry Strikes] send fire from the crimson blade and frost from the other.
Redscar suggests sending someone to the inn to find survivors, and proposes Badarrow with Snapjaw.
Rags refuses to send thirty Redfangs, ten Hobs and seventy Goblins, and says two is enough.
Rags fears exposing Erin, so she will not go herself but agrees to send Badarrow and Snapjaw.
Rehanna Salesmith is a tall woman from Windrest who takes refuge in Riverfarm.
Rehanna accuses Laken of breaking his promise to keep the Windrest folk safe from the Goblins.
Rehanna mocks Laken's blindness, saying a blind man cannot be trusted or tell people apart.
Laken tells Rehanna that fear explains but does not excuse her words, and says he will not eject her.
Rehanna refuses to kneel to Laken.
Laken speaks one word, "Kneel", and Rehanna falls to her knees as he walks away.
Rehanna's husband fought at Lancrel and died after following Wiskeria into battle.
Rehanna blames Wiskeria and the mad Emperor for her husband's death, and says Lancrel's people see the truth.
Rehanna kicks over a cauldron of soup.
Rehanna's hand is scorched when a doorknob turns white-hot, and she screams as skin is torn from her palm.
Witch Mavika admits she cast the spell, saying Rehanna's pain was justly won by rudeness.
Belavierr speaks to Rehanna of an offer, and Rehanna goes white, stumbles and runs.
Rie fears that Rehanna accepted Belavierr's offer, though the cost was unknown to Rie.
Rehanna cradles an infant made of stitched cloth that moves, cries and has black inside its mouth.
Rehanna believes Belavierr has brought her baby back alive and that he will never leave or die.
Rehanna has aged overnight, her hair grey, and has lost all her hatred for Wiskeria, Riverfarm and Laken.
Rehanna says she levelled up as a [Mother] the night before.
Rehanna paid forty years of her life to Belavierr for the doll.
Rehanna names the child Mihka, a name she and her husband chose together.
Reiss is a Goblin Lord who is also a [Necromancer], and he has black eyes with white pupils instead of the crimson of other Goblins.
Reiss is thinner than Garen Redfang, almost able to pass for a Human apart from his green skin and pointed ears.
Reiss speaks the common tongue like a native speaker, with a reverberation of power in his voice.
Reiss rides a dead Shield Spider reanimated by magic, torn open and headless.
Reiss is the apprentice of Az'kerash the Necromancer and calls himself the one student of Az'kerash.
After the Goblin Lord's duel with Zel Shivertail, Az'kerash orders his apprentice to finish the Drake and secure the corpse, then teleports away.
Reiss kneels by the dying Zel and apologises, calling the death cowardly and unworthy.
Zel asks the Goblin Lord's name, and the Goblin Lord answers that he has none, only Goblin Lord and Apprentice.
Zel suggests the Drake name Reiss, which his old friend Sserys always wanted to give a son.
The Goblin Lord takes the name Reiss and swears to avenge Zel and his people by killing the Necromancer.
Reiss orders his Goblins not to touch Zel's body on pain of death, then orders a withdrawal.
The Humans believe the Goblin Lord killed Zel Shivertail, though Reiss knows that is untrue and cannot say so.
Reiss keeps the name given by a dying Drake secret from his master.
Rumour spreads that the Goblin Lord slew Zel, defeated an army backed by Magnolia Reinhart and destroyed two War Golems alone.
Reiss's injuries from the duel with Zel were healed within minutes of his victory.
Reiss rides a smaller Shield Spider after Zel killed his former mount.
Few Goblins have names, and Reiss's is a Drake name that stings, especially after Zel's death.
Some speculate Reiss chose the name to mock the Drakes or to honour a worthy foe.
Reiss orders "Left" and his army skirts around Invrisil without attacking, marching toward a distant mountain.
It was said later that the Goblins spared Invrisil because Zel's army had damaged them, a credit claimed by both Drakes and Humans.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss tells Tremborag's tribes that he is a Goblin Lord named Reiss and that they will join his army.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss is accompanied by Snapjaw and Eater of Spears at the parley, with four more Hobs behind him.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss casts [Deathbolt] on Tremborag's face, then dives clear as Eater of Spears charges and undead burst from the ground.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss claims to have defeated the Tidebreaker and destroyed Drake and Human armies, and promises a Goblin kingdom.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss says he has seen Velan's fall and will make sure it does not happen again.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss reminds Garen Redfang of a promise to follow him if he had a vision.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss tells the Drake Osthia that his master will not help in the battle, since the Necromancer's magic grows harder to cast with distance.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss wants the Mountain City tribe largely intact and expects it to join him if Tremborag and Garen fall.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss orders Snapjaw and Eater of Spears to run ahead, gather lieutenants and reform the army to the south as the Humans arrive.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss turns his tens of thousands of undead north against the Human army to buy time for the fleeing Goblins.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss fears his master's fury but fears more the many deaths if the Humans catch his army.

section: The Mountain City and Dwarfhalls Rest
text: Reiss resists the primal fear that Elia Arcsinger's Skill spreads across the mountain.
Reiss uses a loud voice to order "Split them" and "Begone", driving Tremborag and Garen away from Rags's tribe.
Rags's Goblins feel awe and longing for Reiss, as if he shone in their minds.
Reiss says he raises the dead so living Goblins need not die, and would let them rest if he could.
Reiss tells Rags he has a master but is no slave.
Reiss casts a bolt of black energy at Garen, who dodges as Reiss and Garen aim at each other.
Reiss tells the Goblins that he and Garen were once friends who met ten years earlier when Reiss was a small Goblin and Garen had just become a Hob.
Reiss says he and Garen met again seven years later, Garen then a Gold-rank adventurer and Reiss newly with his master.
Reiss says Garen was furious and called him not-Goblin, but their dream remained the same: Reiss as a Lord and Garen as his finest warrior.
Reiss claims Garen found "it" after years of searching the continent and betrayed the Halfseekers for it.
Reiss claims his master could not find the treasure because he was not a Goblin, and that Reiss never told him the memory.
Reiss shows magic beyond a Goblin [Shaman] by flicking a log into the fire with telekinesis.
Reiss says he came north seeking allies and that Tremborag attacked him under a peace meeting.
Reiss says Goblin raiding parties attacked his armies before he marched on Tremborag's mountain.
Reiss tells Tremborag he would kill him for one Goblin and make him suffer for the thousands who have died.
Reiss tells a story of two Goblins, a wanderer Hob and a small magical Goblin, who killed a wyvern together.
In Reiss's story the two friends challenged their Chieftain, lost, and fled.
In Reiss's story the Hob would become a famous adventurer in Human lands while the magic Goblin would study in Drake cities.
Reiss and Garen each took a disguise, a mask and hood for Garen and an illusion spell for Reiss, and swore to meet seven years later.
Reiss wandered Drake and Gnoll settlements for nearly two years using the illusion spell, since no [Mage] in smaller cities could see through it.
Reiss met Az'kerash, who posed as a [Merchant] in a Drake village and saw through the illusion, then attacked with undead.
Reiss lost the fight against Az'kerash, who offered him service in life or death, and Reiss chose to live.
Reiss tells the Goblins that his master is Az'kerash, the Necromancer who came from Terandria and fought in the Second Antinium War.
Reiss says Az'kerash wanted to create a Goblin King of his own as a weapon but could not make one.
Reiss studied five years under Az'kerash and grew stronger than any Chieftain.
In Reiss's story, Garen is waiting at the meeting place as the famous Gold-rank Goblin adventurer Garen Redfang of the Halfseekers.
Reiss raises a Bone Horror made from a cow to show Goblins that necromancy can spare their lives.
Reiss's Bone Horror collapses when he sees a Goblin child hiding in terror.
Reiss says he is a tool but not mindless: he chooses which orders to obey, has disobeyed his master once and will again.
Reiss dreams of a city where Goblins walk without fear, a kingdom of Goblins.
Reiss says he did not become a Goblin Lord or sacrifice so much for his master but for his dream.
Reiss plans to take a place that can be held, let its people leave in peace and negotiate with Humans or Drakes.
Reiss says his master will support him if he takes a place that can be held.
Reiss says he has been unable to reach Az'kerash by spell since the Humans drove them from the mountain.
Reiss thinks Az'kerash has contacted him less since Zel's death because he is creating unique undead that think independently.
Reiss guesses the Humans' plan is to push his army toward Liscor and the High Passes, possibly using the rain to stop their own army.
Reiss watches Tremborag murder Quietstab while invisible and makes no move to stop it.
Reiss tells the dead Quietstab that he will lead Rags's tribe to a safer place.
Reiss tells Osthia that he watched Quietstab die while invisible, saying one Hob's death will help save tens of thousands.
Reiss reasons that his spells could not have killed Tremborag outright, and let Quietstab die to win Rags's tribe.
Reiss feels guilty, calling the choice a Human thing to do.
Reiss casts [Quiet Air] to create a bubble of silence around himself and Osthia.
Reiss gives Osthia a ring of white wood that he says he finally made.
Reiss tries to reach his master by spell again and hears nothing, as usual.
Reiss offers Rags help against Tremborag, including Eater of Spears, Hobs and his remaining Draug.
Az'kerash takes control of Reiss and tells him to walk with him and report what has occurred.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss privately hopes Rags and Garen will ally with him as partners rather than subjects, and fears he might have to kill Garen.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss thinks Garen will oppose Az'kerash's plans on principle, and still considers Garen his brother.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss tells the Goblins that Az'kerash believes the Humans are driving them to Liscor so trebuchets can open its walls.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss announces the plan to take Liscor, with Az'kerash raising every fallen warrior and walls of bone.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss says Az'kerash will provide his elite undead warriors, his Chosen.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss tells Rags the first city of Goblins could be Liscor, her own home.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss tells Rags his dream has Goblins with no faces, since he would sacrifice anything and anyone for it.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Reiss casts [Deathbolt] on Rags at point-blank range.

section: The Liscor plan and betrayal of Rags
text: Pyrite's throwing axe severs Reiss's hand, and the Flooded Waters tribe and Reiss's army break into battle.
Later, Reiss fuses his severed hand back with bone and pours a healing potion over the stump.
Reiss raises a [Bone Wall] between himself and the charging Pyrite.
Reiss casts [Bone Claws], [Fortified Body] and [Draug Strength] on himself.
Reiss fights Pyrite by imitating the fighting style of Zel Shivertail, a Drake, "calling a memory into life".
Reiss defeats Pyrite with punches that break his ribs, and tells him he has had greater enemies.
Reiss casts [Bloodbat Swarm] during the fight.
Reiss kills Pyrite with seven [Deathbolt]s and apologises.
Reiss believes Pyrite is dead, almost completely sure.
Reiss believes Rags is still alive and orders Snapjaw to search the dead and kill her.
Tremborag's Goblins mostly surrender and join Reiss's tribe, while the core of Rags's tribe flees south.
Yitton sees the Goblin Lord shatter the Flooded Waters tribe and absorb the bulk of its army into his own.
Az'kerash tells Reiss that his Chosen will teleport in to fight the Antinium, especially Bea, and that Venitra will ambush Tyrion Veltras.
Az'kerash tells Reiss that Ijvani has not responded, so other undead will come instead.
Reiss's master tells him that a promising student living in Liscor should be kept alive if possible.
Reiss's master promises that if Reiss seizes Liscor, he will be the first of his students.
Snapjaw asks Reiss "Is it you?", making him wonder whether his desire to take Liscor is his own.
Reiss senses Erin Solstice as an instinct of safety and friendship, and his Goblins feel it too.
Reiss begins to urge his Shield Spider toward Erin despite his master's contempt for her.
Reiss's master overrides him and he orders "Charge! Kill them all!" as Solstice Goblins race toward his army.
Headscratcher, Badarrow, Rabbiteater, Numbtongue and Shorthilt run at Reiss, five brothers laughing as they fight.
Reiss fights toward Tyrion Veltras with a blade of death on his left arm, and thinks of Garen as his brother.
Reiss's master urges him to kill Tyrion, and for an instant Reiss defies the voice, calling out "Brother".
Tyrion Veltras's lance pierces Reiss's chest and tears away his shoulder and severed arm, and his army breaks.
Reiss refuses his master's order to kill Tyrion and the master abandons him.
Reiss walks to a hill to wait for death.
Reiss, nearly dead, sits in Erin Solstice's inn and speaks with her without feeling pain.
Reiss tells Erin he only wanted a place where Goblins could live safely, and also wanted to hurt those who had taken from him.
Reiss laughs at Erin's sign for Goblins and says he wishes he had seen her Goblins' loyalty.
Reiss says Goblins were made enemies from the very start.
Reiss tries to smash Erin's magical chessboard and fails, laughing bitterly.
Reiss dies saying "Someday, Goblins will know peace", never having told Erin his name.
In Book 19, Reiss advises Numbtongue during a card game and points out that Ratici is stealing cards.
Reiss and Pyrite believe Numbtongue summoned them and are copies or memories bound to him.
Reiss appears as a ghost beside Numbtongue and urges him to take his hand, while Shorthilt's ghost offers his instead.

Relc is a Drake guardsman of Liscor's City Watch, a Senior Guardsman over six and a half feet tall with light green scales, sharp claws, a forked tongue, a spiny crest, a bass voice and eyes like a snake's.
Relc is a [Spearmaster] with levels in [Guardsman] as well, and Drakes like him can breathe fire.

Relc has the skills [Dangersense], which makes his scales itch near danger, and [Thick Skin] and [Iron Skin], the last skill from his [Soldier] class, though he thinks [Spearmaster] may also grant it.
Relc has ear-holes on the sides of his head and dislikes the Captain of the Watch.
Relc says his spear throw never misses and he is strong enough to peel Erin off with two fingers.
Relc says he is a former soldier of the 1st Wing of the Liscorian Army and has killed more mages than Pisces has levels.

A named appraisal gives Relc as Relc Grasstongue, a former sergeant of the 1st Wing of the Liscorian army, with Level 33 in [Spearmaster], Level 12 in [Guardsman] and negligible [Archer] and [Carpenter] levels.
Selys said Relc is the strongest active city guard on the continent, perhaps the world, and that he quit the army to become a guardsman.
Relc says he is the highest-level [Guardsman] in the city.
Klbkch said Relc is a higher-level [Guardsman] than he, though Relc lacks [Detect Guilt].
Relc and Klbkch came to Erin's inn after the Watch spotted smoke from the city walls and the Captain sent them to check, and Klbkch introduced Relc as his partner.
Relc and Klbkch paid Erin several copper coins and two silver coins for the meal.
Relc threw his spear past Erin's ear to stop Pisces, and on his day off he and Klbkch left without paying, saying to put it on their tab.
Relc broke through Pisces's Wind Wall by force.
Relc told the guards in the barracks that Erin makes a mean plate of pasta and survived on the floodplains.
Relc told the barracks guards that humans have little inside their heads and cannot be trusted to make the smart decision, and Erin overheard him.
Relc told Erin that Necromancers should be killed on sight, citing a thousand zombies.
Relc drove off the Goblins with his spear, called them no threat to anyone with a few warrior levels, and carried Erin's bag home.
Relc swore when Erin said she had spent a few gold coins on food, and offered to ask around the market.
Relc killed three Goblins as an apology and brought their heads to hang around Erin's inn.
Relc and Klbkch came on duty to warn Erin that her chess bet against Olesm was unfair, since Olesm was a [Tactician].
As Senior Guardsmen, Relc and Klbkch threatened a cheating Drake shopkeeper with a tax and inventory investigation, and Relc flipped tables in his store.
Relc and Klbkch told Erin that adventurers cause trouble by fighting drunk, running from monsters and being rude to guardsmen.
Relc blamed Erin for Klbkch's death, telling her Klbkch died protecting her and that he never wanted to see her at the barracks again, then kicked a chair apart.
Relc saw Erin in the market and marched off in the opposite direction without speaking.
Relc raced Ryoka on the road to show off and lost, which he had seldom ever experienced and never to a human, and wondered if Erin knew her.
Relc confiscated Pisces's gold as a donation to the city, saying Pisces was still wanted for scaring people and robbing graves, and allowed him back into the city after his fines were paid.
Relc asked Erin whether she knew any tall, black-haired female Runner, because one had outrun him.
Relc said that almost all of the Watch are former soldiers.
Relc told Erin the Watch would not punish her for beating adventurers, because the guards laughed when three Human adventurers lost to an innkeeper, Workers and a few Goblins.
Relc said that Goblins are part of the wild, and the Watch leaves them alone so long as they stay away from the city and no orders say otherwise.
Relc said the Antinium do not care that Klbkch died, but that Klbkch was special, having a name.
Relc told Ksmvr he was shielding Erin as a favour because Klbkch had died protecting her, and Ksmvr read out Relc's levels as Level 33 [Spearmaster].
Relc grabbed Zevara and ran past Skinner, stabbing the undead hand.
Relc told Zevara that he and the Antinium are immune to Skinner's projected fear because of [Indomitable Will].
Relc began a [Triple—] spear skill and his spear struck three times at once, exploding a zombie's head.
Relc ran, grey-scaled and wild-eyed, past Selys after seeing the Antinium leader leading them, and whispered "He's back."
Relc greeted Ryoka by spraying her with a mouthful of blue juice and shouting "it's you! The Runner human!"
Relc found himself lying naked on the plains, and strolled into Liscor's southern gates while the Watch Captain was found passed out in a gutter.
Goblins of the Flooded Waters Tribe believe Relc killed more Goblins than the rest of the guardsmen combined, including the Goblins who raised Rags.
Relc threw Rags through the air and later kicked her unconscious.
Gazi's sword cut Relc's arm to the bone and split his spear in two, and Relc later charged Gazi with [Triple Thrust].
Relc threw his spear through the portal and Gazi tossed it back.
Relc and Klbkch joked that Klbkch's death by Goblins hurt his reputation and that Rags took Skinner's kill.
Relc offered to carry Erin's bag in return for food, and told Erin her inn had exploded.
Relc and Ceria wondered why their [Dangersense] had not gone off, and Relc can cover a hundred meters in a few seconds.
Ceria thought Relc could be a Gold-rank adventurer, as the highest-level guardsman she had seen.
Relc declared he would eat at the inn every night if Erin kept making food like french fries.
Relc ate eight burgers in total.
Relc and Klbkch helped Krshia roll ale kegs up to the inn.
Relc charged a warband in the snow and killed two Goblins.
Relc taunted Rags about being a coward, she spat on him, and he knocked her unconscious; he then said the Watch's orders after Klbkch's return were to get rid of Goblins, and kicked her table over.
Relc fought Ulrien, whose sword split Relc's spear shaft, but Relc won using the broken shaft, his tail and kicks.

Relc toasted Byssa, Invrss and Olivis, who died protecting a village from monsters, and cursed the Goblins; he then threw a mug past Erin, and Erin declared the Goblins under her protection, after which he left wishing all their tails would fall off.
Relc and Klbkch called at the inn while Erin was away and Relc left at once, and Klbkch took Lyonette for the thief who burned Krshia's shop.
At Erin's party Relc sat by himself, felt that he and Klbkch were no longer her guests, and Olesm joined them feeling unimportant too.
Relc boasted that he could take on any one Gold-rank adventurer by himself, and Klbkch answered that he spoke only as a friend.
Relc ate at the inn, said the dungeon spat out monsters now and then and that Zevara had the Watch guarding in shifts, and told Erin it was good she took in Mrsha.
Relc dressed as Santa Claus, with Klbkch wearing a white beard, and they frightened the Bitterscale family, then fought two masked Drake burglars with coal and a brick, and a crowd applauded them.
Relc argued the creature Erin saw was a huge salamander that breathes fire rather than a Dragon, and Klbkch called a Dragon near Liscor highly unlikely.
As a Senior Guardsman Relc tried Erin's defense soup, punched a black-scaled Drake adventurer in the stomach to test it, and chased him with a kitchen knife to see if the soup grew extra scales.
Relc complained of breaking up four adventurer brawls and had a bruise, the first injury Erin could remember on him.
Relc wished he had the enchanted spear from his army days as a [Sergeant] and asked Ryoka to carry a message to Liscor's army.
Relc said Liscor's army was fighting around one of the Walled Cities but he did not know where.
Relc head-butted Ryoka with [Relc Headbutt] at the barracks, then spotted a purple-scaled impostor who was "not one of the new guys" and knocked him down with [Relc Punch].
Relc told Zevara that Ilvriss's cronies, not Ryoka and Erin, had started the trouble, released Ryoka and took a lunch break; he had forgotten Ryoka's name.
Relc chased the Winter Sprite Ivolethe down an alley after she poured snow on him and found Ryoka, Regrika Blackpaw and Imenet on the ground.
Relc recognised Ryoka as the Runner he had nearly caught on the north road and tested her with a truth stone, which glowed bright blue when she said "I didn't do it."
Relc kicked Venitra with [Relc Kick], used [Lightning Sprint] and [Triple Thrust] on Regrika Blackpaw, and complained that he was out of shape and wanted his enchanted spear.
Regrika splintered Relc's ordinary spear and opened his chest, and Relc used [Relc Punch] before running for a healing potion.
Relc head-butted a mud-throwing Drake with [Relc Headbutt] after introducing himself, and said he could not sleep without his "security spear".
Ilvriss called Relc a former [Soldier] of Liscor over whom he had no authority.
Relc told Erin the Goblins in her inn were not the ones who killed General Shivertail, so he could put up with them.
Relc said the Drakes were already forming another army to kill the Goblin Lord who killed Zel.
Relc returned to the inn, saying he missed it and would not cause trouble, after his earlier dispute with Erin over the Goblins.
Relc said he was a famous [Sergeant] who had fought against Pallass in three small wars.
Relc knocked a Drake flat with [Relc Punch] and used [Triple Thrust], and a Drake shouted that he was Relc Grasstongue, the Gecko of Liscor.

Relc told Jelaqua that the Walled Cities fight each other constantly, such as a war over one Lady of the Wall calling a Watch Captain an insult, and that Liscor's army, though good, is a tenth of Pallass's size.
Pallass's Watch kept Relc, Jelaqua and the Drowned man in the barracks with their weapons impounded, after Ilvriss insisted they be unshackled and treated as guests.
Relc kept fighting on the wall against the dead moths while Tekshia Shivertail fought with a barbed spear.
Relc and Klbkch had been partners for nearly seven years, and Relc suspected the Antinium had known where the dungeon was from the start.
Relc told Klbkch that the Antinium had known exactly where to find the dungeon and had pretended otherwise.

Ilvriss's officer Ocelos named Relc as the Gecko of Liscor, a former [Sergeant] known for speed and fighting prowess who ambushed enemy officers and escaped, and Ilvriss said the title was not exactly a compliment.
Ilvriss estimated Relc as a Level 33 [Spearmaster] plus at least a Level 20 [Sergeant], and said he retired for a reason of his own.
Relc had a daughter, Embria, a [Wing Commander] in Liscor's army, with a [Major] to whom he was never formally married.
Relc's enchanted spear pierces magic barriers like soft cheese and does not bend; Embria brought it from the army.
Relc said he could take on any Gold-rank adventurer with that spear and could have poked out one of Skinner's eyes.
Relc argued that the Antinium saved Liscor from Skinner and the moths and have fought for the city for ten years, and said he was on the walls.
Relc said the City Watch's standard procedure is to have the perpetrators pay for broken furniture, and told Ilvriss the Watch would send him a bill.
Embria scolded her father to not be an idiot when he tried to start a bar fight.
Relc stood guard duty on the walls in the rain for the sixth straight day.
Relc said Erin grows on people like a mushroom.
Relc hit a ball roughly as far as Headscratcher had, and Ishkr ran on all fours to catch it.
Relc used a bird pickup line on Bevussa, failed, and said he should not have given all the good lines to Embria.
Relc told Erin he was on a walk in the neighbourhood, then asked her to do her "Erin thing".
Relc refused Zevara's order to push Numbtongue back through the door, saying Numbtongue was not doing anything wrong.
Relc deferred to Klbkch while Elissa Slipscal protested rent rises to Klbkch, and Lyonette remembered Relc as the one who killed Garen Redfang.
Embria met her father Relc weekly, and Relc is big and light-green.
Relc cannot cook, nearly burned down his kitchen making pancakes, and collects puzzle-things.

Embria told Yvlon that her father was an anti-officer fighter who charged enemy lines to take out a commander and retreat, and that he stayed a [Sergeant] because no class consolidates [Sergeant] and [Spearmaster].
Embria recalled that Relc once told her Goblins killed his parents.

Relc admitted to Embria that he left the army out of fear of dying, not because of cowardice, and that he was not happy by the end; he refused her offer to return, which she said was the last time she would ask.
Relc told Embria that the Goblins' Garen Redfang chose his own death and that Numbtongue did not attack Relc at the inn because Relc had not killed him.
A Gnoll told Embria there had been some talk when Relc appeared for morning practice, but that he is the only one better than her on the courts.

Relc fought Isceil with a spear that cut through Isceil's stone ward, hurt him badly with a fist and head-butt, and was then tagged by Montressa's [Chain Lightning], complaining that he hates Tier 4 spells.
During the Wyvern attack on Pallass, Relc charged a Wyvern with [Triple Thrust], and Olesm took command of Kel's sector as Liscor's [Strategist], sending Relc to reinforce squads as a [Spearmaster].
Relc minded Mrsha for a day because Lyonette was too busy, Ishkr was committed to another job and Drassi was on holiday.
Relc told Mrsha at a bar that he has a daughter, Embria, who used to sit with him and his squad in the camps and ask what they had done that day.
Relc said he likes his job as a [Guardsman] and likes puzzles and plays, even though Zevara gets on his tail.
Relc argued that Lady Macbeth is written so that her blood-guilt is weak, since she stabs no one and only gets a bit of blood on her hands.
Relc asked Klbkch who the new Ants were and said Klbkch had been in a bad mood all week, but Klbkch did not wish to talk about it.
Relc and Klbkch were monitoring Bearclaw, who testified under a truth spell that she had committed no crime in Liscor, though Klbkch said she had committed murder elsewhere.
Relc and Embria met weekly for father-daughter get-togethers, and Relc showed Erin new puzzles.
Relc asked a Garuda [Guardswoman] from Pallass out with a bad line, and she gave him points for effort and a date on her day off.
Relc said Klbkch was investigating a criminal in Liscor after two of the newest Senior Guards following a Gnoll named Bearclaw were killed, and that Zevara was furious.
Relc claimed you can use Skills in bed, and said [Triple Thrust] once hit the right spot and then the navel and thigh.

Relc pitched his colleague Kelli on The Golden Triangle, which he described as a fund that backs adventurers and [Mages] and pays money back, and which he said a Garuda from Pallass had told him about.

Relc picked a fight with Klbkch in the street, saying Klbkch had once smacked sense into him, and beat him while Dragonspeaker Luciva, Chaldion, Ilvriss and the First Gardener of Oteslia watched through scrying.
Relc is known as the Gecko of Liscor when people want to annoy him, and had been the Watch's best fighter for nearly two decades.
Relc lives alone in a small apartment and solves blacksmith's puzzles that cover his floor.
For the nineteenth day in a row Relc caught himself expecting Klbkch to wake him, forgetting Klbkch was on vacation.
Relc was a Diamond-backer of The Golden Triangle, a rank higher than Gold, and boasted that he had enlisted at least a thousand people.
Erin told Relc that The Golden Triangle was a scam, he insisted it was not, then realised it was and returned the coins to the people he had recruited.
Bearclaw's gang of eighteen ambushed Relc in the street, and her poisoned claws and a crossbow bolt left him scarred on the face and shoulders but alive.
Relc's classes rose to [Spearmaster] Level 36, with the skill [Recall Weapon: Spear], and [Guardsman] Level 17, with [Eyes In The Back].
Relc said he might like living at the inn if Erin had room, and that he would help by kicking Rock Crabs.
Zevara stripped Relc of his Senior Guardsman rank because public trust in him had eroded, and arranged his transfer to Cellidel for a number of months; Relc raised no objections.
Relc's apartment was burned down, and he said most of his puzzles had been saved.
A Guardswoman told Erin that Relc had been reassigned to another city a week earlier after the Golden Triangle incident.
Ryoka learned that Relc had left Liscor because of the Golden Triangle situation, and Erin did not remember which city he had gone to.
Rémi Canada is a [Reporter], later called a [Journalist], who writes reports on the war against Tiqr.
Rémi Canada is a young man from Earth who keeps a smartphone and uses a scrying mirror like a camera.
Rémi Canada is an Earther from Canada, listed alongside the Singer of Terandria as safe bets for being from Earth.
Erin pales at the surname Canada and the class [Reporter] and suspects the author comes from Earth.
Rémi Canada's article carried by the Mage's Guild, which disclaims its authenticity, describes the end of the Laughing Brigade and warns of Tiqr's likely fate.
Rémi writes that he fears his articles have attracted a bounty on his head and that he will try to reach Oliphant.
Pisces finds the author's report fascinating and is unsure whether the writer is male or female.
Rémi Canada watches from a hidden vantage point as Femithain advances, raising his smartphone while he cribs notes.
Rémi holds the scrying mirror like a camera behind Flos of Reim and Teres at Belchan, while a Garuda assistant whispers beside him.
Rémi tells his assistant to stop whispering during the filming.
King Raelt of Jecrass looks into the scrying mirror that Rémi holds, so that his words are heard by all.
Rémi has appeared in Levrhine, probably to witness the battle, and broadcasts both sides with a night-and-day difference.
Rémi watches the King of Jecrass raise one hand and produce a roar of sound.
Rémi Canada follows a group of Earthers into A'ctelios as one of fifteen who enter.
Rémi Canada is organizing another newspaper while others ride south, and tells merchants, a [Mayor] and backers that Wistram does not hold a monopoly on news.
Rémi argues that Chandrar needs a paper of its own, since with one or two papers the news can be controlled.
Rémi is the Editor-in-Chief of the newspaper Chandrar International, one of three international newspapers in circulation.
Chandrar International has the weakest initial sales on the first day, but by day's end Runner's Guilds are asked for it.
Customers cite layout, more impartial reporting, attention to detail, and the Editor-in-Chief's own fame as reasons to buy Chandrar International.
Chandrar International has paid for itself, its equipment and salaries by the end of the first day.
Rémi reports the Clash at Medain without the victorious tones of the other two newspapers.
Ressa is the [Head Maid] in service to Lady Magnolia Reinhart, and the head of her staff.
Ressa looks almost inhumanly good, which is a feature of her class, and is also stern and imposing like a head matron or queen.
Ressa is cold and austere, and unconcerned by weapons pointed at her.
Ressa is a silent [Head Maid] who accompanies her mistress everywhere and can be as quiet as a falling leaf.
Ressa is Magnolia's childhood friend, and Magnolia's right hand and best friend.
Ressa is Magnolia's long-time friend, whose mouth tightens in a way only Magnolia notices.
Ressa is a [Maid] who was trained like an [Assassin] and inherited the best Skills of both classes.
Ressa uses an intimidation effect with her glare that makes servants flinch, but it does not work on Erin Solstice.
Ressa moves at near-invisible speed, hearing through a closed hatch in a speeding carriage.
Ressa casts [Invisibility Field] from the carriage and throws throwing stars at a Hobgoblin on a Carn Wolf.
Ressa wears a magical shield that vaporizes weapons and flesh that touch her.
Ressa walks on ceilings and drops twenty feet to the floor as part of testing her staff.
Ressa wields a magical dagger called the Vision of Grasses, given to her by Regis Reinhart, coated with many poisons.
Ressa uses summoning talismans from Drath, including one that calls a Hydra.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Ressa is a head maid whom Valceif has worked to get on the good side of, and she reacts dramatically at Ryoka Griffin's name.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Ressa leads Erin through the Reinhart mansion with two maids and servants bobbing their heads, introducing herself as the [Head Maid].

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Ressa agrees to let Erin look at the mansion's displays after Erin asks politely and appears unaffected.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Ressa closes a door and locks it from the outside with a key from her pocket.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: When Erin throws a teapot at Magnolia, Ressa catches it, shields Magnolia from the hot liquid and reaches for Erin's throat before Magnolia says stop.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: On Magnolia's word, Ressa smacks Erin lightly on the back of the head, and does so again when Erin says guns would be bad.

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Magnolia warns Ressa that Erin would hit her back, since Erin has [Bar Fighting] and [Minotaur Punch].

section: Book 2: Erin Solstice and the Reinhart mansion
text: Ressa disapproves of the heavily sweetened raspberry tea Magnolia drinks and has said so many times before.
Reynold and Ressa arrive in Ocre in a horseless noble carriage to summon Ryoka to Magnolia's estate.
Ressa tells Ryoka that Lady Reinhart is expecting her.
Asked what happens if Ryoka refuses, Ressa answers "Feel free to try", and refuses to give any promises.
Ressa tells Ryoka she will go with her, or be brought against her will.
Ressa asks Ryoka in the carriage whether she would like to be hit, and Ryoka falls silent.
Ressa orders the carriage inspected and the spell lattice tested because [Invisibility Field] should not have failed to a mere unenchanted bolt.
Ryoka guesses Ressa is a [Ninja], and Magnolia laughs, saying Ressa is a [Maid] and [Assassins] are the class of choice here.
Ressa stops Ryoka's punch at Magnolia, and Ryoka never sees her move.
Magnolia asks if Ressa took a teapot to the face from Erin, and Ressa corrects that it was to the chest and was lukewarm tea.
Ressa blocks an [Assassin] with her chest, kills him with her fingers and flicks projectiles back at the others.
Ressa swallows a mage's fireball with a mirror from her skirt and throws a tripvine bag that engulfs his Golems.
Ressa holds the carriage door for Magnolia at a social event, with servants backing off like prey from a hunter.
Ressa travels with Magnolia, and the staff includes Janica, Bekia, a Gnoll [Maid], Jefry and the driver Alkran, whose arm was broken by assassins.
Ressa tells Reynold that the matter is important enough that he must drive back at once.
Magnolia says Ressa glares out of protectiveness and nagging, and Zel adds that she is armed.
Magnolia tells Zel Shivertail that Ressa is her protector.
Ressa wrinkles her nose at the mud on stepping out at the officers' camp.
Ressa rates Magnolia's speech four out of five, not the sort given on the precipice of a battle but stirring enough.
Ressa stabs a Ghoul in the back with the Vision of Grasses, as some of its poisons still paralyze the undead.
Ressa fights Ghouls beside the [Assassin] Theofore, telling him to shut up and stab.
Ressa rises before dawn and flits from shadow to shadow inspecting hallways for dust and infiltration, and the staff fears her.
Ressa tests combat-capable staff on her patrol, passing the Gnoll Bekia.
Ressa eats porridge and fruit in under a minute, and is at Magnolia's bedside as she wakes.
Ressa avoids Magnolia's punch, since being both [Assassin] and [Maid] means Magnolia cannot hit her.
Ressa leaps out of the carriage at the Circle of Thorns' ambush, slashing with the Vision of Grasses.
Ressa takes three cuts from a [Blademaster Assassin] without damage to her uniform, and throws summoning talismans while other maids call for help.
Ressa recognizes the old [Trapmaster] Sithorn among the assassins and is stunned.
Revi is a Stitch-girl, a person made of cloth, and a Gold-rank [Summoner] of the adventuring team Griffon Hunt.
Revi is in her late twenties and is impatient.
In Book 2, Revi is the newest addition to Griffon Hunt.
Revi is not a [Necromancer], as she tells Halrac.
Revi is a [Mage] of a different specialisation from Typhenous, who is a generalist focused on defensive magic and wards.
Revi changes her hairstyle to short-cropped hair for the wet season, though she still tosses her head as if she had a ponytail.
Revi sews her own ears back onto her head, and Typhenous takes over the needle.
Revi says you cannot kill a Stitch-Girl with a sword.
Revi summons constructs from the memory of souls past by throwing a scrap of fabric into the air.
Revi says her constructs bear some of their previous bodies' power, but have no minds and are not the souls themselves.
Revi's first summon is a tall man in bronze armour with a mace and shield, whom she names as Kelthor.
Revi says not all String People are related and that Kelthor is only a shadow of the warrior he was in life.
Revi says she got Kelthor from her grandmother, and that he has declined in power since her grandmother used him.
Halrac estimates Kelthor at around Level 25.
Revi plans to capture the skeleton's spirit, since she can use a spirit whose memory of life is strong.
Revi says that once a construct dies it is gone, though she could restore it if it were only injured.
Halrac says Revi can conjure spirits of Stitch-warriors or summon other creatures, but her summons cannot think for themselves.
Revi throws five talismans to raise glowing figures, then three String People, two warriors and a staff-wielding mage, against Regrika.
Revi calls on a flaming spectral Corusdeer using a bit of calcified horn.
Revi summons spectral warriors and animals to do her bidding.
Revi summons ghostly warriors and archers, a flaming Corusdeer and two eagles of light on Liscor's wall.
Revi summons a glowing green Face-Eater Moth from a wing in amber and rides it down the street.
Revi's tools are pieces of fallen monsters in amber and talismans made from fallen Stitch-People.
Revi summons eight glowing Stitch-Warriors who hold a line behind Jelaqua against Shield Spiders.
Revi cannot call on the Corusdeer for a week if its spirit is destroyed.
Revi's Corusdeer falls into the monster pit, and she says later she lost it.
Revi uses a wand that shoots weak glowing missiles of light.
Revi's summoned warriors and Corusdeer fight zombies while Halrac shoots a charging Ghoul.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Halrac and Revi get along least well on the team.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi is cut in half by Regrika Blackpaw's blade, and her head and one arm still move.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi tells Erin to sew her together with a needle from her pockets, without worrying about neatness.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi flees from Regrika on a summoned Corusdeer after Erin sews her up.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi complains that the Gold teams work for Erin for free, saying Christmas was fun but this is work.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi grumbles that she did not join Griffon Hunt to work for free.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi asks Ulrien and Halrac to appraise the Horns of Hammerad's extra gear.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi offers to pay more than Typhenous for the ring Pisces holds, and asks to see what it can do.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi gets stabbed in the arm by a camouflaged wall scorpion, pulls her arm off to cut away the envenomed cotton, and needs a healing potion.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Halrac pushes a bowl of soup to Revi and makes her eat it while she complains.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi tries to kill Insill with her wand after Vuliel Drae speak, and Halrac and Typhenous drag her back.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Typhenous webs Revi to stop her cursing.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi says the Halfseekers and the Silver Swords have hit it off, pointing at Jelaqua elbowing Ylawes.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi helps Ceria mark the walls for Calruz, explaining that Griffon Hunt leaves glowing marks at every intersection.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi gives Ceria a vial of glowing liquid to write a sign Calruz might recognise.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi punches Pisces in the face to make him lose control of his undead when he is out of mana.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi and Yvlon tell Selys that the Raskghar treasure was a gift from the Redfang Goblins, so the Adventurer's Guild cannot tax it.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi says the Redfangs were made a team only the day before, and gave the treasure to the three teams three days earlier.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi dances around Moore in celebration when the teams decide to be done with the dungeon.

section: Griffon Hunt and the dungeon, Books 2-9
text: Revi says a mana stone can be triggered by smashing it, though she does not know much about mana stones.
Revi hopes to go home to Chandrar someday, or settle in Izril and have a family.
Revi is thinking of adopting a Gnoll cub, having found Mrsha cute.
Revi's homeland of Doran has been conquered and is now part of the Empire of Sands.
Revi is of the Cotton caste, and her name by Chandrarian address would be Revi Cotton.
Hemp is a caste below Cotton, and Silk is above it.
Revi visits The Silken Touch in Invrisil, run by the Silk-bodied [Seamstress] Dewlana, and announces herself as a Gold-rank adventurer.
Revi asks for all her stitches to be redone in silk thread, without replacing any limbs.
Dewlana's attendants take Revi apart piece by piece and sew her back up.
Revi tells Dewlana she had to re-stitch herself to play baseball, and that she was on the walls against the Goblin Lord.
Revine is known as the Siren of Tides or the Siren of Savere, and unofficially as one of the [Bandit Queens] that plague the world.
Revine commands a mostly female group of [Bandit Ladies] and keeps slave-[Mages] in magical collars.
Revine can blast tonnes of water with a gesture, destroying a dresser full of costly garments.
Revine has a sister.
Revine tells Nsiia at Pomle that the King of Destruction looted Savere, his armies plundering her lands and treasuries.
Revine warns that if Reim's territory expands towards any coast it will not be safe from her wrath or her sister's.
Revine nearly comes to blows with Nsiia, and the watering hole's surface shifts ominously.
Revine rages at a slave-[Mage] because every other nation was warned before her, and she learned of the plan from one of her own people.
Revine orders her fleet pulled back, and calls in the Sandwave Fleet, the Bloodtear Pirates and every [Pirate Captain] within a week's sailing.
Revine orders Urele to kill the Empress of Beasts instead of capturing her.
Revine speaks to Femithain through an enchanted conch held by Urele and demands the Empress be handed over, threatening to challenge Illivere.
Revine goes quiet and cold when Femithain mentions Queen Yisame's claim on Nsiia.
Revine backs down when Femithain says Nerrhavia wants Nsiia and Illivere cannot resist its demand, but says she wants Nsiia.
Revine tells Femithain to keep Nsiia for now and says she will discuss terms when everything is quiet.
Revine says Oliphant is Savere's and that she will deal with General Thelican after this.
Reynold is a [Butler] of the Reinhart house, in the direct employ of Lady Magnolia Reinhart.
Reynold is a very silent man who tells Erin his name only after a few tries.
One of Reynold's duties is overseeing Magnolia's wine collection.
Reynold is also one of Magnolia's personal aides and drives her carriage.
Reynold introduces himself to Ryoka in Invrisil as Reynold Ferusdam, a humble servant of Lady Magnolia Reinhart.
Reynold says he has a few levels in auxiliary classes that inform his main class, though he was never an adventurer.
Reynold fights with a sword and has the Skills [Sickle Cut], [Burst Speed] and [Invisibility Field].
Reynold was once a soldier and says he was a [Lieutenant] commanding a cavalry unit.
Reynold says he fought twice against Drakes in the Bloodfields.
Reynold sets bones in battle and has treated soldiers who cursed his name.
Reynold is called a [Combat Butler].
Reynold uses Magnolia's pink magical carriage as a weapon, running down assassins with it.
Reynold repeats that the invitation is extended to Miss Solstice alone, while Lyonette screams and throws things at him.
Reynold drives Erin home after her meeting with Magnolia and declines her offer of a meal or a bed.
Reynold arrives at the inn where Ryoka is, with a horseless carriage, and says Magnolia wants her.
Reynold says he will not force Ryoka to come, but cautions that Magnolia did not send only him.
Ressa, Magnolia's head [Maid], steps out of the carriage to say Lady Reinhart is expecting Ryoka.
Reynold drives from an exposed seat outside the carriage, and the carriage moves without horses.
Reynold stays composed, though pale, after driving through a Goblin army.
Reynold tells Ryoka that Erin mentioned her worry for Ryoka's safety.
Reynold lowers his voice to tell Ryoka that Magnolia is driven but cares deeply for her servants and everyone on the continent.
Ressa, inside the carriage, orders Reynold to stop talking.
Reynold treats Ryoka's head with a healing potion beside a dead Gnoll [Assassin].
Reynold tells Ryoka that Magnolia will go to war after the attempt on her.
Reynold and Sacra catch the last [Assassin] as he flees, and he is dead.
Reynold is assigned to guide Ryoka in Invrisil only, with an advisory role.
Reynold tells Ryoka that the other Earth people are learning to become adventurers southeast of Invrisil.
Reynold says his orders are to accompany Ryoka everywhere in Invrisil.
Reynold says Ressa gave him precise instructions for what to do if Ryoka offered him violence.
Reynold tells Ryoka that Magnolia has not authorised him to drive her anywhere but Liscor, and that she can run herself.
Reynold drives his pink carriage into the Goblin advance party, beheading a Goblin leader on a Shield Spider with [Sickle Cut].
He uses [Burst Speed] to escape the arrows and [Invisibility Field] to vanish when a Goblin with black eyes and white pupils fires black bolts at him.
Reynold buys time for fleeing villagers while arrows hit his arm and shoulder, and he is hit hard enough to feel his world growing dark.
Reynold faints after the long drive, as Ressa lets out a huge breath.
Reynold is healed and handles the levy lists for Zel with Sacra, a [Maid] who is also Odveig.
Magnolia praises Reynold for buying villagers time and warns him to rest.
Reynold drives the carriage to the officers' camp where Magnolia and Zel address the army.
Reynold says the speech deserves a hundred out of a hundred points, while Ressa gives four of five.
Reynold delivers adventurers willing to fight, the Gold-rank Fire Fingers and the Silver-rank Embryion's Delight, to the battlefield.
Magnolia had quadrupled her reward within the hour.
Reynold says the Goblin Lord's death magic resembles one the Necromancer used and may be a weaker version.
Reynold leads the cavalry of Captain Salvia away from the Goblins, shouting like a rude drill officer.
Reynold drives Magnolia's carriage into the Goblins and hacks at the [Beastmaster] Eggsnatcher on his spider.
Reynold flies the carriage over Goblin pikes with [Flying Wheels].
A midnight bolt from the Goblin Lord strikes Reynold, and the carriage crashes across the front lines.
Zel reaches the coach, revives Reynold with a potion, and rides away with him.
Reynold tells Zel he can fly the carriage again but is wary because the Goblin Lord is an expert shot.
Reynold swerves the flying carriage to avoid the Goblin Lord's black bolts as Zel drops from it.
Reynold and Sacra beat a fleeing [Thug Boss] and leave him for the Watch, noting that Magnolia's hands-off policy in Invrisil is only a rumour.
Reynold delivers Magnolia's decree taxing use of the Invrisil door at six silver per visitor, with an exemption for Erin and her staff.
The decree bans correspondence, merchandise and goods through the door without a signatory agreement, enforced by Magnolia's [Written Decree].
Reynold tells Erin that Magnolia can be cruel but not wrong, citing the Black Tide, and asks her not to insult Magnolia in his presence.
Lyonette tells Reynold that Magnolia treats others like disposable objects, and she hopes he is never a piece in her games.
During an assassin attack, Reynold charges the [Blademaster] with [Double Slash], and has his legs severed.
After losing his legs, Reynold tries to crawl forward and slashes at the [Assassin]'s legs.
Richard is a [Knight] from Earth who leads the group summoned to Rhir, and Tom calls him the strongest person in the group by far.
Richard grew up in Mississippi on a ranch, and knows how to ride a horse and tends his own.
Richard wears a cowboy Stetson over his armor, and Tom admits he pulls it off.
Richard says "Ma'am" and "Sir" to everyone no matter how often he is corrected, since in Rhir people are called Miss or Mister.
Richard is a young man with dark skin who wears a wide-brimmed hat and plate armor.
Richard is a Level 26 [Knight].
Later, Richard and Emily are over Level 30.
Later, Richard is a [Hero] as well, like Edward, who has decided to fight the Demons.
Later, a report says that some of those under Lord Hayvon, like Richard, are approaching Level 40.
Richard is Muslim, which differs from Lord Hayvon's view that the gods are dead.
Richard flies in the air with Boots of Flight, which are slower than a horse.
Richard wears an enchanted red cloak and carries a Ring of Featherfalling.
Richard wields a massive sword as though it weighed nothing at the breach.
Richard decides they must keep the iPhone secret rather than ask the mages for help, because the Blighted King does not seem to know about the other groups.
Richard refuses to trust Wistram's mages in case they take the iPhone.
Richard is referred to as Sir Richard in the Blighted Kingdom and travels with Lord Hayvon's followers.
Richard laughs as he flies and salutes Lord Hayvon, feeling like a superhero.
Richard leads [Giant's Sword] into a gap in the wall with Emily clearing the way, called the Champion of Rhir.
Richard's presence inspires the [Soldiers], and Cirille sees him cut down a Demon commander.
Eddy and Vincent fight in the same breach, with Cirille judging them as good as Gold-ranks.
Rie Valerund is a [Lady] of Invrisil, the last member of the Valerund family, who lives in a mansion near a small town.
Rie is a calm, calculating [Lady], with dark purple hair that Durene suspects may be dyed.
Rie sends Laken goat milk and baby powder for the children he protects, with a verbal message since he is blind.
Rie and her remaining guard count weapons in her mansion, with few bows but a surplus of arrows.
Rie carries a poison she plans to take rather than suffer indignities, telling Geram everyone has plans for the end.
Rie kneels to Laken in the mud with Geram and Nesor, and the soldiers kneel after her.
Rie says she no longer considers her home safe after the Goblin attack, and that she would be dead but for Laken.
Rie pledges herself as Laken's vassal after the Goblin attack, arriving in Riverfarm three days before the gathering.
Rie places her fortune at the Unseen Empire's disposal, calling it a gift for saving her life.
Rie offers to order supplies from Invrisil and other cities abroad.
Rie touches Laken's arm and stands close, and Laken concludes she is flirting with him.
Rie tells Laken that Lord Tilwa is testing him with his letter, and advises leaving it unanswered for a day or two.
Rie calls Magnolia Reinhart dangerous, ruthless and cunning, and thinks the gathering is without a doubt a trap, possibly to kill him.
Rie pushes for a banquet hall built from the best lumber and expensive furnishings and silverware from Invrisil.
Rie agrees that older people should wait the tables rather than younger servants.
Rie tells Durene she should stand at attendance rather than sit at the head table, and suggests she wear armor.
Rie suggests a helmet with a visor for Durene, which Laken understands is meant to cover her face.
Rie tells Laken that refugees are converging on Riverfarm, and that she has received two dozen [Messages] begging for his protection.
Rie is mortified that Nesor was drawn away by Lady Bevia, and is unable to say where Nesor went.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Durene remembers hating Rie and fearing she would seduce Laken, but now finds her jealousy fades and smiles at Rie.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie's captain of the guard is Geram, a bald former [Fistfighter] with scarred knuckles who escorts her as an assistant.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie says Lancrel's people blame Laken for their destroyed city and that some council members want a voice in running Riverfarm.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie says the hard core of dissenters is only a hundred or perhaps two hundred.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie says the rest of Lancrel's people believe the Goblins were a ruse or manipulated by Laken.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie wants Wiskeria to return as [General] and wants Durene armed.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie sent to her estates for a truth stone for a trial, due by the end of the day.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie has sold her dresses and jewelry to finance Riverfarm, and fears Magnolia Reinhart will escalate the trade war.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie's estates are far richer than Riverfarm and only a day's ride away.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie says a guild can run out of a root cellar with Runner's Seals, something to record requests and money to pay Runners.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie attends a meeting flanked by her bodyguard Geram and Nesor, and recalls Belavierr as the Temptress of Izril.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie tells Laken the armed Goblins are dangerous, but Laken says they outsmarted him by doing nothing.

section: Riverfarm after the Goblins, Books 12 and 15
text: Rie lives in Riverfarm in a terribly tiny house, and Ieka picks her up for a meeting.
Rie is a member of the Circle of Thorns, of higher rank than Ieka, though Ieka is the richer [Lady].
Rie is second only to the Petals of Death in the Circle and has authority to recommend actions to it.
Rie's house was all but erased in the Goblin King's rampage and the Sacrifice of Roses.
Rie tells the Circle she believes Emperor Godart is an ally and says she is in his confidences while exposing none of its plans.
The Circle asks Ieka to quit her cabal with Ladies Bedai and Therris and bring them into its fold.
Rie says her investigation found Griffon Hunt caused the Griffin Plague two years ago and has lost at least three members.
Laken suspects Rie ordered the attack on the Goblins and tried to kill Magnolia's [Maid], an idea Ryoka gave him.
Rie tells Laken the Goblins should not be a sticking point.
Rie helps organise Ryoka's party as good public relations for the Unseen Empire.
Rie is one of three Circle operatives in the area, the largest, and the other two monitor her work with Laken.
Rie's aim is to persuade Laken to embrace the Circle of Thorns, or else the Circle would cut him.
Rie tells Laken the Circle of Thorns is unknown, perhaps not even Izrilian.
Rie makes a mistake by hurrying off to contact the Circle instead of watching carefully.
Rievan Forstrom is a tall, dark-haired senior [Mage] in robes who runs the new students' magic lesson at Wistram.
Rievan teaches the Magical Foundations class, which Ceria and Pisces take as probationary students.
Rievan teaches basic or pure magic, covering telekinesis, magical composition and spellcraft, a branch most mages find boring.
