Wiskeria and Odveig are old friends, and Wiskeria joined the Celestial Trackers only about two months earlier.
Wiskeria can manipulate animals, once pulling a Corusdeer's fur and later summoning a herd to fight Snow Golems.
Wiskeria hesitates when Laken asks whether she has already sent word to Invrisil that he is an [Emperor], and she apologises.
Wiskeria explains, as hearsay, that a Goblin tribe left rescued women outside Merendia's gates and that a Great Goblin Chieftain lives on Dwarfhalls Rest.
Wiskeria says the Goblins left in the mountain raid with Hobgoblins and real weapons after another tribe splintered away.
Wiskeria pulls the arrow from the poisoned Beniar and applies a mash.
Wiskeria pounds roots, dried bugs and an egg into a paste that neutralises the poison in Beniar.
Wiskeria admits she took Mossbear fur while the creature slept, claiming it was a precaution, and says Odveig insisted on the escort contract.
Wiskeria says the Celestial Trackers normally take monster-extermination and scouting contracts, plus occasional requests from the Reinhart family.
Wiskeria uses [Paralyzing Touch] on Laken in order to escape.
Wiskeria gives four-in-ten odds that a party planting Laken's markers is attacked, if it moves fast and keeps to the open.
Laken orders Wiskeria to take Durene and plant seven markers four miles from Riverfarm.
Wiskeria apologises to Laken for casting a spell on him, hiding the Mossbear fur and Odveig's actions, and says the fur was meant to drive the Mossbear off.
Wiskeria believes the Celestial Trackers are finished and that she cannot return to Invrisil.
Wiskeria becomes a Level 4 [General] overnight after the battle, as most villagers level up.
Wiskeria blasts a Hob with small jolts of lightning from horseback while her riders hunt down Goblin stragglers.
Wiskeria is a [Witch] and Laken's [General], though she had been only a Silver-rank adventurer before he made her one.
Wiskeria never learned [Message], since that kind of magic is difficult for her class.
Wiskeria says she can gather the hellebore and other ingredients for her plan within one day.
Wiskeria prepares a poison smoke of hellebore leaves, charcoal and a white parasitic root, fanned from cauldrons into the Goblin camp.
Wiskeria points out that the army has under eight hundred soldiers while the Goblins still number over six thousand.
A messenger relays that Wiskeria thinks the Goblins changed leaders, and she fears a trap and asks Laken to wait another day.
Wiskeria suspects the tribe is the Redfang Tribe, though Rie later reports a peace offer from the Flooded Waters tribe.
Wiskeria asks Durene to persuade Laken to delay the attack by a day or two.
Wiskeria receives a [Message] ordering an immediate attack, and two follow-ups return the same reply.
Wiskeria casts [Fox Fire] at Pyrite and is forced back when Noears fires lightning from the city walls.
Wiskeria tells Tyrion Veltras that she just obtained her [General] class, untrained, as a gift from Laken.
A healer tells Durene that her [Witch] friend stopped potions that were worsening the illness and saved her life with her craft.
Wiskeria resigns as [General], saying she got everyone killed and should not lead.
Wiskeria weeps for the dead as a [Witch], though she could not as a [General], and stops crying as easily as she began.
Wiskeria says her mother never taught her how to cry or mourn properly.
Wiskeria says she is a Level 12 [General] with two good battle Skills but is no trainer of armies.
Wiskeria lets villagers such as Rehanna throw rocks at her, saying she deserves them for the deaths she caused.
Wiskeria says [Witches] must belong to a coven, and that a [Witch] alone is probably a bad one.
Wiskeria insists that no [Witch] she knows has levels in [Necromancer].
Wiskeria addresses Riverfarm in public for the first time since the battle.
Wiskeria says Beniar will lead things with his Darksky Riders until Laken returns, as she will not reform the army.
Wiskeria introduces herself as a [Witch] and [General], mostly a [Witch], and has not risen above Level 30 as a [Witch].
Wiskeria tells the families that their dead died heroically, and a girl hears that her brother Randil, a Level 14 [Warrior], was brave.
Wiskeria tells a [Farmer] that his daughter Iglief, an [Archer], fell as the Goblins overran the right while the archers held them.
Wiskeria says spells last hours and charms last days, such as a dust charm that deflects water.
Wiskeria says she cannot make healing potions, though she made poison for Laken, because [Alchemists] have the equipment and knowledge.
Wiskeria cooks a ritual soup with intent and goodwill that she says cannot be repeated, adding her own wrist blood.
Wiskeria says [Witches] are most numerous in Izril and Terandria, few live in Chandrar or Baleros, and most covens are Human.
Wiskeria recognises Mavika by name when the [Witch] reveals herself on a rooftop.
Wiskeria orders Belavierr to leave Riverfarm, denies being her daughter, and claims the town as her own.
Wiskeria accepts the coven of Mavika, Hedag, Eloise, Califor, Nanette and Alevica and tips her hat to all but Belavierr.
Wiskeria tells Belavierr she is unwelcome, unwanted and unloved.
Wiskeria asks Belavierr after Ostevien, and Belavierr answers "Who?" while Califor, Eloise, Hedag and Mavika react to the name.
Wiskeria banishes Belavierr with a three-fold chant and a shove that sends the taller [Witch] back several steps.
Wiskeria tells the village that Belavierr is her mother, whom she has not seen for at least thirteen years.
Wiskeria says no one bests her mother and wonders whether the Hero of Zethe returned to fight her.
Wiskeria names Hedag, Eloise and Nanette as the good [Witches] and Mavika, Alevica and Belavierr as the selfish ones.
Wiskeria calls Califor mostly good, but a terror among [Witches] who helps those who help themselves.
Wiskeria says Belavierr is a [Stitch Witch] and warns Ryoka never to speak with her alone.
Wiskeria apologises to six [Witches] for rudeness, since she thought she was being inducted into Mavika's coven without knowing the circumstances.
Wiskeria is counted among the eight [Witches] gathered at Riverfarm.
Wiskeria calls herself a glorified adventurer, closer to a [Hedge Witch] than a real [Witch].
Wiskeria tells her mother she wanted to find her place by herself, and that one favour she asked has been a regret all her life.
Wiskeria becomes a [Witch] after her mother's lessons, having first been a [Mage] and [Sewer], and leaves after seeing her mother for who she truly was.
Wiskeria accompanies a relief mission as Riverfarm's [General], giving Beniar orders because "Miss Califor's always right".
Wiskeria is frozen in horror when she sees Rehanna holding the stitched cloth infant that Belavierr made.
Wiskeria explains that the cloth doll is an illusion that works if the viewer wishes, is not alive, and that the deal with Rehanna was fair.
Wiskeria says Mavika found her after she ran from her mother.
Wiskeria warns Rehanna that her son will never grow up, but Rehanna says she is happy and begs to keep him.
Wiskeria throws her hat to find her mother, and the hat leads her on a seventeen-minute chase.
Wiskeria recounts that Ostevien was her childhood friend, that Belavierr saved him after a Griffin fall and protected Kaliv, and that it ended in his exile.
Wiskeria tells Ryoka that Ostevien, called the Griffin Prince of Kaliv, the Cursed Prince, is cursed never to die.
Wiskeria tells her mother that she hates what she is and hates her.
Wiskeria says Laken met the fair folk in the spring, which leaves Ryoka desperate to speak to him.
Wiskeria recoils when Belavierr reaches for her hand after Ser Raim's death.
Wiskeria accuses Belavierr of threatening her friend Ostevien and of talking Tagil into killing his friends.
Belavierr answers that she made such bargains to protect herself, and that all of them chose freely.
Wiskeria stabs at Belavierr with a blood charm and an air-blade chant, and both fail.
Belavierr tells Wiskeria she lacks a craft, and Wiskeria says she owes that lack to her mother.
Wiskeria calls down lightning on Belavierr with the word "Justice", then catches the stray lightning and sends it skyward.
Wiskeria vows to become a [Witch] who ends what her mother does, and calls that her craft.
Wiskeria asks Califor to make her an apprentice, and Califor refuses because Nanette is her only apprentice.
Wiskeria swears on her life to the ghost of Califor to keep Nanette safe.
Wiskeria proposes sinking a poison cauldron to fight the Crelers, killing everything there for three years.
Wiskeria warns that Crelers resist hexes and that the Darksky Riders cannot handle swarming ones.
Wrymvr is a Prognugator of the Antinium Hives and a member of the Centenium, known to other races as Wrymvr the Deathless.
Xrn calls Wrymvr different from herself and Klbkch, since each of the three was created for a different role.
Wrymvr was created to defend the Grand Queen and to be undefeatable.
Xrn calls Wrymvr a fool but says he is strong, and treats the history's praise of his strength as accurate.
In the Second Antinium War the Grand Queen released Wrymvr from his role as protector, and he was unleashed against the Drakes.
Wrymvr led an Antinium army against an army from Pallass in the war's second battle, which overran the Drake formations in minutes.
Wrymvr rampaged unchecked behind Drake lines and actively hunted Drake commanders during battle.
Multiple armies tried and failed to slay Wrymvr, which earned him the title of Deathless.
Wrymvr arrived with the Flying Antinium in the battle where Klbkch tried to save a Queen, and Xrn says his arrival saved the Queen.
In that battle the other Flying Antinium glided down like grasshoppers, but only Wrymvr truly flew, screeching wordlessly.
After Tallis the Stormbreaker's victories, the Grand Queen ordered Klbkch, Wrymvr and Xrn to break the Goblin King's might at any cost.
Wrymvr slew a Goblin Lord in personal combat, further damaging the Goblin King's leadership.
At the Antinium council of Queens, the Twisted Queen says Wrymvr will slay Magnolia Reinhart if she can wage war with her Skills.
The Twisted Queen tells Klbkch that Wrymvr wishes to speak with him and asks him to visit the Twisted Antinium.
Wrymvr is one of the oldest Centenium, made before Xrn, who was among the last.
Wrymvr's base form is an Elder Creler, modelled on one of the Antinium's greatest foes from a dark place.
Wrymvr's body has changed greatly since Klbkch last saw him, which is his power.
Wrymvr drops from where he was watching, and the Twisted Antinium flee his presence.
Anand takes Wrymvr for an Elder Creler and attacks, but his sword bounces off the armor until Klbkch stops him.
Xrn had called Wrymvr unstable, unchanging, rude and violent, and Klbkch thinks that was an understatement.
Wrymvr has never died, not even at the battle where Xrn lost her life, and he survived the depths of the sea when no other Centenium did.
Wrymvr has no mercy for other Antinium, since his role was to accompany War Queens into battle and protect them.
Wrymvr screams from multiple mouths, spraying venom, then speaks to Klbkch through the link all Antinium share.
Wrymvr cannot speak aloud, since his mouths were not designed for it, and talks only to Xrn, Klbkch and the other Queens by link.
Wrymvr says the Twisted Antinium's guards did not attack, because the spire of minds attacks all and only Wrymvr frightens them.
Wrymvr and Klbkch laugh together, and Wrymvr's laughter sounds like hissing, clicking and muted shrieks.
Wrymvr, Klbkch and the Twisted Queen debate how the Antinium could cross the sea to Terandria.
Klbkch asks Wrymvr whether he could kill the Illusionist, and Wrymvr answers yes through the link.
At the council a sending states there is no way to win at sea against experts and that only Wrymvr has survived the depths.
A sending after Wrymvr echoes Klbkch's frustration says that magic cannot steal Wrymvr, so he would be alone if teleported.
Wrymvr projects an image of Minotaur weapons destroying wooden ships.
Lady Wuvren is a [Lady] of Izril who looks about twenty-eight although she is nearly sixty years old.
Wuvren's skin and hair are as youthful as they ever were, though she sometimes seems older in her manner, voice and the age in her eyes.
Wuvren has a son, Gilliad, a stately man with a trimmed chestnut beard who looks older than she does and calls her mother.
Wuvren is called the [Eternal Beauty], and people who meet her fall in love with her.
Wuvren is called the most beautiful [Lady] in all of Izril, with an appearance that always belies her age.
Wuvren has held her place on the lists of the top ten [Ladies] to marry since she turned sixteen, about fifty years.
Wuvren is said to be over sixty and to be always third place at worst in the beauty rankings.
Wuvren charms people with her voice and eyes, and an [Assassin] warns his companions not to look at her because she has "charmed eyes".
Wuvren uses [Heartbreaker Kiss], flicking two fingers from her lips to leave an [Assassin] clutching her chest without killing her.
Pryde says Wuvren claims to have charmed a Troll once.
Pryde later refers to Wuvren's Troll, called the Baron, as someone Wuvren could have brought as a bodyguard.
Wuvren is entertaining guests at an estate open to callers when [Assassins] leap in through windows and demand her head.
Wuvren pushes her son back, pushes the leader's blade away from her chest and talks the female [Assassin] into lowering her weapon.
Wuvren's guests and guards catch three [Assassins], and she remarks that she nearly had the young woman.
Wuvren says she is not like Bethal, Magnolia or Zanthia and prefers to break hearts rather than kill, and sends Gilliad to learn who the attackers were.
Wuvren asks for word to be sent that she needs to speak to Magnolia.
Wuvren stands with Zanthia and Ieka in the semicircle of [Ladies] facing Belavierr.
Wuvren shudders and nearly steps back when Belavierr turns on her, and Pryde and Bethal steady her.
Wuvren's voice trembles with the strain as the [Ladies] circle Belavierr.
Wuvren helps Zanthia lift the stricken Pryde after Belavierr strikes her down.
Wuvren visits the Wandering Inn with Magnolia and Pryde in modern Earth-style dress, with her hair braided in Earth fashion.
Wuvren blows a kiss at Grimalkin, who is suddenly polite and formal, and apologises to him for it.
Wuvren, as the coach pulls away, says Erin has charm-related Skills, probably [Crowd Control], and could start a riot if she wished.
Wuvren looks closer to her actual age as the coach leaves Liscor.
Xalandrass is a male Naga [Merchant] and war vendor with golden scales and jeweled clothing, at least nine feet tall.
Xalandrass invites Ken to call him Xal, since he knows Humans are not as adept at speaking as other races.
Xalandrass enjoys being admired and wiggles his tail appreciatively when Ken stares at him.
Xalandrass recognises Ken at once as a Human he has seen before, though they have never spoken.
Xalandrass says he sold Evercut arrows to the Roving Arrow company and shares some blame for an attack on those who hired them.
Xalandrass buys an Evercut arrowhead back from Ken for red, white and black paint plus coin.
Xalandrass offers Ken other wares, including a charm that amplifies the voice, a favourite of commanders like Quallet.
Xalandrass fishes for information about the Last Light, and Ken declines to say anything he has no right to.
Xalandrass hopes Ken will speak of his fairness and send the Last Light to him for healing potions or needles.
Xalandrass noted that another person had come to him with a device that made light.
Xalandrass has a deep cut down his tail after his camp was attacked and heals it with a potion.
Xalandrass crushed at least six soldiers who attacked his camp, breaking their bones with his tail.
Xalandrass throws open his stores to supply Gravetender's Fist and others with enchanted weapons and potions.
Xalandrass joins forces with the neutral captains and tends his wounds in a corner of Quallet's tent.
Xalandrass suspects both companies attacked Geneva's camp, though he would bet the Dullahans broke conduct first.
Xalandrass warns that both sides will want no witnesses to their attacks on neutral parties and will kill Geneva.
Xalandrass lends Ken his most powerful voice-amplifying ring so Ken can address the battlefield.
Ken names Xalandrass, along with Quallet and Exara, as a neutral party in the conflict.
Xalandrass's fortunes turned south after being caught up in the incident with the Razorshard Armor company.
Xalandrass tries to bribe his way to the front of a queue with two hundred gold pieces, as much as he can afford.
Xalandrass tells Niers that the Last Light of Baleros took part in the battle, and that he observed her work.
Xalandrass shows Niers a flashlight that he obtained from strange Humans on the battlefield.
Xalandrass explains he got the flashlight when mercenaries from a suppression company bartered it for alcohol.
Xalandrass also shows Niers iPhones, which he took from the dead by trading with Dullahan soldiers.
Xalandrass learns the iPhones can be [Repaired] and tells Niers so.
Niers buys Xalandrass's information, the artifacts and his silence, offering a price in gold plus business deals.
Niers has Peclir bring a purple cloth-covered item as payment for the silence of Xalandrass and his [Mage] friend.
Xif is a Gnoll [Alchemist] who runs the shop Cunning Crafts in Pallass, on the ninth floor among the alchemists' houses.
Xif calls himself a City Gnoll and has shaggy tan fur stained every colour and singed in two places.
Xif smells overwhelmingly of chemicals and says his sense of smell has mostly gone as a byproduct of his work.
Xif claims to be only the second-best [Alchemist] in Pallass and says someone far more specialised is better than him.
Xif is the most famous regular [Alchemist] in Pallass, specialised in selling his creations, and is Saliss' friend or rival.
Xif says he specialises in plant work, with [Poison Immunity] and [Perfect Reduction] among his focused Skills.
Xif invokes [The Avid Collector] to force a sale: Erin must name a price for one Faerie Flower, and she says 220 gold.
Xif is invited by Erin to the inn's gathering and meets Krshia's Liscorian Gnolls, shaking a paw like a Drake instead of sniffing.
Xif says he is not one for politics and came because he had met Erin and heard of interesting sights at the inn.
Xif says the Gnolls may have done a great disservice to the white-furred, though he is no Plains Gnoll.
Erin tells Xif that Mrsha is not cursed and has been nothing but good to the inn; Xif answers that tradition runs deep.
Xif buys one Faerie Flower for 220 gold from Erin, pulling out a bag of holding and stacking the coins on a table.
Erin refuses to sell any other flowers to Xif, saying they were a very important gift.
Xif tells Octavia he does not take apprentices and would only consider one whose Skillset lay outside his own.
Xif says most [Alchemists] will be able to copy Octavia's matches once they arrive in Pallass.
Xif offers to recommend Octavia's matches to his [Merchants], who travel north of Pallass in winter, and to discuss pricing.
Xif asks Numbtongue, the first Goblin he has met, to sell his nail clippings and offers to pay.
Xif has one sample of Erin's flower, which he finds extremely psychedelic and strongly magical, and he plans to send it to Oteslia.
Xif says he tried and failed twice to grow the flower and will not risk his single sample.
Xif regrets pushing Erin so fast over the flowers but says he must have more.
Xif shouts through a speaking stone outside Saliss' hidden lab, demanding entry while Octavia is being taught.
Xif offers Saliss a flower cutting or his Alloyshine Oil recipe in exchange for being let in.
Xif and Saliss teach Octavia an orgasm potion that is outlawed in Pallass, brewing it in Xif's shop with his ingredients.
Xif made one dose of the potion beforehand because he knew Octavia was coming.
Xif tells Saliss that the Walled Cities' ban on such potions was Saliss' doing.
Saliss lets Xif keep two bottles of the teaching batch and promises to put him back in Erin's good books.
Xol of Ingrilt is a Dullahan [Juggernaut], one of the largest and most famous War Walkers in the Iron Vanguard company, in crimson armour with silver inlays.
Xol is fourteen feet tall when standing and was crouching when he hid before charging.
Xol is often seen with Tulm's personal vanguard.
A smaller Dullahan carries Xol's head, which is far larger than normal and wears the same helmet.
Xol charges the students, catching a thrown tripvine bag and sending a student flying.
Xol catches Peki mid-air with [Attraction Shield], slams her down and lifts Merrik before dropping him.
Xol tells Luan that using children to win a game is wrong, a thing no [Strategist] would do.
Xol agrees when Tulm says he wants the sword Wil holds, answering "If desire were deed."
Xol sits with Tulm after the loss, and Tulm says he would have paid even Xol for victory.
Xol asks Zevai's Adventuring Guild for a personal nonlethal bounty on Luan the City Runner.
Xol asks for superficial beatings and the destruction of Luan's boat, with no permanent damage.
Xrn is an azure-carapaced Antinium with swirling multicolored eyes, a slim body and only two arms, who stands out from every other Antinium in Liscor's Hive.
Xrn is the Prognugator of the Grand Queen of the Antinium, known by her enemies as the Small Queen.
Xrn's class is [Thaumaturge], and what she works is Wonders rather than ordinary magic.
Xrn carries a staff, which she raises to cast her spells.
Her eyes change color with her mood, such as orange and red, cold blue-grey, or a swirling vortex of colors.
Xrn tells Klbkch that the Custodium are partial Prognugators with natural blades of a dark substance, four of whom accompany her.
Pawn blocks Klbkch with twenty Soldiers as Klbkch and Xrn stand ready to fight in the street, while Guardsmen form a line.
Xrn casts [Featherfall] to slow a fall, and she is named "Xrn the Small Queen" when she meets Zel.
Xrn finds Klbkch at the inn at Christmas and watches the mistletoe kisses with fascination.
Xrn scolds Klbkch for running off to the inn and avoiding her for the fifth time, and asks whether his Queen knows.
Xrn tells Zel that of all those who fought in the Antinium Wars she was the one who never fell.
Xrn tells Zel that she was there when General Sserys died but did not kill him, and that a single thrust to the heart was dealt by Wrymvr the Deathless.
Xrn tells Klbkch that her class is [Thaumaturge], and she conjures ice, fire, lightning and magma on his desk.
Xrn says she has regained almost all her lost levels but has not told the Grand Queen of her leveling for a long period.
Xrn says she came against the Grand Queen's wishes, that the Queen would have preferred Tersk to lead, and that only she, Klbkch and perhaps Wrymvr are competent Prognugators.
Xrn says the Grand Queen does not care whether Klbkch's Hive has created Individuals, and that the Queen of the Silent Antinium sent no envoy.
Xrn reveals that no new Antinium Queens have been born since their arrival on this continent over two decades ago.
Xrn says she has tried repeatedly to create Queens, burned what she created, and proposes that they return to Rhir to recover their lost knowledge.
Xrn plans to learn to sail, pass the Blighted King and the Demon King, and bring back a younger Queen with the necessary knowledge.
Xrn wants the [Strategists] Belgrade and Anand for the plan, and intends to use the flawed Prognugator copies the Grand Queen made, which she encouraged.
Xrn believes the Antinium who fought on in Rhir swore to fight for a thousand years and have continued to do battle.
Xrn says she told Zel to find Wrymvr and thinks Wrymvr and his Queen have gone insane.
Xrn shields Belgrade with her magic, announces herself as the Small Queen, casts [Burning Lightning] against the Crypt Worm, and heals Belgrade's injuries.
Xrn tells Pawn that the duty of the Antinium is to survive and that they go to war and die so that some may live.
Xrn tells the Queen of the Free Antinium that the Grand Queen wants her to return to the Hives.
Ryoka recognizes Xrn as a legend of the Second Antinium War, and Xrn casts [Stomach of the Cow] and [Powerful Digestion] before going to eat.
In the Antinium Wars Xrn casts [Venomous Snow], [Thunderstrike Volley], [Chaos Flamewheel] and [Glorious Radiance], and is struck in the chest by an arrow.
Xrn tells the others that Klbkch was created as a warrior and assassin, she was meant to cast magic, and Wrymvr was meant to defend the Grand Queen.
Xrn says the Centenium were made to be heroes.
Xrn thinks of Tersk as an ill-made clone of Galuc with armor, and of her escort as poor copies of true Antinium.
Xrn says she, Klbkch and Wrymvr were ordered to break the Goblin King's might, and that Tallis Stormbreaker could not repeat his grand spell when the second and third armies were sent.
The Grand Queen lost three armies to the Goblin King's forces before she stopped fighting in open engagements.
Xrn proposes that the Antinium shelter Liscor's people in the Hives and then claim the city as heroes.
Someone reports that Xrn says the storms were more than winter storms and came from Wistram's mages.
Xrn arrives and strikes Klbkch down with a prismatic ray, telling him he is lost.
Xrn steps into The Wandering Inn, bringing silence.
Xrn, the Small Queen, Centenium and [Thaumaturge], walks into the inn, where Numbtongue has met her before.
Xrn tells Erin that Klbkch is learning to feel, that she has hit him with her staff multiple times, and that he understands only war.
Xrn asks Erin to take more Antinium into the inn, teach them, apprentice Garry and let them eat and play games, and to quarter up to three hundred Antinium near the inn.

Xrn offers Erin ten thousand gold pieces, and a hundred thousand if Erin can create in another Antinium a change like Pawn's, and says she wants an army of at least eight hundred thousand Painted Antinium.
Xrn tells Erin that war is coming and offers to enchant her inn.
Xrn tells Erin that the Drakes continue to war against the Antinium and are right to fear them.
Xrn casts [The Bindings of Belavierr] on Facestealer.
Xrn tells Pawn he may call her "Aunt".
Xrn says over half of the Centenium marched with the First Queen who created them, and that she herself died once.
Xrn tells the Queens they have a new enemy in Magnolia Reinhart and asks that she be designated an entity of maximum threat, like Zel Shivertail.
Xrn says the Painted Antinium must join the other Hives and that she will support Erin from the shadows if needed.
At the Meeting of Druids Xrn stares at Teriarch, and the Dragon recoils and turns hostile.
Xrn leads the Antinium of three Hives and the Painted Antinium into the dungeon, and everything she meets dies.
Xrn has enchanted barricades with her [Thaumaturge] abilities.
Xrn told Klbkch that she thought Wrymvr had gone insane, and a Queen says she is subservient and acts as the Queens do.
Xrn draws glyphs on the Hive wall and tells Pawn that if they attack the Free Antinium they will try to cast [Earthquake] and fail.
Xrn, the Small Queen, stands on an earth platform and addresses fourteen Prognugators and one Revalantor from three Hives: the Flying, Silent and Armored Antinium.

Xrn tells them to kill only Goblins and Humans and not Drakes unless ordered, and says that she, the Free Queen and Klbkch will lead in battle, with their commands superseding those of the other Queens.
Xrn's eyes shine with several colours, red for battle excitement, blue for anticipation, and bright yellow and white for hope.

Workers from all three Hives dig a vast tunnel north to Liscor, so that an army will be there to take back the city from the Humans when Liscor falls and its people retreat into the Free Antinium's Hive.
Xrn is azure blue, and the last of the three Centenium of Izril, with eyes of dancing pink, yellow and a hint of orange mischief.
Xrn tells the Grand Queen that the Free Queen must explain an incident to the Liscorian government, and the Free Queen is grateful for Xrn's lie.
Yellow Splatters is a Painted Antinium Soldier and [Sergeant] who commands about forty Soldiers.
Pawn introduces Yellow Splatters to Erin as a Soldier who is apparently more important than the others, but Pawn refuses to say why and calls it a secret for now.
He is a Level 12 [Sergeant] with the Skills [Tough Carapace] and [Power Strike].
He is an inch or two taller than other Soldiers, with a slightly larger body.
Yellow Splatters holds that eating aboveground and seeing the sky are pointless compared with fighting to save lives.
He deliberately overturns his bowl of food in Erin's inn, and every Soldier except Purple Smile pushes back their bowl and follows him out.
When Pawn orders him to stop sparring in the barracks, Yellow Splatters pushes Pawn aside, and the Soldiers turn their backs on Pawn to follow their [Sergeant].
Yellow Splatters decides that Purple Smile is unfit to be a [Sergeant], and he grows furious when Purple Smile hands a bowl of food to a Worker.
He flips the table and attacks Purple Smile, relying on being bigger and stronger and having [Tough Carapace], but Purple Smile dodges and deflects his blows.
Yellow Splatters realises he was wrong, that the Antinium needed to stare at the sky more than they needed more training, and he reads a wordless picture book about a Drake child with a magic sword.
Pawn tells the two Soldiers that fewer Painted Soldiers will be needed for fighting and relieves them of duty; Yellow Splatters thinks of how foolish he has been.
Pawn admits that some of the fault was his and Purple Smile's for not telling Yellow Splatters what they were doing.
Yellow Splatters understands that he is one of many, with a team and a family, and not a lone leader.
Pawn names Purple Smile and Yellow Splatters, both [Sergeants], to oversee the chess games and the training and emergencies while he consults Erin.
Klbkch tells the Free Queen that there may now be seven Individuals, with Yellow Splatters and Purple Smile the two Soldiers who show great promise.
Bird sees Yellow Splatters reading a book while Purple Smile does something like dancing.

Yellow Splatters refuses at first to fight for Erin against the Goblin Lord, then chooses one hundred of the Painted Soldiers, the oldest, none more than three years old, who follow him out of the Hive in disobedience of their Queen's orders.

Yellow Splatters returns in a taller, larger body with a permanent yellow carapace and a deep, commanding voice, built by a despairing Queen, and announces that he perished in battle against the Goblin Lord with his hundred Soldiers and was brought back to life.
The Painted Soldiers, three hundred strong, follow him out of Liscor's gate to clear Shield Spider nests, and he pulls off the leg of a matriarch spider as large as two wagons to use as a club.
He speaks fluently with a deep, commanding voice, and two of his four arms end in five-fingered Worker-style hands that he uses with a spoon.
Yellow Splatters tells Numbtongue that he was brought back by his Queen's will and that of the other Soldiers through the Rite of Anastases, an Antinium secret.
Numbtongue tells Yellow Splatters that being the last one is hard, and the Hobgoblin then helps him clear Shield Spiders.
Yellow Splatters tells Numbtongue that he and his Soldiers can eat wheat although it is uncomfortable.
Yellow Splatters says that he and Numbtongue are not friends, since the concept is foreign to Antinium and he has not studied it under Revalantor Klbkch.
He stays at the inn and lets the forty-nine other Soldiers there rotate in so that all may enjoy the experience.
He says he is stronger than before his death thanks to the Free Queen, having lost all but six levels in dying and regained five, and he intends to reach Level 20 within the month.
Yellow Splatters says he must be the strongest and make the Soldiers stronger with kindness, because he failed once before.
Asked by Numbtongue whether he is really the Prognugator of the Hive, Yellow Splatters calls it a convenient fact and answers "Perhaps" when it is called a lie.
Dekass, a Prognugator, regards the strange [Sergeant] as inferior despite his voice, and notes that Yellow Splatters insisted other Workers and Soldiers be served first.
Yellow Splatters tells Bird that heaven exists and that all Antinium who perish should believe in it.
Yellow Splatters applies to Zevara to replace Klbkch on the Watch, describing himself as a Prognugator of the Free Antinium and a Soldier, and Zevara considers him on a provisional basis.
Yellow Splatters guards Erin and says he has checked every twenty minutes with Purple Smiles and Belgrade, who are deployed in Liscor.
About forty Painted Antinium are in the inn and two squads are in the Garden.
Yerranola is a Selphid student of Niers Astoragon who inhabits a body, first a fresh Human one and later a female Dullahan body with the head sewn on.
Yerranola says she can feel things in her body and disconnects her nerves if something seems funky.
Yerranola drives a reinforced wagon at the plaza as a battering ram, laughing atop it, while Dullahans dive aside.
Tulm has the Midnight Shields stop the wagon, which splinters and sends Yerranola flying.
Cameral, in Dullahan armour as a decoy, throws his head toward Niers' circle, and Tulm leaps eight feet to catch it, so Niers rules "Out!"
Yerranola and Cameral say the plan was agreed beforehand and Cameral's wounds were real but planned.
Yerranola helps hold Merrik back from diving into the sea after Peki.
Seagrass beheads Yerranola, but her inner body tackles him over the railing, and she high-fives Wil with her headless body.
Yerranola finds a new body later.
A black arrow strikes Yerranola in the chest and she says she is only scratched, then goes silent on deck.
Later, Yerranola's body is gone from poisoning and she is kept in a jar of fluid in agony from blowfish poison.
Wil, Venaz, Feshi and Merrik resolve to take her to Oteslia for an antidote, though a bounty is on their heads.
Yesel is the wife of Prost, the [Farmer] of Riverfarm.
Yesel gives Durene a basket full of goods to take home after Laken first visits the village.
Yesel visits Laken and Durene at the cottage, bringing a gift of clothes, and chats with Laken over mint tea.
Yesel offers to put Laken up in her own home, with the children squeezing into one room.
Yesel offers to have Durene pull a wagon to carry Laken to the village.
Yesel says that the Beetrs would also welcome Laken, since they have an empty room after their daughter died the previous summer.
Laken declines every offer, and he senses Yesel's invisible looks at Durene and her reactions across the table.
Yesel sends Durene out for firewood so she can speak to Laken alone.
Yesel tells Laken that the villagers put Durene out at the cottage so she would not cause trouble, and asks whether Durene has told him what she is.
Yesel presses Laken to stay in the village, and he stops her by saying he prefers to let people keep their secrets.
Laken sends Yesel out of the cottage, thanking her for the clothes.
Laken asks after Yesel and the children, and Prost answers that all are well.
Durene eats fresh bread that Prost's wife Yesel baked in an oven the villagers uncovered that morning.
Yesel tells Ryoka that the villagers still remember her Christmas presents for the little ones during the hard winter.
Yisht is the Scalespeaker of Hectval, a Drake who leads the Hectval delegation to Liscor.
Yisht rushes to Lism at the reception, gushing with gratitude and apologising, and says that morning he thought Liscor a cesspool.
Yisht says the fault was his, due to misconceptions, and promises proper gifts to match Liscor's hospitality.
Yisht says Liscor's election was a damned shame and that Lism did his best to keep the Council from being stolen.
Yisht says three Gnolls on Liscor's Council is as bad as the Council being stolen, though it is just as well they are not a majority.
Yisht tells Lism it is a disgrace that Gnolls took over the city, and says Gnolls bring more theft and troublemaking and smell bad.
Yisht says Hectval keeps its Gnoll population regulated with separate districts, and that if Liscor's election was redrawn the old Council did it to save seats.
Yisht says Hectval's laws make citizenship hard for Gnolls, which Lism reacts to with thirteen years.
Yisht says that with the King of Destruction and the tribes restless, Hectval no longer kicks Gnolls out but institutes the right laws.
Yisht says Hectval's Drake households above a certain wealth have Paworker Gnolls as [Carers], [Cleaners] and [Porters], put in uniform and given a collar.
Yisht calls the collar a sign of affection and says Liscor was thought a lost cause with the Antinium.
Yisht calls Humans the enemy and the last straw, and disgusting, loudmouthed and arrogant.
Yitton Byres is the head of the small Byres family, a [Lord] whose chainmail is silvery steel.
Yitton Byres brought over a thousand retainers to the muster against the Goblin Lord, almost all his house could spare.
Yitton Byres has lived over fifty-three years and never took up arms as a [Knight], though he has faced many monsters.
Yitton Byres wears a maintained beard and dark brown hair turning grey, and carries himself with the gravitas of his class.
Yitton Byres keeps himself clean and smells of rain and metal.
The Byres house is regarded by other nobles as a small house with ancient holdings.
Byres lands lie past Riverfarm.
Yitton Byres says his family were vampire slayers in another age and the first [Knights] who rode with the Five Families.
Yitton Byres says the Byres house has also clashed with [Witches] and other monsters, and many of the Byres line have perished in battle.
Yitton Byres is the father of Ylawes and Yvlon Byres.
Shallel Byres is Yvlon's mother and comes from Terandria.
Shallel Byres says she was the daughter of a very minor noble house and married into money.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres' political standing rose sharply when images from Liscor showed two of his children helping defeat the Face-Eater Moths besieging the city.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Tyrion Veltras respects Yitton Byres as a solid, unpretentious [Lord], though they are not close friends.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres has modest holdings and eats the same plain food as his men, as the family cannot afford lavish supplies.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres wears a longsword at his side in the nobles' pavilion.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: When Lord Gralton threatens to confront Tyrion over the delay, Yitton says he would rather fight Gralton than suffer mutiny in the camp.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres proposes that a delegation persuade Tyrion of the nobles' discontent, and offers to be the first to join Gralton in it.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Tyrion lets Yitton Byres into his protective spell bubble, so that Yitton accepts that Tyrion holds him in some esteem.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres reports to Tyrion that two Goblin tribes are about to clash and offers to separate them.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres is troubled to see strategy such as pike walls, crossbows and harassing tactics coming from the Goblins.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Tyrion asks Yitton Byres to ride with him to the front for his input.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Lord Erill told Yitton Byres over cups that Tyrion would want as many Goblins alive as possible.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres was shaken by Tremborag's survival after being speared through the heart, and poured three cups of wine.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres had fought a Goblin Chieftain and seen a Goblin Lord before, but never laid eyes on a Goblin King.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres had not heard from Ylawes or Yvlon in a long while, and Ylawes had sworn to bring Yvlon back.

section: The Muster against the Goblin Lord (Books 7-9)
text: Yitton Byres watches the Goblin Lord's army absorb the defeated Goblins, and Tyrion answers his question with "There are enough to serve".
Yitton Byres fears that Yvlon and Ylawes are in Liscor, where Tyrion's army is about to attack.
Yitton Byres says Liscor's Mage's Guild refuses all [Message] spells that do not come from a Drake city.
Laken hears that Yitton Byres was against attacking Liscor from the start, a position no other noble in camp takes.
Yitton Byres asks Emperor Laken for help, saying Tyrion is not open to reason.
Laken promises to discuss ransom or other means to rescue Yitton's children, and Gralton joins in.
Laken names Lady Ieka and Lord Erill among nobles he is wary of, while judging Gralton chose his side faster.
Yitton Byres charges toward Tyrion with a sword, begging him to hold off the attack on Liscor so he can ransom his children.
Tyrion admits the attack is an assault, and Yitton accuses him of subterfuge and tells him he cannot let it happen.
Jericha stuns Yitton Byres with a spell at Tyrion's order to take him alive, and he is escorted behind the lines.
Yitton Byres reports that his daughter does not wish to see him and that approaching Liscor is dangerous at the moment.
Yitton Byres advises Laken not to hand something over to the other nobles, and Laken has to tell him to use his first name.
Yitton Byres offers cautious advice rooted in history, in contrast to Gralton's stories of failure.
Yitton Byres decides to accompany Laken because the Byres lands lie past Riverfarm.
Yitton Byres asks Pisces not to summon undead on his lands except at greatest need, as his subjects fear them.
Yitton Byres objects personally and morally to the existence of undead and of a class that uses them.
Yvlon smashes the dining table with a metal arm in anger at her father's treatment of Pisces.
Yitton Byres tells Yvlon that [Necromancers] have caused harm and that she would be responsible for any incidents.
Yvlon retorts that Yitton marched on Liscor with an army ready to slaughter its Drakes and Gnolls.
Yitton Byres says he did not know Yvlon was in Liscor and acted for the realm, since the target was a Goblin Lord.
Ylawes Byres is a tall blond Gold-rank [Knight] who wears silver plate and carries a shield and sword.
Ylawes leads the Silver Swords, an adventuring group dedicated to fighting monsters.
Ylawes is the older brother of Yvlon Byres.
He works mainly in the far north near the family estates, and is quite famous there.
Ylawes is a [Lord]'s son and has no knighthood order, saying he fulfilled the spirit of his class.
Ylawes uses the Skill [Shield Breaker] against Toren.
Magic twists a blade away from his head before it can strike.
His arms are enchanted but his plate mail is not.
He uses [Shield of Valor] to push zombies and Goblins back in a cone.
His armour is silvery with the Byres crest, and in Book 8 he carries a silver-alloyed longsword.
Ylawes wears silver and steel armour that, per the old stories, no Vampire could touch.
Ylawes says he came to Esthelm to put the dead to rest after hearing too late and finding other cities and the Adventurer's Guild doing nothing.
He is not a Named Adventurer and could not drive off hundreds of Goblins alone.
Ylawes suspects the Goblins spared Esthelm's people so there would be many bodies to raise as an undead horde.
Ylawes killed a man who charged him with a sword.
He shamed a gang of Esthelm men preying on each other into following him to protect the city.
He organised close to a thousand survivors into building barricades that sealed off nearly a quarter of the city.
Ylawes carries a scroll that shows a reply from someone, simply "Soon".
Ylawes told a man he had sent for help the night before and that the reply said help is coming, but not when.
Ylawes nearly killed the Redfang Goblins who attacked him, until the Horror intervened.
Ylawes wondered why the Redfang warriors were unlike ordinary Goblins.
Ylawes suspected the Redfang Goblins played a role in Esthelm's victory, having seen their leader kill the Goblin commander.
Ylawes holds the main entrance of the palisade, where he is struck by a javelin.
Ylawes remembered the dead girl as a monster, but saw only a smiling young woman, and let the Goblins leave with her body.
Ylawes is called the Savior of Esthelm in talk, and Yvlon says Esthelm is just another of his triumphs.
Ylawes' team sent a request seeking confirmation that Yvlon Byres lived in the city.
Ylawes arrived at Erin's inn with a half-Elf [Mage] and a Dwarf in full plate, and greeted Yvlon.
Erin threw a cake at his face when the Redfang Goblins drew weapons.
Ylawes sheathed his sword after learning the sign outside says No Killing Goblins.
House Byres supports itself with silver and merchants, has a mine, and is in decline.
House Byres was famous for rooting out Vampires, and its silver was key to their destruction.
Ylawes believes Magnolia's army will not engage the Goblin Lord, while Tyrion's levy would sweep the Goblins.
Ylawes' family has fought undead and those who command them for generations.
Ylawes committed his team to finding a lost Minotaur adventurer in Liscor's dungeon.
Ylawes said the largest Face-Eater Moth he had seen was mounted on a wall and only Troll-sized.
A giant Face-Eater Moth carried Ylawes aloft, and he cut into its belly as Falene's magic helped him survive.
Erin sold Ylawes advice for five copper and told him not to ask Yvlon to come home.
Ylawes explained to Embria that House Byres made arms against Vampires, last sighted four hundred years ago.
Ylawes argued with Yvlon about joining Tyrion's army and going north, and she refused.
He told Yvlon he outranks her as her brother, and she told him adventurers do not follow military command.
Ylawes demanded Yvlon leave Liscor for the north, and Falene bound her with [Binding Cords - Iron].
Ylawes fought Pisces and others until Halrac and Bevussa and the other adventurers stopped them.
Ylawes' team left Liscor going north.
Later, Ylawes returned to the walls and told Yvlon he had a change of heart and would not abandon her.
Ylawes has known Dawil for six years.
Ylawes learned from Ryoka that Yvlon is a [Silversteel Armsmistress] and that Ceria changed classes.
Ylawes performed a House Byres tradition at Colfa's home, and Dawil brought a bucket of water with a bit of silver in it.
Himilt shook Ylawes' silver-armoured hand, and his skin burned to the bone to hide that he is a Vampire.
Ylawes believes Vampires were monsters without conscience who hid among Humans pretending to emotion.
Ylawes grew suspicious that Fierre's family might be Vampires and asked Falene to message Delanay d'Artien.
Ytol is a [Death Commander] of the Rustängmarder, the commander of the company sent to join Flos.
The Rustängmarder have a [Commander] for each company who always has levels in [Necromancer].
Ytol's right arm, right eye and right leg are gone, and he leans on a crutch.
Ytol lost his limbs the month before, when his company marched to join the King of Destruction.
Ytol says that half is always the price for desertion and that he was grateful it was he who bore his company's sins, or they could not fight for Flos.
Ytol says the Rustängmarder were pained to honor one vow and forsake the other, so he above others was chosen.
Ytol says he would give up his other half to honor the oath, and that the whole company will come when their contract ends.
Ytol smiles when he looks at the King of Destruction, though his eyes are otherwise pitiless and empty.
Ytol rides toward Teres to check on her, balancing despite his lack of limbs.
Ytol goes still at the sight of the Minotaurs, like Mars, and asks Flos whether to advance or fall back.
Teres has never heard one of Flos's officers suggest a retreat before.
Ytol tells Flos the army did not prepare for a battle with Minotaurs.
Flos refuses the retreat, orders Ytol to advance and spread out, and the blank-faced Ytol bows.
Yvlon Byres is a Human adventurer, once Captain of the Silver Spears and later a member of the Horns of Hammerad.
Yvlon is the Third Daughter of House Byres, a small noble house in Izril that mines silver.
Yvlon was a [Warrior], later a [Wounded Warrior], and by Book 14 is a [Silversteel Armsmistress].
Yvlon Byres is a fair-skinned woman with blonde hair and polished silver armor, who sits beside Calruz in the group of captains.
Yvlon introduces herself to Ryoka as a Silver-rank adventurer and the Captain of the Silver Spears.
Yvlon says the Byres family are minor aristocracy who trade in silver, with several large mines in the area.
Yvlon says the Byres family is distantly related to the Reinharts.
Sostrom says Yvlon once defeated five bandits with only her bare hands after losing her sword.
Yvlon fights Ryoka in full plate armor, offers her the first strike, and takes a stance like a boxer's guard.
Yvlon blocks Ryoka's spinning wheel kick with her arms and staggers, then catches Ryoka's punch with her gauntlet.
Yvlon twists Ryoka's hand and her gauntlet draws blood from Ryoka's jaw before she lets go.
Yvlon smiles politely in a [Lady]'s way that gives nothing away, similar to Lady Magnolia's smile.
Yvlon offers to set up an arrangement for Ryoka to work for the captains' teams, including delivering supplies to the ruins near Liscor.
Yvlon says her aunt told her that Ryoka has no levels or classes, which she had not believed until the fight.
An onlooker suggests that Yvlon would never have taken the fight normally, and wonders what her aunt told her.
Yvlon pledges that each of her Silver Spears will receive a share of the reward, and that the families of those who fall will not be left penniless.
Yvlon meets Ceria's eyes across fifteen feet as Skinner kills, then tears herself away and keeps running as the dead chase her.
Yvlon and Cervial run to Liscor and back in under thirty minutes to look for the missing girl, but the gate guard says no one came by.
Yvlon sits catatonic in a white bed in the Adventurer's Guild, half the skin of her face torn away and her hair ragged.
Yvlon's armor was torn to shreds when cut off her, and Selys remembers her screaming.
Ryoka tells Ceria that Yvlon is comatose and neither speaks nor moves.
Yvlon is described as silent and still recovering, and as the only silver-rank adventurer of note left.
Later, Yvlon wakes; her body is repaired but she is scarred, and she blames herself when she sees Ceria.
Yvlon is the only captain left, her squad perished entirely in the Ruins, and about eight survivors have scattered.
The Watch seized the survivors' equipment, so they cannot pay the death insurance to the families.
Yvlon wakes in the Adventurer's Guild and looks at her face in a hand mirror that her mother gave her long ago.
The mirror is spelled for protection and backed with pure silver, and the Byres family locked it so that it will not reflect anything in a non-Byres's hand.
The healing potion Yvlon drank to help Selys restored most of her damaged skin, which she did not want, though a faint scar remains on her left face.
Yvlon moves into a small cramped room that the Guild keeps for struggling adventurers, because she thinks it is less than she deserves.
Yvlon has no coins left but her silver-steel plate armor, shield and a longsword made by a Level 32 [Blacksmith] are valuable.
Yvlon wears the armament of a [Knight] though she is only a [Warrior], and thinks she is not worthy of the [Knight] class.
Yvlon thinks she let her people die through incompetence and survived only because she was guarding the rear.
Yvlon decides to act and heads for the southern gates, believing the Silver Spears are dead, even their Captain.
Erin finds Yvlon tall, golden-haired and fair-skinned, and her manners resemble Lyonette's in their elegance.
Yvlon's face is scarred where Skinner ripped the skin from the left half, though she has not lost her nose.
Yvlon tells Erin the scar is her penance for failing the people she led, and says she did not want to use a healing potion.
Ceria argues that Skinner was not Yvlon's fault, since Cervial, Gerald and Lir, all Silver-rank Captains, also failed to sense anything amiss.
Yvlon says she took responsibility for her adventurers' lives and has nothing to give their families but her armor and sword.
Ceria calls Yvlon as stubborn as Gerial and Calruz.
Yvlon's face is nearly healed and she stands steady in her silver armor when she arrives at the inn with Krshia and Selys.
Yvlon has no activatable skills but fights with competent swordplay, turning cuts with her shield and slashing off Goblin limbs.
Local adventurers in Esthelm meet Ceria, and especially Yvlon, with sympathy or contempt because all of them knew someone who died in the crypt.
Under the spell, Yvlon speaks as Ylawes Byres, a [Swordsman] and heir to the Byres name, and then as Yelen Byres.
Yvlon charges the fiery guardian crying "For Byres and honor!", and her silver sword shatters its gem before it melts.
Yvlon's silver armor melts over her hands and arms, and she lies unconscious with melted silver intertwined with flesh.
Yvlon removes the rest of her plate armor, but the melted silver on her arms is fused to her skin, though she can still flex her arms at the elbows and wrists.
Yvlon says she always wondered how Dullahans lived and will learn a little of it, and that her father would be proud.
Yvlon walks silently through the cheering crowd in Liscor, where people point at her arms as those of a wounded hero rather than in disgust.
Ceria imagines Gerial, Calruz, Sostrom, Hunt and Marian walking beside the Horns of Hammerad during the cheering.
A [Healer] tells Yvlon the metal cannot be removed from her arms, and suggests only a [Bone Surgeon] or a higher-level [Healer] with a Skill might help.
A [Blacksmith] says she could cut away the outer metal with an enchanted dagger and sand it smooth, but would not touch the parts anchored to bone.
Yvlon was raised among nobles and learned to read people's eyes and dance with words before she picked up a sword.
Yvlon keeps cool composure and politeness at all times, which she calls the mark of a Byres.
Yvlon grieves that the ugly black metal replaces the silver she wore, which was her family's colors and fortune and the name of her adventuring group.
Yvlon dreams of the pit and of Skinner, the crawling monster with crimson eyes, and the undead striking down each of her friends.
Yvlon defies "Aunt Magnolia's" request to take Ryoka, and Lady Magnolia's maid corrects her to "Lady Magnolia".
Ceria remembers that the Byres house is a branch house of the Reinhart family and subservient in some way.
Yvlon wears leather instead of plate, except along her fused arms, because her plate armor was too damaged to save.
Yvlon can still wield a sword with some stiffness, but her arms need a master-class [Healer] or a spell to fix.
The [Blacksmith] helped sand the rough edges of the metal in Yvlon's arms after cutting most of it away.
Yvlon considers killing Pisces over the danger of undead like Toren, until Ceria and Erin argue against it and she agrees to watch him as a teammate.
Erin tells Yvlon that Pisces saved her life at least twice, once against Acid Flies and once by sending undead to protect her against Skinner.
Yvlon says her brother Ylawes has a Dwarf in his group, whom he met by luck in a tavern.
Yvlon calls her brother Ylawes overprotective and a far better adventurer than she.
Yvlon does not speak a word to Pisces all morning, not even to greet him, after learning he made Toren.
Yvlon has perfect blonde hair and metal fused into her arms, and Termin addresses her as Miss Byres.
Yvlon covers her bright hair with a cloak and asks the others to avoid her name and the group's name in Esthelm because she wants to avoid meeting her brother Ylawes.
Yvlon says Ylawes is not a threat, so long as he does not meet Ksmvr for the first time alone.
Yvlon had a tutor as a child, as rich families do, but could not cast [Light], and neither could her older brother or her sister.
Yvlon says Ylawes will try to take her home the instant he finds her, because he would never accept her continuing to adventure while crippled.
Yvlon says her family is a minor house in Izril known for an adventurer or warrior in each generation and for names beginning with "y".
Yvlon says that if her family had a potion or artifact to regenerate bones or limbs, they would not be a minor house.
The metal in Yvlon's forearms is melded with both flesh and bone, and she scratches at her arms absently.
Yvlon hates necromancy and barely tolerates Pisces, and would never let him experiment with adding someone else's bone to hers.
Yvlon says that in her experience the best adventurers do not fixate on magical items, since she has seen too many teams torn apart over loot.
Yvlon tries on plain steel gauntlets and winces as they strike the metal in her skin.
Yvlon was a Level 22 [Warrior], a respectable Silver-rank adventurer, whose team the Silver Spears was well known and respected locally.
Later, Yvlon gains the new class [Wounded Warrior] at Level 26, which she has told no one.
Yvlon despairs that she will never be a [Knight], never be her brother's equal and never go home.
Yvlon suggests taking contracts in Esthelm, and Pisces agrees.
Yvlon brings back a request to exterminate three adult male bears bothering Esthelm, just past the town.
Halrac advises checking that the bears are not Mothbears or rabid, and Jelaqua adds that they might be infected with Brainshrooms.
Yvlon changes her grip on her sword, with a broken right arm, and uses the mordhau technique to crash its enchanted pommel through the Creler's back.
Yvlon has the Skill [Ignore Pain] and does not feel her broken arm, noticing only when she cannot grip her sword properly.
Pisces corrects the bones around the bent steel in Yvlon's broken right arm, and Yvlon pours a healing potion over it.
Pisces says he can repair Yvlon's arms but cannot remove the iron fused with her flesh, since there is not enough bone to rebuild the arms afterward.
Pisces says a bear's bones, or any other bones, would be rejected by a human body, which accepts only its own bone.
Yvlon says her family is devoted to championing justice and has a history of serving as [Knights].
Yvlon was raised to hate necromancy and says she would cut down any [Necromancer] she meets, but tolerates Pisces only.
Yvlon tells her team that she is a Level 26 [Wounded Warrior], a show of trust among adventurers.
Yvlon refuses to go north with her brother Ylawes, who rode hundreds of miles to take her home, saying she is in a team.
Yvlon tells Ylawes she was injured in Albez protecting her team and would do it again, and that the metal is in her bones.
Yvlon says her sword has the weight enchantment and is better than Ylawes's, so she can fight despite weak arms.
Ylawes is a [Knight] with silver armor and the family crest, and Yvlon envies him but did not want him there.
Ceria, Yvlon and Ksmvr all level up after a battle.
Ceria casts [Silence] on her and Yvlon's room every night because both wake up screaming, which Erin says began while they explored Albez.
Yvlon breaks her left shield arm blocking a Raskghar and does not notice, because of [Ignore Pain].
Yvlon's broken bone shows metal fused to it, and she says she forgot to activate the magic on her shield.
Yvlon no longer hates Pisces and regards him as her teammate, though she does not like him.
Yvlon asks Pisces to reinforce her arms with a lattice of necromantic bone, a splint and a shield over the bone, saying she would once have rather died.
Pisces at first refuses to experiment on the living, but agrees to do it and says it can be removed.
Yvlon tells Pisces to use bear bones, and Pisces works on her arms hidden from the inn's other occupants.
Yvlon points out to Pisces that dead Raskghar and Goblins are not on Selys's list of banned bones, so he can use them.
Pisces reinforces both of Yvlon's arms with bone, and she agrees to keep it between the two of them for now.
Yvlon wakes in armor, tied to her bed by Falene's magical bindings after a sleep spell, with a sandwich on her chest left by Dawil.
Yvlon frees herself when Ksmvr cuts the bindings with her sword, as Pisces advises, saying Falene's spell is only Tier 4.
Yvlon wears her gauntlets and vambraces for some reason, and her arms look bigger.
Yvlon tells Erin she left the dungeon because she did not want to ask Ceria why she let Calruz live, as the horrors he let the Raskghar commit were not the Calruz she knew.
Yvlon says Ceria saw the heart of the dungeon, and that what lurks there is not something Erin needs to hear about.
Revi and Yvlon tell Selys the Raskghar treasure was a gift from the Goblins, so it is not taxable under the Adventurer's Guild's laws.
Revi and Yvlon note that the Redfang Goblins were only made a team the previous day, so they were not registered adventurers when they gave the treasure away.
Ylawes proposes going north toward Lord Veltras's army, and Yvlon refuses, saying Tyrion Veltras will conscript a Gold-rank team and sack Liscor.
Yvlon accuses her father of throwing out centuries of the Byres family's friendship with the Reinharts by supporting Tyrion Veltras.
Yvlon tosses her drink at Ylawes, tells him she is not a [Knight] and that adventurers do not follow military command.
Yvlon tells Ylawes she is not his little sister and refuses to leave her team, then goes off to try Erin's dance.
Yvlon says that if Liscor falls, she will go with her team and take Erin south.
Yvlon regrets that she never thanked Ylawes for coming all that way and doing so much for her.
Yvlon, the [Wounded Warrior], wears her gauntlets even while eating, and Ceria knows she cannot feel her arms.
Yvlon says she is Level 28, wants to reach Level 30 to gain a stronger class than [Wounded Warrior], and feels like the weakest link.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Ceria tells Crossbow Stan that she and Yvlon had the dead cremated and gave the families all the money they had left.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Ceria says Yvlon lost everything except her armor and sword to the families.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon breaks down in tears in a cell, saying she lost her team, sometimes forgets their names and faces, no longer dreams of them and ran.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon tells Embria she is Silver-rank and has improved since her last ranking test, though not enough.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says her armor is second-rate but decent and her sword is a Sword of [Weight], which she tries not to let do the fighting.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon is a Level 28 [Wounded Warrior], having leveled up once during training with Ksmvr and fighting low-level monsters.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Grimalkin identifies Yvlon's Skills as a footwork Skill, [Lesser Strength], an armor-lightening Skill and [Keener Edge], and says she lacks the powerful moves of a Level 30 class.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Pisces's bone reinforcement holds when Yvlon tumbles down a muddy hill, and she cannot feel her arms.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon eats with a fork despite the metal arm guards she almost always wears, and takes them off only to wash the skin.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon hides an infection, red and swollen, under the guards.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon spars daily with Ksmvr in the Adventurer's Guild's practice yard, and predicts his [Quick Slash].

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon uses the Skill [Crescent Cut], a curving blade attack that slides down past a blocker, which she says is not good against monsters.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon wears bought-piecemeal enchanted steel armor that is mismatched in decoration but high-quality, and never takes off her arm armor in public.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Few people know the extent of Yvlon's injuries beyond her friends: a fire elemental at Albez melted her old armor and the metal burned into her arms.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Pisces's reinforcement lets Yvlon strike hard without her arms breaking, but a lot of her bone is gone and he is still working on the underlying problem.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says she was Captain of the Silver Spears, whose five members were Veronika, Maisé, Dalia, Samite and herself.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon wanted the Silver Spears to be like her brother's team, the Silver Swords, and still feels she is back in the crypts watching her friends vanish.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon wonders whether her survival was cowardice or practicality, and why she was the only one to make it out.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Alais invites Ceria and Yvlon to a private drink with the northern team captains, and Yvlon accepts and feels welcomed again.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon dislocates her left arm in a fight with Wistram's Beza without feeling it, and brawls on one-handed until she pins the Minotaur.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Montressa casts [Binding Cords] on Yvlon and a Centaur finishes her with [Soporific Dust], though she resists for nearly a minute.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Ceria is sealed into a black box by Montressa, and Alais later wakes to find Ceria, Yvlon and Ksmvr gone.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon's arm now has bone grafted onto the weakened arm, with the flesh torn, infected and oozing pus where the metal is.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says Pisces's bone supports let her swing a sword and that the [Healer] agreed, and says she asked Pisces to do it.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Ceria is angry that Yvlon did not tell her, and Yvlon says she did not because Ceria would react exactly this way; Ksmvr knew by accident.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says the infection is not from the bones, that she does not feel it, and that she can move her arms.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: The [Healer] says exertion might provoke Yvlon's infection or cure it, and Yvlon decides to keep adventuring and use a potion if wounded.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Pisces hopes to remove the metal from Yvlon's bone, which is beyond him now, at Level 40.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says there is no fixing her arms short of someone like the fabled Healer of Tenbault.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Later, Yvlon's arm skin is infected again where it meets the metal, and a Gnoll [Healer] warns a healing potion can feed the infection.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Healers in other cities suggested that in time Yvlon's skin might accept the metal, or not.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says the Byres family has five members: her parents, Ylawes, herself and her older sister Ysara, the eldest.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says the family's "y" naming is a tradition, though her mother married into the family and is not named so.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon says all three siblings were taught the sword and Ysara was gifted, possibly better than Pisces, but she is not a [Knight] and is an [Armored Merchant] working in the north.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon walks past Montressa's team after they rescue her, telling them to stay away from her team.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Facing Crelers, Yvlon sees the horde of undead and the Silver Spears falling, and cries "Horns of Hammerad! Stand and fight!".

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon's Sword of Weight rebounds off the adult Creler's head three times, then the Creler severs her right arm.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: The sword is an enchanted weapon taken from Albez and is worthy of a Gold-rank adventurer.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon reattaches her severed arm to her shoulder, Pisces fuses the bone, and a healing potion closes the flesh, but the arm is weak.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon can swing the sword awkwardly, and cannot change the grip of her fingers.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon reverses her grip and uses the mordhau to crack a juvenile Creler's underbelly, then strikes the adult's head repeatedly, with the blow of a Sword of Weight heavier than a warhammer.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon reads Beza's scroll of [Lion's Strength] with one hand and charges the adult Creler with her broken sword.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon clings to the adult Creler's head, tears off pieces of armor, and cuts a tunnel toward its brain without feeling pain.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon shouts "I am Yvlon Byres" while ramming her sword toward the Creler's brain, and a strike from inside tears open her cheek.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: The Creler throws Yvlon out of its body just before she can reach the brain, when the scroll's enchantment has faded.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon wakes in the broken inn with notifications that her [Wounded Warrior] class is Level 32 and her [Crescent Cut] has changed.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Her class changes from [Wounded Warrior] to [Silversteel Armsmistress], and her arms are now pure silver mixed with burnished steel, a metal skin imitating flesh.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon lifts her broken, heavy Sword of Weight with one arm as if it were light.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon tells the crowd she is an [Armsmistress] and that her [Crescent Cut] Skill has become the sword art [Sword Art: Curve of the Moon].

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Keldrass explains that sword arts are powerful but situational techniques that must be set up in combat, unlike Skills.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon's sword art extends the reach of her blade and cuts a rift in the Guild's floor, a table and a rafter.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon has a Skill from her new arms, [Armform], and its duelist form makes her arms look like armor over the outside of her skin.

section: Training, sorrow and the northern teams (Books 11-13)
text: Yvlon can use [Armform (Razorkind)] to put a cutting edge on her gauntlets and turn her fingers into razor blades.
Yvlon is a Gold-rank [Armsmistress] whose arms, up to the shoulder, are a mix of silver and steel imitating flesh down to the muscle, replacing the crippled arms she had a month earlier.
Yvlon feels heat through her metal arms, but the sensation is removed from burning, and her arms hold the fire's heat.
People stare at Yvlon's arms and call them beautiful.
Yvlon introduces herself as the Third Daughter of the House of Byres.
Yvlon grabs a [Guardswoman] to stop the Watch arresting Ksmvr, stating that Magnolia Reinhart, the [Lady] of Invrisil, is her aunt by relation.
Yvlon regrets pulling rank, tells Ksmvr she hates acting like Pisces, and asks him not to do what she did unless he has no choice.
Yvlon drags a table over one-handed with her new arms, and tells Ryoka it is the same Yvlon with new arms.
In the village of Yissirain's Rest, within House Byres's domain, locals recognise Yvlon as Lady Yvlon by her hair and arms and recall that her brother once slew two Mothbears.
Yvlon wants to go home straight away rather than let a thank-you gift reach her family, and has not told her family of her new class.
Yvlon covers her metal skin with a long-sleeved shirt and gloves and asks nobody to mention her arms, saying she does not want to make a scene.
Yvlon says she is the third child of House Byres, that her sister is the real heir, and that the house is small and poor and mines silver.
Yvlon says her parents are very traditional, her father especially, and that her mother married into the family.
House Byres's keep sits near the foothills and a silver mine, ringed by a moat that connects to a river.
Yvlon's father is Lord Yitton Byres, in his early fifties with grey-brown hair and beard, and her mother is Shallel Byres, amber-haired with a faded Terandrian accent.
Shallel Byres was Guildmistress of the Scrivener's Guild in Terandria, from a minor house, before she met Yitton.
Yvlon's father and mother are glad to see her, though she did not announce her visit and they have not heard from her for months.
Yvlon tells her mother she does not feel Human, and fears she did not earn her new strength and feels part-Golem.
Yvlon suggests leaving after a few more days without upsetting her parents, and asks about Pisces's dead village.
Yvlon says a legend holds that the dragon Yderigrisel, once a friend of House Byres, will return in their hour of need, though it already came back during the Creler wars and died.
Zalaiss Holmfyre is a [Merchant] elected to Liscor's new Council.
Olesm describes Zalaiss and Tismel as wealthy, safe picks in their districts.
Zalaiss counts on the Council as one of the Drakes in Lism's party, along with Tismel, Jeiss and Alonna.
Zalaiss and Tismel are in the same bed as the old Council, as Olesm sees it.
Zalaiss and Tismel sit between Krshia and Lism across the table at the first meeting, apprehensive about the old Council.
Zalaiss timidly objects that having the Council announcement shouted repeatedly would be lazy, and falls silent when Lism and Krshia agree the matter is unimportant.
Zalaiss asks hesitantly whether the Council meeting time means right at dawn.
Zalaiss votes in favour of executing the Minotaur in the dungeon, when Tismel hesitates, in Lism's proposed vote.
Zalaiss, being a [Merchant], looks sharply at Lism and knows when not to trust someone's immediate word.
Zalaiss objects to Lism's motion to limit rent prices, claiming she has a right to be heard as a Councilmember of equal rank.
Lism answers that the Council has already decided, and Zalaiss pales as the other Councilmembers back his rent motion.
Zalaiss tries to yank Jeiss's arm down when the Council raises hands for Lism's motions, to no effect.
Zalaiss shouts that Lism's actions are mutiny, and flees the room to tell the old Council as Lism urges.
Zalaiss returns with the old Council, and Relc blocks the way, telling Zalaiss and Tismel they may listen if they promise not to interrupt.
Zalaiss rarely shows up to Council meetings, and is either drunk when she arrives or with Tismel and the old Council, relaying the current Council's decisions.
Zalaiss and Tismel lack the votes to sway any but contentious issues.
Zalaiss and Tismel are the largely useless traditionalist members of the Council, who tend to be overridden in majority votes.
Zamea is the leader of the Nomads of the Sky and the tallest of the half-Giants, with the strongest bloodlines.
Zamea is about thirty feet tall, or ten meters, and the ground trembles where she walks.
Zamea holds the title Shepherd, and is called First Shepherd of the Nomads of the Sky.
Zamea's skin is rugged and mineral-hard, her eyes are pale orange, and she looks like a scaled-up Human woman.
Zamea is twice as large as the average War Walker.
Zamea wields an axe and her skin can stop steel.
Zamea punches a Manticore in a battle, and the rest flee her.
Flos calls Shepherd Zamea over to hear news of subjects arriving from Jecrass.
Zamea tells Teres that half-Giants have skin like armor, and that she would break only after mountains do.
Zamea says she is one of the last of the tallfolk and tells Teres that they are not equals, while lifting her in her hand.
Zamea says the Nomads number only hundreds, while smallfolk are like dust, everywhere.
Zamea carries a frightened Teres on her shoulder, choosing her steps with care.
Zamea strides against Belchan's first line, her axe gleaming, smashing through dirt, stone and pits as soldiers vanish before her swings.
Zamea shouts for the smallfolk to bring her down for Reim in Flos Reimarch's name.
Zamea is struck in the cheek by an enchanted javelin and is threatened by elite soldiers with enchanted blades.
Zamea uses [Cleaving Arc], widening her axe's blade, and cuts half of the elites apart.
Zamea, the First Shepherd, puts on a helmet and tells Orthenon to order his [Soldiers] back, as she will not stop until the enemy breaks.
Zamea and Orthenon tear Jecrass's forces apart so that its army breaks within five minutes.
Flos offers Zamea condolences for the loss of her kin, Shali.
Zassil is a male Oldblood Drake with wings, and an adventurer of the Wings of Pallass.
Zassil is the youngest of Bevussa's team and sometimes shows his inexperience.
Zassil is a [Battle Flier], a class unique to flying species, and is a competent [Flier].
Zassil fights with a spear in the air.
Zassil is publicly named the captain of the Wings of Pallass, while Bevussa is the real captain, an open secret among adventurers.
Zassil lands with Issa on a Stone Starer and stabs it with spear and sword, killing it.
Zassil stares at the Flamewardens' firepower in awe and says they must be Named Adventurers, as if forgetting he is Oldblood himself.
Zassil sits up after a Drake from another team leaves and says something about a botched ambush, and Bevussa slaps him across the back of the head.
Zassil is seized mid-dive by a Redfang warrior who leaps from a Carn Wolf and stabs at his wings until Bevussa hurls the warrior off.
Zassil flexes his wings and grins at the other Drakes as the team discusses how fliers are poor dungeon-divers.
Bevussa orders Zassil to fly back and find the other teams so they can rally at the dungeon entrance.
